text: He has fenced up my way so that I cannot pass, and He has set darkness in my paths.

title: Job 19:9
text: He has stripped me of my glory, and has taken the crown from my head.

title: Job 19:10
text: He has broken me on every side, and I am gone, and He has uprooted my hope like a tree.

title: Job 19:11
text: He has also kindled His wrath against me, and to Himself He counts me as His enemy.

title: Job 19:12
text: His troops come together and raise up their way against me, and camp around my tent.

title: Job 19:13
text: He has put my brothers far from me, and my friends have truly turned away from me.

title: Job 19:14
text: My people have fallen away, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

title: Job 19:15
text: Those who dwell in my house, and my slave-girls, count me as a stranger; I am a foreigner in their sight.

title: Job 19:16
text: I called my servant, and he gave no answer; I must beg him with my mouth.

title: Job 19:17
text: My breath is hated by my wife, and I must beg to the sons of my [mother's] womb.

title: Job 19:18
text: Even young children despise me; I arise, and they speak against me.

title: Job 19:19
text: All the men of my counsel detest me, even this one I loved has turned against me.

title: Job 19:20
text: My bone clings to my skin and to my flesh, and I have escaped with the skin of my teeth.

title: Job 19:21
text: Have pity on me! Have pity on me, my friends! For the hand of God has touched me.

title: Job 19:22
text: Why do you, like God, persecute me and are not satisfied with my flesh?

title: Job 19:23
text: Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were engraved in a book!

title: Job 19:24
text: [Oh that] they were cut with an iron pen and lead in the rock forever!

title: Job 19:25
text: For I know [that] my Redeemer lives, and He shall rise on the earth at the last;

title: Job 19:26
text: and even after they corrupt my skin, yet this: in my flesh I shall see God,

title: Job 19:27
text: whom I shall see for myself, and my eyes shall behold, and not a stranger's; [though] My heart be exhausted in my bosom.

title: Job 19:28
text: For you ought to say, Why do we persecute him, since the root of the matter is found in me?

title: Job 19:29
text: Fear for yourselves because of the sword; for wrath [brings] the punishments of the sword, so that you may know [there is] a judgment.

title: Job 20:1
text: And Zophar the Naamathite answered and said,

title: Job 20:2
text: Therefore my thoughts cause me to answer, even because of my haste in me.

title: Job 20:3
text: I have heard the rebuke meant to shame me, and the spirit of my understanding causes me to answer.

title: Job 20:4
text: Do you know this from [days] of old, from the setting of man on earth,

title: Job 20:5
text: that the exulting of the wicked [is] short, and the joy of the ungodly [is] for a moment?

title: Job 20:6
text: Though his honor mounts up to the heavens, and his head reaches to the clouds,

title: Job 20:7
text: he shall perish forever like his dung; they who see him shall say, Where [is] he?

title: Job 20:8
text: He flies away like a dream, and shall not be found, and shall be chased away like a vision of the night.

title: Job 20:9
text: An eye glimpsed him, but will not again; yea, his place shall not see him again.

title: Job 20:10
text: His sons shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore his wealth.

title: Job 20:11
text: His bones are full of his youthful vigor, but it lies down with him in the dust.

title: Job 20:12
text: Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, [though] he hides it under his tongue;

title: Job 20:13
text: [though] he spares it and will not leave it; yea, keeps it still in his mouth;

title: Job 20:14
text: [yet] his food in his belly shall be turned; the gall of asps [is] within him.

title: Job 20:15
text: He swallows riches, but vomits it; God shall cast them out of his belly.

title: Job 20:16
text: He shall suck the poison of asps; the viper's tongue shall slay him.

title: Job 20:17
text: He shall not see the rivers, the flowings of the brooks of honey and butter,

title: Job 20:18
text: giving back his gain, and he will not eat. As to the wealth of his trading, even he shall not enjoy [it].

title: Job 20:19
text: For he pressed down [and] forsook the poor; he stole a house, but he had not built it.

title: Job 20:20
text: Surely he shall not know quietness in his belly; he will not escape with the things of desire.

title: Job 20:21
text: None of his food shall be left; therefore his good will not last.

title: Job 20:22
text: In the fullness of his plenty he shall be in trouble; every wretched one shall come on him.

title: Job 20:23
text: It shall happen at the filling of his belly, [God] shall cast the fury of His wrath on him, and He shall rain on him while he is eating.

title: Job 20:24
text: He shall flee from the iron weapon, a bow of bronze shall pierce him.

title: Job 20:25
text: One draws it, and treads it from behind, even lightning from his gall; terror [is] on him.

title: Job 20:26
text: All darkness [shall be] hidden in his secret places; a fire not blown shall consume him; those left in his tent shall be broken.

title: Job 20:27
text: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity, and the earth rise up against him.

title: Job 20:28
text: The increase of his house shall depart, and shall flow [away] in the day of his wrath.

title: Job 20:29
text: This [is] the portion of a wicked man from God, and the inheritance of his word from God.

title: Job 21:1
text: And Job answered and said,

title: Job 21:2
text: Listen carefully to my speech, and let this be your comfort.

title: Job 21:3
text: Rise with me and I shall speak; and after I have spoken, mock on.

title: Job 21:4
text: [As for] me, is my complaint to man? And why should my spirit not be troubled?

title: Job 21:5
text: Turn to me and be amazed, and lay [your] hand on [your] mouth.

title: Job 21:6
text: And if I remember, I am afraid, and trembling takes hold on my flesh.

title: Job 21:7
text: Why do the wicked live? They grow old and become mighty [in] power?

title: Job 21:8
text: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

title: Job 21:9
text: Their houses [are] in peace, without fear; nor [is] the rod of God on them.

title: Job 21:10
text: Their bull mates and does not fail; their cow calves, and does not cast her calf.

title: Job 21:11
text: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

title: Job 21:12
text: They lift up [voice] at the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the flute.

title: Job 21:13
text: They spend their days in good, and in a moment go down [to] the grave.

title: Job 21:14
text: And they say to God, Depart from us; for we do not desire the knowledge of your ways;

title: Job 21:15
text: what [is] the Almighty, that we should serve Him? And what profit should we have if we pray to Him?

title: Job 21:16
text: Behold, their good [is] not in their hand; the wisdom of the wicked is far from me.

title: Job 21:17
text: How often is the lamp of the wicked put out, and their trouble comes on them! He shares out pains in His anger;

title: Job 21:18
text: they are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff [that] the storm steals away.

title: Job 21:19
text: God lays up his iniquity for his children. He repays him, and he knows.

title: Job 21:20
text: His eyes shall see his ruin, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

title: Job 21:21
text: For what [is] his pleasure in his house after him, and the number of his months is cut off?

title: Job 21:22
text: Shall [any] teach God knowledge, since He shall judge the exalted?

title: Job 21:23
text: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

title: Job 21:24
text: His sides are full of milk, his bones are wet with marrow.

title: Job 21:25
text: And another dies with bitter soul, and never eats with pleasure.

title: Job 21:26
text: They lie down together in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.

title: Job 21:27
text: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the plots which you wrongfully hatch against me.

title: Job 21:28
text: For you say, Where [is] the house of the noble, and where the dwelling-places of the wicked?

title: Job 21:29
text: [Did] you not ask those who go by the way? And do you not know their signs,

title: Job 21:30
text: that the wicked is kept for the day of calamity? They shall be brought to the day of wrath.

title: Job 21:31
text: Who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him [what] he has done?

title: Job 21:32
text: Yet he shall be brought to the grave, and watch shall be kept over [his] tomb.

title: Job 21:33
text: And the clods of the valley shall be sweet to him and every man shall draw after him, as [there is] no numbering of those before him.

title: Job 21:34
text: How then do you comfort me in vain; yea, in your answers remains transgression?

title: Job 22:1
text: And Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

title: Job 22:2
text: Can a man be useful to God, as he who is wise may be useful to himself?

title: Job 22:3
text: [Is it] any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous, or gain [to Him] that you make your ways perfect?

title: Job 22:4
text: Will He reprove you because of your reverence, or enter into judgment with you?

title: Job 22:5
text: [Is] not your wickedness great, and your iniquity without measure?

title: Job 22:6
text: For you have taken a pledge from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

title: Job 22:7
text: You have not given water to the weary to drink, and you have held back bread from the hungry.

title: Job 22:8
text: But [as for] the mighty man, he had the earth, and the honored man lived in it.

title: Job 22:9
text: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

title: Job 22:10
text: Therefore snares [are] all around you, and sudden fear troubles you;

title: Job 22:11
text: or darkness, [so that] you cannot see; and a flood of waters covers you.

title: Job 22:12
text: [Is] not God high in Heaven? And behold the leading stars, for [they] are high.

title: Job 22:13
text: And you say, What does God know? Can He judge through the dark cloud?

title: Job 22:14
text: Clouds [are] a covering to Him, so that He does not see; and He walks in the circuit of Heaven.

title: Job 22:15
text: Do you keep to the old way which wicked men have walked?

title: Job 22:16
text: [They] were seized, but [there was] not time; their foundation was poured out [by] a flood;

title: Job 22:17
text: who said to God, Depart from us; and, What can the Almighty do to them?

title: Job 22:18
text: Yet He filled their houses with substance; and the wisdom of the wicked is far from me.

title: Job 22:19
text: The righteous see [it], and are glad; and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

title: Job 22:20
text: Truly our foe is not cut down, and fire has eaten their wealth.

title: Job 22:21
text: Now be of service with Him, and be at peace. Good shall come to you by them.

title: Job 22:22
text: Please receive the law from His mouth and lay up His words in your heart.

title: Job 22:23
text: If you return to the Almighty, you shall be built up; you shall put away injustice far from your tents.

title: Job 22:24
text: Then you shall lay up gold like dust, and among the rock of the torrents of Ophir.

title: Job 22:25
text: Yea, the Almighty shall be your gold and silver, [a] tower to you.

title: Job 22:26
text: For then you shall have your delight in the Almighty, and shall lift up your face to God.

title: Job 22:27
text: You shall make your prayer to Him, and He shall hear you, and you shall pay your vows.

title: Job 22:28
text: You shall also order a thing, and it shall be fulfilled to you; and the light shall shine on your ways.

title: Job 22:29
text: For they have humiliated [you], and you shall say, Pride! And He shall save the lowly of eyes.

title: Job 22:30
text: He shall deliver [one] not innocent, and will deliver by the pureness of your hands.

title: Job 23:1
text: And Job answered and said,

title: Job 23:2
text: Even today [is] my complaint bitter; my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

title: Job 23:3
text: Oh that I knew [where] I might find Him, [that] I might come even to His seat!

title: Job 23:4
text: I would order [my] cause before Him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

title: Job 23:5
text: I would know the words [which] He would answer me, and understand what He would say to me.

title: Job 23:6
text: Will He plead against me with [His] great power? No, surely He would give heed to me.

title: Job 23:7
text: There the righteous might reason with Him; and I would be delivered forever from my Judge.

title: Job 23:8
text: Behold, I go forward, but He is not [there]; and backward, but I cannot see Him;

title: Job 23:9
text: on the left hand, where He works, but I cannot behold Him. He turns to the right, but I do not see [Him].

title: Job 23:10
text: But He knows the way that I take; [when] He has tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

title: Job 23:11
text: My foot has held fast in His steps; I have kept His way, and have not fallen away;

title: Job 23:12
text: nor have I gone back from the commandment of His lips; I treasured the words of His mouth more than my portion.

title: Job 23:13
text: But He [is] in one [mind], and who can turn Him? Yea, what His soul desires, He does [it].

title: Job 23:14
text: For He fulfilled my lot, and many [things] like these are with Him.

title: Job 23:15
text: Therefore I am troubled at His presence; when I look, I am afraid of Him.

title: Job 23:16
text: For God makes my heart soft, and the Almighty troubles me;

title: Job 23:17
text: because I was not cut off before the darkness; yea, He covered the darkness from my face.

title: Job 24:1
text: [Since] times are not hidden from the Almighty, why do those who know Him not see His days?

title: Job 24:2
text: They remove the landmarks; they seize flocks and feed them.

title: Job 24:3
text: They drive away the ass of the fatherless; they take the widow's ox for a pledge.

title: Job 24:4
text: They turn the needy out of the way; the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

title: Job 24:5
text: Behold, [like] wild asses in the desert, they go forth to their work, rising early for a prey. The wilderness [yields] food for them and for [their] children.

title: Job 24:6
text: They reap his fodder in the field; and they gather the grapes of the wicked.

title: Job 24:7
text: They lodge the naked without clothing, and [give] no covering in the cold.

title: Job 24:8
text: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of shelter.

title: Job 24:9
text: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge from the poor.

title: Job 24:10
text: They cause [him] to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaves from the hungry.

title: Job 24:11
text: They press out oil between their walls; they tread their winepresses, and still suffer thirst.

title: Job 24:12
text: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded cries for help; yet God does not charge foolishness.

title: Job 24:13
text: They are of those who rebel against the light; they know not His ways, nor stay in His paths.

title: Job 24:14
text: The murderer rising with the light kills the poor and needy, and in the night he is a thief.

title: Job 24:15
text: And the eye of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, No eye will see me; and he puts a covering on [his] face.

title: Job 24:16
text: In the dark they dig through houses [which] they had marked for themselves in the daytime; they do not know the light.

title: Job 24:17
text: For the morning [is] to them like the shadow of death; for they know the terrors of the shadow of death.

title: Job 24:18
text: He [is] swift on the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth; he does not behold the way of the vineyards.

title: Job 24:19
text: Drought and heat eat up the snow waters; [so does] the grave those who have sinned.

title: Job 24:20
text: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be remembered no more; and injustice shall be broken like a tree.

title: Job 24:21
text: [He] ill-treats the women who bear no [children]; and does no good to the widow.

title: Job 24:22
text: He also draws the mighty with his power; he rises up, and no one is sure of life.

title: Job 24:23
text: He gives safety to him, and he rests on [it]; yet His eyes [are] on their ways.

title: Job 24:24
text: They are lifted up for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are gathered in like all [others], and are cut off like the heads of the ears of grain.

title: Job 24:25
text: And if [it is] not [so], who will make me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?

title: Job 25:1
text: And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

title: Job 25:2
text: Rule and fear are with Him; [He] makes peace in His high places.

title: Job 25:3
text: Is there any number of His armies? And on whom does not His light arise?

title: Job 25:4
text: How then can man be justified with God? Or how can [one] who is born of a woman be clean?

title: Job 25:5
text: Look even to [the] moon, and it shines not; yea, the stars are not pure in His sight;

title: Job 25:6
text: how much less man [who is] a maggot, and the son of man, [who is] a worm?

title: Job 26:1
text: But Job answered and said,

title: Job 26:2
text: How have you helped [the] powerless, [or] saved [the] arm that has no strength?

title: Job 26:3
text: How have you advised [those] not wise, or fully declared wise plans?

title: Job 26:4
text: To whom have you spoken words? And whose spirit came from you?

title: Job 26:5
text: The departed spirits tremble under the waters, and those who dwell in them.

title: Job 26:6
text: Hell [is] naked before Him, and the Pit has no covering.

title: Job 26:7
text: He stretches out the north over the empty place, [and] He hung the earth on nothing.

title: Job 26:8
text: He binds up [the] waters in His thick clouds; and the cloud is not torn under them.

title: Job 26:9
text: He covers the face of [His] throne, spreading His cloud on it.

title: Job 26:10
text: He has described a circle on the surface of the waters to the boundary of light with darkness.

title: Job 26:11
text: The pillars of the heavens tremble and are astonished at His rebuke.

title: Job 26:12
text: He quiets the sea with His power, and by His understanding He shatters the proud.

title: Job 26:13
text: By His Spirit the heavens [were] beautiful; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.

title: Job 26:14
text: Lo, these [are] the edges of His ways; but what a whisper of a word we hear of Him! And the thunder of His power who can understand?

title: Job 27:1
text: And Job continued the lifting up of His speech, and said,

title: Job 27:2
text: [As] God lives, He has taken away my judgment; and the Almighty has made my soul bitter.

title: Job 27:3
text: As long as my breath [is] in me, and the spirit of God [is] in my nostrils,

title: Job 27:4
text: my lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

title: Job 27:5
text: Far be it from me that I should justify you; until I die I will not retract my integrity from me.

title: Job 27:6
text: I hold fast by my righteousness, and I will not let it go; my heart shall not shame me [any] of my days.

title: Job 27:7
text: Let my enemy be like the wicked, and he who rises up against me as the perverse.

title: Job 27:8
text: For what [is] the hope of the ungodly when He cuts off, when God takes away his soul?

title: Job 27:9
text: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

title: Job 27:10
text: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? Will he always call on God?

title: Job 27:11
text: I will teach you by the hand of God; that which [is] with the Almighty I will not hide.

title: Job 27:12
text: Behold, all you have seen [it] yourselves; why then do you become completely vain?

title: Job 27:13
text: This [is] the portion of a wicked man with God, and the inheritance of cruel men [which] they shall receive from the Almighty.

title: Job 27:14
text: If his sons are multiplied, [the] sword [is] for them; and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

title: Job 27:15
text: Those who remain of him shall be buried in death; and his widows shall not weep.

title: Job 27:16
text: Though he heaps up silver like the dust, and prepares clothing like the clay,

title: Job 27:17
text: he may prepare, but the just shall put [it] on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

title: Job 27:18
text: He builds his house like a moth, and like a booth [that] a watchman makes.

title: Job 27:19
text: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered. He opens his eyes, and he [is] not.

title: Job 27:20
text: Terrors overtake him like waters; a tempest steals him away in the night.

title: Job 27:21
text: The east wind lifts him up, and he is gone; for it whirls him out of his place.

title: Job 27:22
text: For it will hurl at him, and will not spare; he will surely flee out of its hand.

title: Job 27:23
text: He shall clap His hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

title: Job 28:1
text: Surely there is a mine for the silver, and a place [where] they refine gold.

title: Job 28:2
text: Iron is taken out of the earth, and bronze [is] melted [out of] the stone.

title: Job 28:3
text: He sets an end to darkness, and to every extremity He searches out the stones of darkness and the shadow of death.

title: Job 28:4
text: He opens a shaft far from the visitor; they are forgotten by [man's] foot; they hang far away from men, they swing to and fro.

title: Job 28:5
text: [As to] the earth, out of it comes bread; and underneath it is turned up like fire.

title: Job 28:6
text: Its stones [are] the place of sapphires; and it has dust of gold.

title: Job 28:7
text: [There is] a path which no bird knows, nor has the vulture's eye caught sight of it;

title: Job 28:8
text: the sons of pride have not walked on it, the lion has not passed by.

title: Job 28:9
text: He puts forth His hand on the flinty places; He overturns the mountains by the roots.

title: Job 28:10
text: He cuts out rivers among the rocks; and His eye sees every precious thing.

title: Job 28:11
text: He holds back the floods from overflowing; and the hidden thing, He brings to light.

title: Job 28:12
text: But where shall wisdom be found? And where [is] the place of understanding?

title: Job 28:13
text: Man does not know the price of it; nor is it found in the land of the living.

title: Job 28:14
text: The deep says, [It is] not in me; and the sea says, [It is] not in me.

title: Job 28:15
text: Pure gold cannot be given in its stead, and silver be weighed as its price.

title: Job 28:16
text: It cannot be weighed against the gold of Ophir, against precious onyx, or sapphire;

title: Job 28:17
text: gold and the crystal cannot equal it, nor can it be exchanged for a vessel of fine gold.

title: Job 28:18
text: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls; and the price of wisdom [is] above rubies.

title: Job 28:19
text: The topaz of Ethiopia cannot equal it; it cannot be weighed against pure gold.

title: Job 28:20
text: From where then does wisdom come, and where [is] the place of understanding?

title: Job 28:21
text: Yea, it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and hidden from the birds of the heavens.

title: Job 28:22
text: The place of ruin and death say, We have heard the fame of it with our ears.

title: Job 28:23
text: God understands the way of it, and He knows its place.

title: Job 28:24
text: For He looks to the end of the earth, [and] sees under all the heavens;

title: Job 28:25
text: making a weight for the winds, and measuring out the waters by measure.

title: Job 28:26
text: When He made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning to thunder;

title: Job 28:27
text: then He saw it, and declared it; He prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

title: Job 28:28
text: And to man He said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that [is] wisdom! And to depart from evil [is] understanding!

title: Job 29:1
text: And Job continued the lifting up of his speech, and said,

title: Job 29:2
text: Oh that I were as [in] months past, as [in] the days when God watched over me;

title: Job 29:3
text: when His lamp shone on my head; I walked [through] darkness by His light;

title: Job 29:4
text: as I was in the days of my harvest, when the secret of God [was] on my tent;

title: Job 29:5
text: When the Almighty [was] yet with me, [and] my children were around me;

title: Job 29:6
text: when I washed my steps with curds, and the rock poured out rivers of oil for me;

title: Job 29:7
text: when I went out to the gate by the city; [when] I prepared my seat in the street!

title: Job 29:8
text: The young men saw me and hid themselves; and the aged arose [and] stood up.

title: Job 29:9
text: The rulers held back from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

title: Job 29:10
text: The noble's voice was subdued, and their tongue clung to the roof of their mouth.

title: Job 29:11
text: For the ear heard and blessed me. And the eye saw me and witnessed to me.

title: Job 29:12
text: For I delivered the poor who cried for help, and the fatherless who [had] none to help him.

title: Job 29:13
text: The blessing of the perishing came on me; and I caused the widow's heart to sing.

title: Job 29:14
text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; my judgment [was] like a robe and a diadem.

title: Job 29:15
text: I was eyes to the blind and feet to the lame.

title: Job 29:16
text: I [was] a father to the poor; and the cause which I did not know, I searched out.

title: Job 29:17
text: I broke the fangs of the wicked, and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

title: Job 29:18
text: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply [my] days like the sand.

title: Job 29:19
text: My root [was] open to the waters, and the dew lay all night on my branch.

title: Job 29:20
text: My glory [was] fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

title: Job 29:21
text: They listened to me, and waited, and kept silent at my counsel.

title: Job 29:22
text: After my words they did not go on; and my speech dropped on them.

title: Job 29:23
text: And they waited for me like the rain; and they opened their mouth wide [as] for the latter rain.

title: Job 29:24
text: I smiled kindly on them [when] they did not believe; and they did not make the light of my face fall.

title: Job 29:25
text: I chose out their way, and sat as chief; and I lived like a king in the army, as one [who] comforts the mourners.

title: Job 30:1
text: But now those younger laugh at me, whose fathers I would have refused to set with the dogs of my flock.

title: Job 30:2
text: Also, what [profit] for me [was] the strength of their hands, [for] or full vigor had perished from them?

title: Job 30:3
text: They are dried up with want and famine; they who gnaw the dry ground, [which was] before waste and ruin,

title: Job 30:4
text: [those] plucking mallows by the bushes, and broom roots [for] their food.

title: Job 30:5
text: They are driven forth from the midst; they cried against them as a thief.

title: Job 30:6
text: [They] dwell in the chasms of the valleys, [in] holes of the earth and [in] rocks.

title: Job 30:7
text: They bray among the bushes; they huddle together under the nettles;

title: Job 30:8
text: sons of fools, yea, sons without a name; they have been whipped out of the land.

title: Job 30:9
text: And now I am their song; yea, I am their byword.

title: Job 30:10
text: They despise me, and they flee far from me; they do not spare spit from my face.

title: Job 30:11
text: Because He has loosed His bowstring and afflicted me, they have also thrown off the bridle before me.

title: Job 30:12
text: On [my] right a brood rises; they push away my feet and raise up against me the ways of their ruin.

title: Job 30:13
text: They have broken down my path, they gain by my trouble; they have no helper.

title: Job 30:14
text: As [through] a wide break they came [on]; they roll under a ruin.

title: Job 30:15
text: Terrors have turned on me; they pursue my soul like the wind; and my good passes away like a cloud.

title: Job 30:16
text: And now my soul is poured out within me; the days of affliction have taken hold on me.

title: Job 30:17
text: My bones are pierced in me in the night; and my gnawings never lie down.

title: Job 30:18
text: By the great force [of my disease] my clothing is exposed; it binds me about like the mouth of my coat.

title: Job 30:19
text: [He has] cast me into the mire, and I have become like dust and ashes.

title: Job 30:20
text: I cried to You, and You did not hear me; I stood up, and You did not consider me.

title: Job 30:21
text: You changed to [be] cruel to me; with Your mighty hand You assault me.

title: Job 30:22
text: You lift me up to the wind; You cause me to ride [on it]; and You melt me in a storm.

title: Job 30:23
text: For I know [that] You will bring me [to] death, and [to] the house appointed for all living.

title: Job 30:24
text: Surely He will not stretch out [His] hand to the ruin-heap, though they cry in their misfortune.

title: Job 30:25
text: Did I not weep for him whose day was hard; and my soul grieved for the poor?

title: Job 30:26
text: When I looked for good, then evil came; and when I waited for light, then darkness came.

title: Job 30:27
text: My bowels boiled, and did not rest; the days of trouble confront me.

title: Job 30:28
text: I go in mourning with no sun; I stood up [and] I cried out in the congregation.

title: Job 30:29
text: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to daughters of the ostrich.

title: Job 30:30
text: My skin is black on me, and my bones are burned with heat.

title: Job 30:31
text: And my lyre has [turned] to mourning, and my flute to the sound of weeping.

title: Job 31:1
text: I made a covenant with my eyes; how then could I look upon a virgin?

title: Job 31:2
text: For what [is] the portion from God above? And [what is] the inheritance from the Almighty on high?

title: Job 31:3
text: [Is] not disaster to the perverse, and calamity to the workers of iniquity?

title: Job 31:4
text: Does He not see my ways, and count all my steps?

title: Job 31:5
text: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot has hurried to deceit,

title: Job 31:6
text: let me be weighed in an even balance so that God may know my uprightness.

title: Job 31:7
text: If my step has turned out of the way, or my heart has walked after my eyes, and if any blot has held fast to my hands;

title: Job 31:8
text: [then] let me sow, and let another eat; and let my harvests be rooted out.

title: Job 31:9
text: If my heart has been enticed by a woman, or I have laid wait at my neighbor's door,

title: Job 31:10
text: [then] let my wife grind to another, and let others bow down on her.

title: Job 31:11
text: For that [would be] an evil purpose; yea, it [would be] an iniquity [to be punished by] the judges.

title: Job 31:12
text: For it [is] a fire that devours to the Place of Ruin, and it would root out all my gain.

title: Job 31:13
text: If I despised the cause of my man servant or of my slave-girl, when they argued with me;

title: Job 31:14
text: what then shall I do when God rises up? And when He calls me to account, what shall I answer Him?

title: Job 31:15
text: Did not He who made me in the womb make him? And did not One shape us in the womb?

title: Job 31:16
text: If I have withheld the poor from [their] desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

title: Job 31:17
text: or have eaten my bit alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it,

title: Job 31:18
text: for from my youth he grew up with me, as [with] a father, and from my mother's womb I guided her;

title: Job 31:19
text: if I have seen any perish for lack of clothing, or there was no covering for the needy;

title: Job 31:20
text: if his loins have not blessed me, and he warmed himself with the fleece of my flock;

title: Job 31:21
text: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless when I watched over my help in the gate;

title: Job 31:22
text: [then] let my arm fall from the shoulder blade, and let my arm be broken from the elbow.

title: Job 31:23
text: For trouble [from] God [is] a terror to me, and I could not do [anything] because of His highness.

title: Job 31:24
text: If I have made gold my hope, or have called fine gold my trust;

title: Job 31:25
text: if I rejoiced because my wealth [was] great, and because my hand had gotten much;

title: Job 31:26
text: if I looked to the light when it shone, or the moon walking in brightness,

title: Job 31:27
text: and my heart has been secretly enticed, or my mouth has kissed my hand;

title: Job 31:28
text: this also [would be] an iniquity [for] the judges; for I would have denied the God above.

title: Job 31:29
text: If I rejoiced at the ruin of my hater, and I was excited when evil found him;

title: Job 31:30
text: also I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse;

title: Job 31:31
text: if the men of my camp did not say, Who can find one who has not been satisfied with his meat?

title: Job 31:32
text: The stranger did not sleep in the street, [for] I opened my doors to the traveler.

title: Job 31:33
text: If I covered my transgressions like Adam, by hiding my iniquity in my bosom,

title: Job 31:34
text: then let me tremble before a great multitude, and be terrified by the scorn of families; [and] I will be silent [and] not go out the door.

title: Job 31:35
text: Oh that I had one to hear me! Behold my mark. Let the Almighty answer me, and my Accuser write an indictment.

title: Job 31:36
text: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, [and] bind it [like] crowns to me.

title: Job 31:37
text: I would declare to Him the number of my steps; like a prince I would go near Him.

title: Job 31:38
text: If my lands cry against me, or its furrows weep together;

title: Job 31:39
text: if I have eaten its strength without silver, or have caused its owner to expire,

title: Job 31:40
text: let thorns come forth instead of wheat, and weeds instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

title: Job 32:1
text: And these three men ceased from answering Job, because he [was] righteous in his own eyes.

title: Job 32:2
text: And burned the anger of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram. His wrath burned against Job, because he had justified himself rather than God.

title: Job 32:3
text: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer and had condemned Job.

title: Job 32:4
text: And Elihu had waited beside Job with words, because they [were] older than he in days.

title: Job 32:5
text: When Elihu saw that there [was] no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.

title: Job 32:6
text: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I [am] young, and you [are] very old; therefore I was afraid, and dared not show you my opinion.

title: Job 32:7
text: I said, Days should speak, and the multitude of years should teach wisdom.

title: Job 32:8
text: But a spirit [is] in man giving them perception, even the breath of the Almighty.

title: Job 32:9
text: [It is] not the great that are wise, nor the aged who understand judgment.

title: Job 32:10
text: Therefore I say, Listen to me. I also will declare my opinion.

title: Job 32:11
text: Behold, I waited for your words; I listened to your reasons, while you searched out what to say.

title: Job 32:12
text: Yes, I listened to you, and, behold, not one of you proved Job wrong [nor] answered his words,

title: Job 32:13
text: that you do not say, We have found out wisdom. God has pushed him down, not man.

title: Job 32:14
text: And he has not directed his words against me; and I will not answer him with your words.

title: Job 32:15
text: They are broken; they answer no more; words have left them.

title: Job 32:16
text: Shall I wait because you do not speak, because they stand still, answering no more?

title: Job 32:17
text: I also will answer my part; I also will declare my wisdom.

title: Job 32:18
text: For I am full of words; the spirit within me presses on me.

title: Job 32:19
text: Behold, my breast [is] as wine which has no vent; it bursts like new wineskins.

title: Job 32:20
text: I will speak so that I may be refreshed; I will open my lips and answer.

title: Job 32:21
text: I will not now lift up the face of a man, nor eulogize [any] man,

title: Job 32:22
text: For I do not know how to eulogize; else after a little my Maker would take me away.

title: Job 33:1
text: However, Job, please hear my speeches, and listen to all my words.

title: Job 33:2
text: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue has spoken in my mouth,

title: Job 33:3
text: my words [shall be] from my upright heart, and my lips will clearly speak knowledge.

title: Job 33:4
text: The Spirit of God made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

title: Job 33:5
text: If you can, answer me; set yourself in order before me, stand up.

title: Job 33:6
text: Behold, I [am] toward God even as you [are]; I also am formed out of the clay.

title: Job 33:7
text: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, and my burden shall not be heavy on you.

title: Job 33:8
text: Surely you have spoken in my ears, and I have heard the sound of [your] words.

title: Job 33:9
text: [You said], I [am] pure, without transgression; I [am] innocent, and no iniquity [is] in me;

title: Job 33:10
text: behold, He finds reasons to be against me, He counts me for His enemy;

title: Job 33:11
text: He puts my feet in the stocks; He marks all my paths.

title: Job 33:12
text: Behold, [in] this you are not right; I will answer you, for God is greater than man.

title: Job 33:13
text: Why do you fight against Him? For He does not give account for [any] of His matters.

title: Job 33:14
text: For God speaks once, yea, twice, [but] not one takes notice.

title: Job 33:15
text: In a dream, a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men; while [they] slumber on the bed;

title: Job 33:16
text: then He opens the ear of men and seals their teaching,

title: Job 33:17
text: so that He may turn man [from his] act, that He might hide pride from man.

title: Job 33:18
text: He keeps back his soul from the Pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

title: Job 33:19
text: He is also chastened with pain on his bed, and enduring strife [in] his bones;

title: Job 33:20
text: so that his life is sick of bread, and his soul desirable food.

title: Job 33:21
text: His flesh wastes away, not seen; and his bones laid bare; they were not seen.

title: Job 33:22
text: Yea, his soul draws near to the Pit, and his life to the dealers of death.

title: Job 33:23
text: If there is a messenger for him, a mediator, one among a thousand, to declare for man his uprightness,

title: Job 33:24
text: then He is gracious to him and says, Deliver him from going down to the Pit; for I have found a ransom.

title: Job 33:25
text: His flesh shall be fresher than in vigor; he shall return to the days of his youth;

title: Job 33:26
text: he shall pray to God, and He will be gracious to Him; and he shall see His face with joy, for He will restore to man his righteousness.

title: Job 33:27
text: He will observe to men, and say, I have sinned and perverted righteousness; and it was not equally repaid to me,

title: Job 33:28
text: He has redeemed my soul from passing over into the Pit, and my life shall see the light.

title: Job 33:29
text: Lo, all these [things] God does two or three times with a man,

title: Job 33:30
text: to bring back his soul from the Pit, to be lighted with the light of the living.

title: Job 33:31
text: Hear this, Job, listen to me; be silent and I will speak.

title: Job 33:32
text: If you have anything to say, answer me; speak, for I desire to justify you.

title: Job 33:33
text: If not, listen to me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom.

title: Job 34:1
text: And Elihu answered and said,

title: Job 34:2
text: Hear my words, wise men; and give ear to me, you who have knowledge;

title: Job 34:3
text: For the ear tries words, [as] the palate tastes food.

title: Job 34:4
text: Let us choose for ourselves what is right; let us know among ourselves what [is] good.

title: Job 34:5
text: For Job has said, I am righteous; and God has taken away my right;

title: Job 34:6
text: should I lie against my right? My wound cannot be cured; [I am] without rebellion.

title: Job 34:7
text: What man [is] like Job, [who] drinks up scorning like water;

title: Job 34:8
text: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

title: Job 34:9
text: For he has said, It profits a man nothing when he is accepted with God.

title: Job 34:10
text: Therefore listen to me, O man of heart; far be it from God to commit iniquity; and from the Almighty, to do wrong.

title: Job 34:11
text: For He repays man's work, and causes him to find according to [his] ways.

title: Job 34:12
text: Yes, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

title: Job 34:13
text: Who has given the earth as a deposit with Him? Or who has set the whole world in order?

title: Job 34:14
text: If He sets His heart on man, [if] He gathers to Himself his spirit and his breath,

title: Job 34:15
text: all flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again to dust.

title: Job 34:16
text: If now [you have] understanding, hear this; listen to the sound of my words.

title: Job 34:17
text: Shall one who hates right govern? And will you condemn Him who is just and mighty?

title: Job 34:18
text: Who says to a king, O worthless one; and to nobles, O evil one?

title: Job 34:19
text: [How much less to Him who] does not lift up the face of rulers, nor regard the rich before the poor? For all of them [are] the work of His hands.

title: Job 34:20
text: In a moment they die, and a people are shaken at midnight and pass away; and the mighty shall be taken away without a hand.

title: Job 34:21
text: For His eyes [are] on the ways of man, and He sees all his steps.

title: Job 34:22
text: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death to hide there the workers of iniquity.

title: Job 34:23
text: For He does not still impose on man to go before God in judgment.

title: Job 34:24
text: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their place.

title: Job 34:25
text: Therefore He knows their works, and He overturns in the night, so that they are destroyed.

title: Job 34:26
text: He strikes them for evil deeds in the place of the watchers,

title: Job 34:27
text: because thus they turned from following Him, and they did not consider all His ways;

title: Job 34:28
text: [so as] to cause the cry of the poor to come to Him, for He hears the cry of the afflicted.

title: Job 34:29
text: And He gives quietness, who then can condemn? And when He hides [His] face, who can behold Him? And [it may be] against a nation and a man together;

title: Job 34:30
text: from the reigning of ungodly men, from [being] snares for the people.

title: Job 34:31
text: For has any said to God, I have taken away; I will not pervert?

title: Job 34:32
text: Besides what I see, You teach me; if I have done iniquity, I will do it no more.

title: Job 34:33
text: Must He repay because you rejected [it]? For you must choose, and not I; therefore speak what you know.

title: Job 34:34
text: Men of understanding will say to me, and a wise man who hears me [will say],

title: Job 34:35
text: Job has spoken without knowledge, and his words [were] without wisdom.

title: Job 34:36
text: Would that Job may be tried to the end because [his] answers [are] like men of iniquity.

title: Job 34:37
text: For he adds rebellion to his sins; he claps [his] hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.

title: Job 35:1
text: And Elihu answered and said,

title: Job 35:2
text: Do you think this to [be] right, you [that] say, I am more just than God?

title: Job 35:3
text: For you say, What will it benefit you? And, What good shall I have more than [if] I had sinned?

title: Job 35:4
text: I will answer your words, and your friends with you.

title: Job 35:5
text: Look to the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds; they are higher than you.

title: Job 35:6
text: If you sin, what do you do against Him? Or [if] your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to Him?

title: Job 35:7
text: If you are righteous, what do you give Him? Or what does He receive from your hand?

title: Job 35:8
text: Your wickedness [may hurt] a man like yourself; and your righteousness [may profit] the son of man.

title: Job 35:9
text: From the host of tyrannies they cry out; they cry out because of the arm of the multitude.

title: Job 35:10
text: But none says, Where [is] God my Maker, who gives songs in the night;

title: Job 35:11
text: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the heavens?

title: Job 35:12
text: There they cry, but He gives no answer, because of the pride of evildoers.

title: Job 35:13
text: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty look on it.

title: Job 35:14
text: How [much less] when you say you do not see Him! Judgment [is] before Him; you are waiting for Him.

title: Job 35:15
text: And now, because His anger has not visited, and He does not recognize stupidity,

title: Job 35:16
text: even Job opens his mouth in vanity; he multiplies words without knowledge.

title: Job 36:1
text: Elihu went on and said,

title: Job 36:2
text: Wait for me a little, and I will show you that [there are] yet words for God.

title: Job 36:3
text: I will bring my knowledge from afar, and I will credit righteousness to my Maker.

title: Job 36:4
text: For truly my words [are] not false; He who is perfect in knowledge [is] with you.

title: Job 36:5
text: Behold, God [is] mighty, and does not despise; [He is] mighty in strength of heart.

title: Job 36:6
text: He will not keep alive one who is wicked, but gives right to the afflicted.

title: Job 36:7
text: He withdraws not His eyes from the righteous, but [they are] like kings on the throne; yes, [He] causes them to sit forever, and they are very high.

title: Job 36:8
text: And if they [are] bound in chains, and are held in cords of affliction,

title: Job 36:9
text: then He shows them their work, and their sins, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

title: Job 36:10
text: He also opens their ears to teaching, and commands that they return from iniquity.

title: Job 36:11
text: If they obey and serve Him, they shall spend their days in blessedness, and their years in pleasures.

title: Job 36:12
text: But if they do not obey, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

title: Job 36:13
text: But the ungodly in heart heap up wrath; they cry not when He binds them.

title: Job 36:14
text: Their soul dies in youth, and their life [ends] among the sodomites.

title: Job 36:15
text: He delivers the poor in his affliction, and opens their ears by oppression.

title: Job 36:16
text: And He also would have lured you from the mouth of distress [to] a wide place not cramped; and the setting of your table [would be] full of fatness.

title: Job 36:17
text: But you have fulfilled the judgment of the wicked; judgment and justice take hold;

title: Job 36:18
text: For [beware] wrath, that He not lure you with [His] scorn; then a great ransom cannot turn you aside.

title: Job 36:19
text: [If] your cry for help is set in order, then [it will] not [be]. in distress, but with all the forces of strength.

title: Job 36:20
text: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

title: Job 36:21
text: Beware, do not turn to iniquity; for this you have chosen rather than affliction.

title: Job 36:22
text: Behold, God is exalted in His power; who teaches like Him?

title: Job 36:23
text: Who has appointed Him His way; or who can say, You have done wrong?

title: Job 36:24
text: Remember that you magnify His work of which men have sung;

title: Job 36:25
text: every man has seen it; man may see [it] afar off.

title: Job 36:26
text: Behold, God [is] great, and we do not know; the number of His years cannot be searched out.

title: Job 36:27
text: For He draws up the drops of water; they distill rain into mist,

title: Job 36:28
text: which the clouds pour down [and] drop on man plentifully.

title: Job 36:29
text: Also can [any] understand the spreading of the clouds, or the crashing of His canopy?

title: Job 36:30
text: Behold, He spreads His light on it, and He covers the bottom of the sea.

title: Job 36:31
text: For by them He judges the people; He gives plenty of food.

title: Job 36:32
text: He covers His hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark;

title: Job 36:33
text: its thunder declares concerning Him, and the cattle, concerning what is coming.

title: Job 37:1
text: My heart trembles at this also, and it leaps out of its place.

title: Job 37:2
text: Listen carefully to the thunder of His voice, and the rumbling that comes out of His mouth.

title: Job 37:3
text: He loosens it under the whole heavens, and His lightning to the ends of the earth.

title: Job 37:4
text: After it a voice roars; He thunders with the voice of His majesty, and He will not hold them when His voice is heard.

title: Job 37:5
text: God thunders marvelously with His voice; He does great things, and we do not understand.

title: Job 37:6
text: For He says to the snow, Fall [on] the earth; also to the shower of rain, and to the shower of [heavy] rains in its strength.

title: Job 37:7
text: He seals up the hand of every man, so that all men may know His work.

title: Job 37:8
text: Then the beast goes into its lair, and it remains in its dens.

title: Job 37:9
text: Out of the storeroom comes the tempest; and cold from scattering winds.

title: Job 37:10
text: By the breath of God ice is given; and the expanse of waters is frozen tight.

title: Job 37:11
text: Also He loads the clouds with moisture; He scatters the lightning cloud,

title: Job 37:12
text: and it is turned around by His guidance, so that they may do whatever He commands them on the face of the world in the earth.

title: Job 37:13
text: Whether as a whip, or for His land, or for mercy, He finds it.

title: Job 37:14
text: Listen to this, Job; stand still, and consider the wonderful works of God.

title: Job 37:15
text: Do you know when God placed them, and caused the lightning of His cloud to shine?

title: Job 37:16
text: Do you know the balancing of the clouds, the wonderful works of Him who is perfect in knowledge?

title: Job 37:17
text: You whose clothes warm when He quiets the earth from the south wind?

title: Job 37:18
text: Have you beat out the expanse with Him, hard like a cast mirror?

title: Job 37:19
text: Teach us what we shall say to Him; [for] because of darkness we cannot arrange our case.

title: Job 37:20
text: Shall it be told Him that I would speak? If a man speaks, surely he shall be swallowed up.

title: Job 37:21
text: And now men cannot look upon the light; it [is] in the clouds; but the wind passes and clears them.

title: Job 37:22
text: Golden [splendor] comes out of the north; God [is] awesome in His majesty.

title: Job 37:23
text: The Almighty, whom we cannot find out, [is] exalted in power; and to judgment and overflowing righteousness He does no violence.

title: Job 37:24
text: Therefore, men fear Him; He does not respect any [who are] wise in heart.

title: Job 38:1
text: And the LORD answered Job out of the tempest, and said,

title: Job 38:2
text: Who [is] this that darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

title: Job 38:3
text: Now gird up your loins like a man; for I will ask of you, and you teach Me.

title: Job 38:4
text: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell if you have understanding!

title: Job 38:5
text: Who has set its measurements, for you know? Or who has stretched the line on it?

title: Job 38:6
text: On what [are] its bases sunk, or who cast its cornerstone,

title: Job 38:7
text: when the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

title: Job 38:8
text: Or [who] shut up the sea with doors, when it broke forth as it came from the womb?

title: Job 38:9
text: When I made the clouds its robe, and darkness its navel-band,

title: Job 38:10
text: and set My limit on it, and set bars and doors,

title: Job 38:11
text: and I said, You shall come to here, but no further; and here your proud waves shall stop.

title: Job 38:12
text: Have you commanded the morning from your days, [and] caused the dawn to know its place,

title: Job 38:13
text: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth; that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

title: Job 38:14
text: It is turned like clay [under] a seal; and they stand forth like a garment.

title: Job 38:15
text: And from the wicked their light is withheld, and the high arm shall be broken.

title: Job 38:16
text: Have you gone to the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in search of the depths?

title: Job 38:17
text: Have the gates of death been opened to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

title: Job 38:18
text: Have you understood the breadth of the earth? Tell, if you know it all!

title: Job 38:19
text: Where [is] the way [where] light dwells? And where [is] the place of darkness,

title: Job 38:20
text: that you should take it to its boundary, and that you should know the paths [to] its house?

title: Job 38:21
text: You know, because you were born then. And the number of your days [is] great?

title: Job 38:22
text: Have you entered into the storehouses of the snow? Or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

title: Job 38:23
text: which I have kept for the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

title: Job 38:24
text: How [is] it, way the light distributed, [and how does] the east wind spread itself on the earth?

title: Job 38:25
text: Who has cut a channel for the flood, or a way for the thunderclaps;

title: Job 38:26
text: to cause rain to fall on the earth [where] no man [is], a wilderness and no man in it;

title: Job 38:27
text: to satisfy the desolate and waste ground, and to cause the source of grass to spring forth?

title: Job 38:28
text: Has the rain a father? Or who has brought forth the drops of dew?

title: Job 38:29
text: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the frost of the heavens, who fathered it?

title: Job 38:30
text: The waters are hidden like stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

title: Job 38:31
text: Can you bind the bands of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

title: Job 38:32
text: Can you bring the constellations in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with its sons?

title: Job 38:33
text: Do you know the ordinances of the heavens? Can you set up their rulership on the earth?

title: Job 38:34
text: Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, so that floods of waters may cover you?

title: Job 38:35
text: Can you send lightnings, that they may go, and say to you, Here we [are]?

title: Job 38:36
text: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

title: Job 38:37
text: Who can number the clouds by wisdom; or who can empty out the jars of the heavens,

title: Job 38:38
text: when the dust is melted [into] hardness, and the clods cling fast together?

title: Job 38:39
text: Will you hunt the prey for the lion, or fill the appetite of the young lions,

title: Job 38:40
text: when they crouch in dens, [and] sit in the cover of their hiding place?

title: Job 38:41
text: Who provides food for the raven, when its young ones cry to God [and] wander about without food?

title: Job 39:1
text: Do you know the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? Can you observe the calving of deer?

title: Job 39:2
text: Can you number the months [that] they fulfill? Or do you know the time for their bearing,

title: Job 39:3
text: [when] they bow down [and] bring forth; they send out their pangs.

title: Job 39:4
text: Their young ones are strong, they multiply with grain; they go forth and do not return to them again.

title: Job 39:5
text: Who has sent out the wild ass free? Or who has loosed the bands of the wild ass,

title: Job 39:6
text: to whom I have assigned the wilderness [for] its home, and the salt land [for] its dwellings?

title: Job 39:7
text: He scorns the turmoil of the city; he does not hear the driver's shouts.

title: Job 39:8
text: He seeks out mountains [for] his pasture, and he searches after every green thing.

title: Job 39:9
text: Will the wild ox be willing to serve you, or spend the night by your feed-trough?

title: Job 39:10
text: Can you tie the wild ox [in] the furrow [with] his rope? Or will he harrow the valleys for you?

title: Job 39:11
text: Will you trust him because his strength [is] great? Or will you leave your labor to him?

title: Job 39:12
text: Will you trust him, that he will return your seed and gather [it to] your grain-floor?

title: Job 39:13
text: The wing of the ostrich beats joyously; though not [like] the stork's pinions [for] flight.

title: Job 39:14
text: For she leaves her eggs to the earth, and lets them warm in the dust,

title: Job 39:15
text: and forgets that a foot may crush them, or that the beast of the field may break them.

title: Job 39:16
text: She treats her young roughly, as if not hers; for her labor [is] vanity without fear;

title: Job 39:17
text: because God has caused her to forget wisdom, and He has not given her a share in understanding.

title: Job 39:18
text: At the time she lifts herself up on high, she scorns the horse and its rider.

title: Job 39:19
text: Have you given the horse strength? Have you clothed his neck [with] a mane?

title: Job 39:20
text: Can you make him leap like a locust? The glory of his snorting [is] terrifying.

title: Job 39:21
text: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in [his] strength; he goes on to meet the weapons.

title: Job 39:22
text: He mocks at fear, and is not terrified; and he does not turn back from the sword.

title: Job 39:23
text: The quiver rattles against him, the glittering spear and the shield.

title: Job 39:24
text: He swallows the ground with quivering and rage; and he does not stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

title: Job 39:25
text: When the trumpet [sounds], he says, Aha! And he smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

title: Job 39:26
text: Does the hawk soar by your understanding? Will he spread his wings toward the south?

title: Job 39:27
text: Does the eagle mount up at your command and make his nest on high?

title: Job 39:28
text: He lives and stays [on the] rock, on the crag of the rock and [the] strong place.

title: Job 39:29
text: From there he seeks food, and his eyes see afar off.

title: Job 39:30
text: And his young brood also sucks up blood; and where the dead [are], there he [is].

title: Job 40:1
text: And the LORD answered Job and said,

title: Job 40:2
text: Shall a reprover contend with the Almighty? He who reproves God, let him answer it.

title: Job 40:3
text: And Job answered the LORD and said,

title: Job 40:4
text: Behold, I am vile! What shall I answer You? I will lay my hand on my mouth.

title: Job 40:5
text: Once I have spoken; but I will not answer; yea, twice, but I will go no further.

title: Job 40:6
text: And the LORD answered Job out of the tempest, and said,

title: Job 40:7
text: Now gird up your loins like a man. I will question you, and you teach Me.

title: Job 40:8
text: Will you also set aside My judgment? Will you condemn Me so that you may be justified?

title: Job 40:9
text: And [have] you an arm like God? Or can you thunder with a voice like His?

title: Job 40:10
text: Adorn yourself now with majesty and grandeur, and with glory and honor clothe yourself.

title: Job 40:11
text: Pour forth the rage of your wrath; and behold everyone who is proud, and abase him.

title: Job 40:12
text: Look on everyone [who is] proud, [and] bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.

title: Job 40:13
text: Hide them in the dust together; [and] bind their faces in darkness.

title: Job 40:14
text: Then I also will confess to you that your own right [hand] can save you.

title: Job 40:15
text: Now behold behemoth, which I made along with you; he eats grass like an ox;

title: Job 40:16
text: see, now, his strength [is] in his loins, and his force [is] in the muscles of his belly.

title: Job 40:17
text: He hangs his tail like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are knit together.

title: Job 40:18
text: His bones [are] like tubes of bronze; his bones [are] like bars of iron.

title: Job 40:19
text: He [is] the first of the ways of God; his Maker brings near his sword.

title: Job 40:20
text: For the mountains yield food for him, and all the beasts of the field play there.

title: Job 40:21
text: He lies under the lotus, in the hiding place of the reed and the marsh.

title: Job 40:22
text: The lotus trees cover him [with] their shadow; the willows of the brook surround him.

title: Job 40:23
text: Behold, though a flood presses, he does not run away; he feels safe even if Jordan swells up to his mouth.

title: Job 40:24
text: Shall [any] take him before [his] eyes, or pierce through [his] nose with cords?

title: Job 41:1
text: Can you draw out the leviathan with a hook, or hold down his tongue with a cord?

title: Job 41:2
text: Can you put a reed rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw with a thorn?

title: Job 41:3
text: Will he multiply pleas for help to you? Will he speak soft words to you?

title: Job 41:4
text: Will he make a covenant with you? Will you take him for a servant for ever?

title: Job 41:5
text: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your maidens?

title: Job 41:6
text: Shall [your] companions bargain over him? Shall they divide him among the merchants?

title: Job 41:7
text: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fishing spears?

title: Job 41:8
text: Lay your hand on him, think of the battle; you will never do it again.

title: Job 41:9
text: Behold, his hope has been made false; will not one be cast down at the sight of him?

title: Job 41:10
text: None [is so] fierce as to dare to stir him up; who then [is] able to stand before Me?

title: Job 41:11
text: Who has gone before Me that I should repay? All that [is] the heavens is Mine.

title: Job 41:12
text: I will not keep silent [concerning] his limbs, or [his] mighty strength, or the grace of his frame.

title: Job 41:13
text: Who can take off the surface of his skin; who can come [to him] with his double bridle?

title: Job 41:14
text: Who can open the doors to his face? Terror [is] round about his teeth.

title: Job 41:15
text: The rows of shields [are] his pride, shut up with a close seal;

title: Job 41:16
text: one is so near to another that no air can come between them;

title: Job 41:17
text: they are joined one to another, they clasp each other so that they can not be separated.

title: Job 41:18
text: His sneezings flash forth light, and his eyes [are] like the eyelids of the dawn.

title: Job 41:19
text: Out of his mouth go burning torches, sparks of fire leap out.

title: Job 41:20
text: Out of his nostrils goes smoke, as [out] of a boiling pot [fired] by reeds.

title: Job 41:21
text: His breath kindles coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.

title: Job 41:22
text: In his neck remains strength, and terror dances before him.

title: Job 41:23
text: The folds of his flesh are joined together, cast firm on him; he cannot be moved.

title: Job 41:24
text: His heart is cast hard as a stone, even cast hard as a piece of a riding millstone.

title: Job 41:25
text: The mighty are afraid from his rising; they are beside themselves from the crashing.

title: Job 41:26
text: The sword overtakes him, [but] will not hold firm. The spear, the dart, and the javelin [also].

title: Job 41:27
text: He counts iron as straw, bronze as rotten wood.

title: Job 41:28
text: An arrow cannot make him flee; slingstones are turned by him into stubble.

title: Job 41:29
text: Darts are counted as straw; he laughs at the shaking of a javelin.

title: Job 41:30
text: Points of potsherds [are] under him; he spreads sharp pointed [marks] on the mire.

title: Job 41:31
text: He makes the deep boil like a pot; he makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

title: Job 41:32
text: He makes a path to shine after him; one would think the deep [to be] gray-headed.

title: Job 41:33
text: On earth there is nothing like him, one made without fear.

title: Job 41:34
text: He beholds all high [things]; he [is] a king over all the sons of pride.

title: Job 42:1
text: And Job answered the LORD and said,

title: Job 42:2
text: I know that You can do all, and not [any] purpose is withheld from You.

title: Job 42:3
text: Who [is] he who hides counsel without knowledge? Therefore I have spoken what I did not understand; [things] too wonderful for me; yea, I did not know.

title: Job 42:4
text: Hear, I beseech You, and I will speak; I will ask You, and You will cause me to know.

title: Job 42:5
text: I have heard of You by the hearing of the ear; but now my eye has seen You.

title: Job 42:6
text: Therefore I despise [myself], and repent in dust and ashes.

title: Job 42:7
text: And it happened after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against you and your two friends. For you have not spoken of Me what is right, as My servant Job [has].

title: Job 42:8
text: And now take to yourselves seven young bulls and seven rams, and go to My servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering. And My servant Job will pray for you. Surely I will lift up his face so as not to do with you [according to your] foolishness, in that you have not spoken of Me what is right, like My servant Job.

title: Job 42:9
text: And Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, [and] Zophar the Naamathite, went and did as the LORD commanded them. The LORD also accepted the face of Job.

title: Job 42:10
text: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job when he prayed for his friends. Also the LORD added to Job all that [had been his], to double.

title: Job 42:11
text: And came to him all his brothers, and all his sisters, and all those who had known him before. And they ate bread with him in his house, and consoled him and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought on him. Each one also gave him a piece of money, and each one a ring of gold.

title: Job 42:12
text: And the LORD blessed the latter [days] of Job more than the beginning. For he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

title: Job 42:13
text: He also had seven sons and three daughters.

title: Job 42:14
text: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.

title: Job 42:15
text: And in all the land there [were] not found women as beautiful as the daughters of Job. And their father gave them inheritance among their brothers.

title: Job 42:16
text: After this Job lived a hundred and forty years, and he saw his sons, and his sons' sons, four generations.

title: Job 42:17
text: And Job died, [being] old and full of days.

title: Psalms 1:1
text: Blessed [is] the man who has not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, and has not stood in the way of sinners, and has not sat in the seat of the scornful.

title: Psalms 1:2
text: But his delight [is] only in the law of the LORD; and in His law he meditates day and night.

title: Psalms 1:3
text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivulets of water that brings forth its fruit in its seasons, and its leaf shall not wither, and all which he does shall be blessed.

title: Psalms 1:4
text: The wicked [are] not so, but [are] like chaff which the wind drives away.

title: Psalms 1:5
text: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

title: Psalms 1:6
text: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous; but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

title: Psalms 2:1
text: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples meditate on a vain thing?

title: Psalms 2:2
text: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers plot together, against the LORD and against His anointed, [saying],

title: Psalms 2:3
text: Let us break their bands in two and cast away their cords from us.

title: Psalms 2:4
text: He who sits in the heavens shall laugh; the LORD shall mock at them.

title: Psalms 2:5
text: Then He shall speak to them in His anger, and trouble them in His wrath.

title: Psalms 2:6
text: Yea, I have set My king on My holy hill, on Zion.

title: Psalms 2:7
text: I will declare the decree of the LORD. He has said to Me, You [are] My Son; today I have begotten You.

title: Psalms 2:8
text: Ask of Me, and I shall give the nations [for] Your inheritance; and the uttermost parts of the earth for Your possession.

title: Psalms 2:9
text: You shall break them with a rod of iron; You shall dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

title: Psalms 2:10
text: And now be wise, O kings; be instructed, O judges of the earth.

title: Psalms 2:11
text: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

title: Psalms 2:12
text: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry, and you perish [from] the way, when His wrath is kindled in but a little time. Blessed [are] all who put their trust in Him.

title: Psalms 3:1
text: A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom. O Lord, how my foes have increased! Many [are] the ones who rise up against me.

title: Psalms 3:2
text: Many are saying of my soul, [There is] no deliverance for him in God. Selah.

title: Psalms 3:3
text: But You, O LORD, [are] a shield for me; my glory, the One who lifts up my head.

title: Psalms 3:4
text: I cried to the LORD with my voice, and He heard me out of His holy hill. Selah.

title: Psalms 3:5
text: I laid down and slept. I awoke, for the LORD kept me.

title: Psalms 3:6
text: I am not afraid of ten thousands of people who have set against me all around.

title: Psalms 3:7
text: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God; for You have struck all my enemies [on] the cheekbone. You have broken the teeth of the ungodly.

title: Psalms 3:8
text: Salvation [belongs] to the LORD. Your blessing [is] on Your people. Selah.

title: Psalms 4:1
text: To the Chief Musician, for stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness; You gave room to me in trouble; have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

title: Psalms 4:2
text: O sons of men, [how long] will you turn My glory into shame? Will you love vanity and seek after a lie? Selah.

title: Psalms 4:3
text: But know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself. The LORD hears when I call to Him.

title: Psalms 4:4
text: Tremble, and sin not; speak within your own heart on your bed and be still. Selah.

title: Psalms 4:5
text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and trust in the LORD.

title: Psalms 4:6
text: There [are] many who say, Who will show us [any] good? LORD, lift up the light of Your face on us.

title: Psalms 4:7
text: You have put gladness in my heart, more than in the time [that] their grain and their wine increased.

title: Psalms 4:8
text: I will lie down, both in peace and in sleep. For You alone, LORD, make me dwell in safety.

title: Psalms 5:1
text: To the Chief Musician, for flutes. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my meditation.

title: Psalms 5:2
text: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for to You I will pray.

title: Psalms 5:3
text: My voice You shall hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning I will direct [my prayer] to You, and I will look up.

title: Psalms 5:4
text: For You [are] not a God that enjoys wickedness; nor shall evil dwell with You.

title: Psalms 5:5
text: The foolish shall not stand in Your sight. You hate all doers of iniquity.

title: Psalms 5:6
text: You shall destroy those who speak lies; the LORD will despise the bloody and deceitful man.

title: Psalms 5:7
text: But I, in the abundance of Your grace, I will come [into] Your house; I will worship in Your fear toward Your holy temple.

title: Psalms 5:8
text: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness, because of my enemies; make Your way straight before my face.

title: Psalms 5:9
text: For [there is] no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is wickedness; their throat [is] an open grave; they flatter with their tongue.

title: Psalms 5:10
text: Hold them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.

title: Psalms 5:11
text: But let all who put their trust in You rejoice; let them always shout for joy, because You defend them. And let those who love Your name be joyful in You.

title: Psalms 5:12
text: For You; O LORD, will bless the righteous; with favor You will surround him as [with] a shield.

title: Psalms 6:1
text: To the Chief Musician, for eight-stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. O LORD, rebuke me not in Your anger, nor chasten me in the heat of Your fury.

title: Psalms 6:2
text: Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I [am] weak; O LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

title: Psalms 6:3
text: My soul also is exceedingly troubled; but You, O LORD, how long?

title: Psalms 6:4
text: Return, O LORD, return; deliver my soul; save me for Your mercy's sake.

title: Psalms 6:5
text: For in death [there is] no memory of You; in the grave who shall give You thanks?

title: Psalms 6:6
text: I am weary in my groaning; all the night I make my bed swim; I melt my couch with my tears.

title: Psalms 6:7
text: My eye is dim because of grief; it wastes away because of all my enemies.

title: Psalms 6:8
text: Depart from me, all workers of iniquity; for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.

title: Psalms 6:9
text: The LORD has heard my cry; the LORD will receive my prayer.

title: Psalms 6:10
text: Let all my enemies be ashamed and exceedingly troubled; let them turn back [and] be ashamed in a moment.

title: Psalms 7:1
text: A song of David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite. O LORD my God, in You I put my trust; save me from all who pursue me, and deliver me,

title: Psalms 7:2
text: lest he tear my soul like a lion, tearing [it] in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.

title: Psalms 7:3
text: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there is iniquity in my hands;

title: Psalms 7:4
text: if I have rewarded evil to my friend, or if I have delivered my vexer without cause;

title: Psalms 7:5
text: let the enemy persecute my soul and take [it]; yea, let him trample down my life on the earth and lay my honor in the dust. Selah.

title: Psalms 7:6
text: Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; lift up Yourself because of the rage of my enemies, and awake for me [to] the judgment which You have commanded.

title: Psalms 7:7
text: And the congregation of the peoples shall surround You; and over it You will return on high.

title: Psalms 7:8
text: The LORD shall judge the people; judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to my integrity on me.

title: Psalms 7:9
text: O let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the just. For the righteous God tries the minds and hearts.

title: Psalms 7:10
text: My defense [is] from God, who saves the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 7:11
text: God judges the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

title: Psalms 7:12
text: If he does not turn, He will whet His sword; He has bent His bow and made it ready.

title: Psalms 7:13
text: Yea, He has fitted for him instruments of death; He will make ready His arrows hotly pursue.

title: Psalms 7:14
text: Behold, he labors in pain with iniquity, and he has conceived mischief, and has brought forth falsehood.

title: Psalms 7:15
text: He dug a pit and bored it, and has fallen into the ditch [which] he made.

title: Psalms 7:16
text: His mischief shall return on his own head, and his violence shall come on his own crown.

title: Psalms 7:17
text: I will praise the LORD according to His righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

title: Psalms 8:1
text: To the Chief Musician, on the harp. A Psalm of David. O Jehovah our Lord, how excellent [is] Your name in all the earth! [You] have set Your glory above the heavens!

title: Psalms 8:2
text: Out of the mouths of babes and sucklings You have ordained strength, because of Your tormentors, to cause the enemy and the avenger to cease.

title: Psalms 8:3
text: When I look at Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars which You have established;

title: Psalms 8:4
text: what is man that You are mindful of him, and the son of man, that You visit him?

title: Psalms 8:5
text: For You have made him a little lower than the angels, and have crowned him with glory and honor.

title: Psalms 8:6
text: You made him rule over the works of Your hands; You have put all [things] under his feet:

title: Psalms 8:7
text: all sheep and oxen, yes, and the beasts of the field;

title: Psalms 8:8
text: the birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea, and [all that] pass through the paths of the seas.

title: Psalms 8:9
text: O Jehovah, our Lord, how excellent [is] Your name in all the earth!

title: Psalms 9:1
text: To the Chief Musician. To die for the Son. A Psalm of David. I will praise [You], O LORD, with my whole heart; I will tell of all Your marvelous works.

title: Psalms 9:2
text: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.

title: Psalms 9:3
text: When my enemies have turned back, they shall fall and perish before You.

title: Psalms 9:4
text: For You have maintained my right and my cause; You sat in the throne judging right.

title: Psalms 9:5
text: You have rebuked the heathen, You have destroyed the wicked, You have put out their name forever and ever.

title: Psalms 9:6
text: The desolations of the enemy have come to an end forever, and You have destroyed the cities; their memorial has perished with them.

title: Psalms 9:7
text: But the LORD shall endure forever; He has prepared His throne for judgment.

title: Psalms 9:8
text: And He shall judge the world in righteousness; He shall judge the peoples in uprightness.

title: Psalms 9:9
text: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

title: Psalms 9:10
text: And those who know Your name will put their trust in You; for You, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.

title: Psalms 9:11
text: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; declare among the nations His deeds.

title: Psalms 9:12
text: For He remembers them, the seekers of bloodshed; He forgets not the cry of the humble.

title: Psalms 9:13
text: Have mercy on me, O LORD; see my trouble from those who hate me, You who lift me up from the gates of death,

title: Psalms 9:14
text: so that I may declare all Your praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion; I will rejoice in Your salvation.

title: Psalms 9:15
text: The nations have sunk down in the pit [that] they made; their foot is caught in the net which they hid.

title: Psalms 9:16
