text: The LORD is known. He has executed judgment; the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. A meditation. Selah.

title: Psalms 9:17
text: The wicked shall be turned into hell, all the nations that forget God.

title: Psalms 9:18
text: For the needy shall not always be forgotten; the hope of the poor shall [not] perish forever.

title: Psalms 9:19
text: Arise, O LORD; let not man be strong. Let the nations be judged in Your sight.

title: Psalms 9:20
text: Put them in fear, O LORD, let the nations know they [are] but men. Selah.

title: Psalms 10:1
text: Why do You stand afar off, O LORD? Will You hide in times of trouble?

title: Psalms 10:2
text: The wicked in [his] pride persecutes the poor; let them be taken in the plans that they have imagined.

title: Psalms 10:3
text: For the wicked boasts of his heart's desire, and blesses the covetous [whom] the LORD despises.

title: Psalms 10:4
text: Through the pride of his face the wicked will not seek [Him]; There [is] no God in all his schemes.

title: Psalms 10:5
text: His ways are always perverted; Your judgments [are] high, out of his sight. [As for] all his enemies, he puffs at them.

title: Psalms 10:6
text: He has said in his heart, I shall not be moved; from generation to generation, never in evil!

title: Psalms 10:7
text: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud; under his tongue [are] mischief and vanity.

title: Psalms 10:8
text: He sits in the hiding-places of the villages; in the secret places he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the poor.

title: Psalms 10:9
text: He lies in wait secretly, like a lion in his den. He lies in wait to catch the poor; he catches the poor when he draws him into his net.

title: Psalms 10:10
text: He crouches and bows, and the poor have fallen by his might.

title: Psalms 10:11
text: He has said in his heart, God has forgotten; He hides His face; He will not see forever!

title: Psalms 10:12
text: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up Your hand; forget not the humble.

title: Psalms 10:13
text: Why do the wicked condemn God? He has said in his heart, You will not judge.

title: Psalms 10:14
text: You have seen [it]; for You behold mischief and vexation, to repay [it] with Your hand. The poor commits [himself] to You; You are the Helper of the fatherless.

title: Psalms 10:15
text: Break the arm of the wicked and the evil one; seek out his wickedness, [until] You find none.

title: Psalms 10:16
text: The LORD [is] King forever and ever; the nations have perished out of His land.

title: Psalms 10:17
text: LORD, You have heard the desire of the humble; You will prepare their heart, You will cause Your ear to hear,

title: Psalms 10:18
text: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, so that the man of the earth may no more terrify.

title: Psalms 11:1
text: To the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David. I put my trust in the LORD; how can you say to me, Flee [like] a bird to the mountains;

title: Psalms 11:2
text: for lo, the wicked bend [their] bow; they make ready their arrow on the string, so that they may secretly shoot at the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 11:3
text: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

title: Psalms 11:4
text: The LORD [is] in His holy temple; the LORD's throne [is] in Heaven; His eyes behold, His eyelids examine the children of men.

title: Psalms 11:5
text: The LORD tries the righteous; but His soul hates the wicked and the one who loves violence,

title: Psalms 11:6
text: On the wicked He shall rain snares, fire and brimstone; and a horrible tempest [shall be] the portion of their cup.

title: Psalms 11:7
text: For the righteous LORD loves righteousness; His face looks on the upright.

title: Psalms 12:1
text: To the Chief Musician, on eight. A Psalm of David. Help, LORD, for the godly man ceases; for the faithful fail from among the sons of men.

title: Psalms 12:2
text: They speak vanity each one with his neighbor; [with] flattering lips and a double heart they speak.

title: Psalms 12:3
text: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that speaks proud things,

title: Psalms 12:4
text: that has said, With our tongue we shall do much; our lips [are] our own; who [is] lord over us?

title: Psalms 12:5
text: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, I will now arise, says the LORD. I will set in safety, he pants for it.

title: Psalms 12:6
text: The words of the LORD [are] pure words, [like] silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

title: Psalms 12:7
text: You shall keep them, O LORD, You shall preserve them from this generation forever.

title: Psalms 12:8
text: The wicked walk on every side, when vileness is praised by the sons of men.

title: Psalms 13:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. How long will You forget me, O LORD? Forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?

title: Psalms 13:2
text: How long shall I take counsel in my heart [having] sorrow in my heart daily? How long shall my enemy be lifted up over me?

title: Psalms 13:3
text: Look! Answer me, O LORD my God; enlighten my eyes, lest I sleep the [sleep of] death,

title: Psalms 13:4
text: lest my enemy say, I have overcome him, and my foes rejoice when I am shaken.

title: Psalms 13:5
text: But I have trusted in Your mercy; my heart shall rejoice in Your salvation.

title: Psalms 13:6
text: I will sing to the LORD, because He has rewarded me.

title: Psalms 14:1
text: To the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David. The fool has said in his heart, [There is] no God! They acted corruptly; they have done abominable works, [there is] none who does good.

title: Psalms 14:2
text: The LORD looked down from Heaven on the sons of men, to see if there were any who understood [and] sought God.

title: Psalms 14:3
text: All [have] gone aside, together they are filthy; [there is] none who does good, no, not one.

title: Psalms 14:4
text: Have all the workers of iniquity not known, eating up My people [as] they eat bread? They have not called on the LORD.

title: Psalms 14:5
text: There they were in great fear; for God [is] in the generation of the righteous.

title: Psalms 14:6
text: You have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD [is] his refuge.

title: Psalms 14:7
text: Who will bring the salvation of Israel out of Zion? When the LORD brings back the captivity of His people, Jacob shall rejoice, [and] Israel shall be glad.

title: Psalms 15:1
text: A Psalm of David. LORD, who shall dwell in Your tabernacle? Who shall dwell on Your holy hill?

title: Psalms 15:2
text: He who walks uprightly, and works righteousness, and speaks the truth in his heart;

title: Psalms 15:3
text: [he] does not backbite with his tongue, nor do evil to his neighbor, nor take up a reproach against his neighbor;

title: Psalms 15:4
text: in whose eyes the reprobate is despised, but he honors those who fear the LORD; [he] has sworn to his hurt, and does not change it;

title: Psalms 15:5
text: [he] has not put out his money at interest, nor has he taken a bribe against the innocent. He who does these [things] shall not be moved forever.

title: Psalms 16:1
text: A Secret Treasure of David. Watch over me, O God; for in You do I put my trust.

title: Psalms 16:2
text: [Oh my soul,] you have said to the LORD, You [are] my Lord; I have no goodness apart from You.

title: Psalms 16:3
text: As to the saints in the earth, they [are] the excellent, in whom [is] all my delight.

title: Psalms 16:4
text: Their sorrows shall be multiplied [who] run after another [god]. I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood; and I will not take their names on my lips.

title: Psalms 16:5
text: The LORD [is] the portion of my inheritance, and of my cup; You shall uphold my lot.

title: Psalms 16:6
text: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant [places]; yea, I have a beautiful inheritance.

title: Psalms 16:7
text: I will bless the LORD, who has given me wisdom; my heart also instructs me [in] the nights.

title: Psalms 16:8
text: I have set the LORD always before Me; because [He is] at My right hand, I shall not be moved.

title: Psalms 16:9
text: Therefore My heart is glad, and My glory rejoices; My flesh also shall rest in hope;

title: Psalms 16:10
text: For You will not leave My soul in hell; You will not allow Your Holy One to see corruption.

title: Psalms 16:11
text: You will make Me know the way of life; in Your presence [is] fullness of joys. At Your right hand [are] pleasures forevermore.

title: Psalms 17:1
text: A Prayer of David. Hear the right, O LORD; listen to my cry; Give ear to my prayer, [for it is] not in lips of deceit.

title: Psalms 17:2
text: Let my judgment go out from Your presence; let Your eyes behold uprightly.

title: Psalms 17:3
text: You have proved my heart; You have visited [me] in the night; You have tried me, and You will find nothing; my thoughts do not pass beyond my mouth.

title: Psalms 17:4
text: Concerning the works of men, by the words of Your lips, I am kept [from] the paths of the destroyer.

title: Psalms 17:5
text: My steps have been held in Your paths, [so that] my footsteps have not slipped.

title: Psalms 17:6
text: I have called on You, for You will hear me, O God; bow down Your ear to me; [hear] my speech.

title: Psalms 17:7
text: Set our Your wonderful loving-kindness, O Savior of those seeking refuge [in You], by Your right hand, from those who rise up against [me].

title: Psalms 17:8
text: Keep me as the pupil, the daughter of the eye; hide me under the shadow of Your wings,

title: Psalms 17:9
text: from the face of the wicked who strip me. [Those] against [my] soul, My foes, encircle me.

title: Psalms 17:10
text: They are enclosed in their own fat; with their mouth they speak proudly,

title: Psalms 17:11
text: They have now hemmed in our steps. They have set their eyes to bow [me] to the earth,

title: Psalms 17:12
text: Their likeness is like a lion [that] longs to tear, and like a young lion lurking in secret places.

title: Psalms 17:13
text: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, bow him down; deliver my soul from the wicked by Your sword,

title: Psalms 17:14
text: from men by Your hand, O LORD, from men of the world whose portion is in [this] life, and whose belly You fill with Your treasure. They are satisfied with sons, and will leave their riches to their babes.

title: Psalms 17:15
text: [As for] me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I shall be satisfied with Your image.

title: Psalms 18:1
text: To the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David, the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul; and he said: I love You, O LORD, my strength.

title: Psalms 18:2
text: The LORD [is] my strength, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock; I will trust in Him; [He is] my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

title: Psalms 18:3
text: I will call on the LORD, [who is worthy] to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.

title: Psalms 18:4
text: The sorrows of death hemmed me in, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

title: Psalms 18:5
text: The sorrows of hell surrounded me; the snares of death confronted me.

title: Psalms 18:6
text: In my distress I called on the LORD, and I cried to my God; He heard my voice out of His temple, and my cry came before Him, into His ears.

title: Psalms 18:7
text: Then the earth shook and trembled; and the foundations of the hills moved and were shaken, because He was angry.

title: Psalms 18:8
text: A smoke went up out of His nostrils, and fire devoured out of His mouth; coals were kindled by it.

title: Psalms 18:9
text: And He bowed the heavens and came down, and darkness [was] under His feet.

title: Psalms 18:10
text: And He rode on a cherub, and flew; yea, He soared on the wings of the wind.

title: Psalms 18:11
text: He made darkness His secret place, His pavilion around Him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

title: Psalms 18:12
text: At the brightness before Him, His dark clouds passed through, hailstones and coals of fire passed.

title: Psalms 18:13
text: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave forth His voice; hailstones and coals of fire.

title: Psalms 18:14
text: Yea, He sent out His arrows and scattered them; and He shot out lightnings and crushed them.

title: Psalms 18:15
text: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were uncovered, at Your rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.

title: Psalms 18:16
text: He sent from above, He took me, He drew me out of many waters.

title: Psalms 18:17
text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from those who hated me; for they were too strong for me.

title: Psalms 18:18
text: They went before me in the day of my calamity; but the LORD was my stay.

title: Psalms 18:19
text: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me because He delighted in me.

title: Psalms 18:20
text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands He has repaid me.

title: Psalms 18:21
text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

title: Psalms 18:22
text: For all His judgments [were] before me, and I did not put away His statutes from me.

title: Psalms 18:23
text: I was also upright before Him, and I kept myself from my iniquity.

title: Psalms 18:24
text: And the LORD has returned to me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His eyes.

title: Psalms 18:25
text: With the merciful, You will show Yourself merciful; with an upright man You will show Yourself upright;

title: Psalms 18:26
text: with the pure You will show Yourself pure; and with the crooked You will show Yourself perverse.

title: Psalms 18:27
text: For You will save the afflicted people, but will bring down high looks.

title: Psalms 18:28
text: For You will light my candle; the LORD my God will make my darkness light.

title: Psalms 18:29
text: For by You I have run through a troop; and by my God I have leaped over a wall.

title: Psalms 18:30
text: [As for] God, His way [is] perfect; the word of the LORD [is] tried; He [is] a shield to all those who trust in Him.

title: Psalms 18:31
text: For who [is] God besides Jehovah? Or, who [is] a Rock except our God?

title: Psalms 18:32
text: [It is] God who girds me with strength and makes my way perfect.

title: Psalms 18:33
text: He makes my feet like hinds' feet, and sets me on my high places.

title: Psalms 18:34
text: He teaches my hands to war, so that a bow of bronze is bent by my arms.

title: Psalms 18:35
text: You have also given me the shield of Your salvation; and Your right hand has held me up, and Your gentleness has made me great.

title: Psalms 18:36
text: You have given a wide place for my steps under me, so that my feet have not slipped.

title: Psalms 18:37
text: I have pursued my enemies and overtaken them; nor did I turn again until they were destroyed.

title: Psalms 18:38
text: I have shattered them, and they cannot rise again; they have fallen under my feet.

title: Psalms 18:39
text: For You have girded me with strength for the battle; You have humbled under me those who rose up against me.

title: Psalms 18:40
text: You have also given me the neck of my enemies; so that I might destroy those who hate me.

title: Psalms 18:41
text: They cried, but there [was] none to save; [even] to the LORD, but He did not answer them.

title: Psalms 18:42
text: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind; I cast them out like the dirt in the streets.

title: Psalms 18:43
text: You have delivered Me from the strivings of the people; You have made Me the head of the nations; a people [whom] I have not known shall serve Me.

title: Psalms 18:44
text: As soon as they hear of Me, they shall obey Me; the sons of strangers shall bow down to Me.

title: Psalms 18:45
text: The sons of strangers shall fade away and be afraid out of their strongholds.

title: Psalms 18:46
text: The LORD lives; and blessed [be] my rock, and let the God of my salvation be praised.

title: Psalms 18:47
text: [It is] God who avenges me, and humbles the people under me.

title: Psalms 18:48
text: He delivers me from my enemies; yea, You lift me up above those who rise up against me; You have delivered me from the violent man.

title: Psalms 18:49
text: Therefore I will give thanks to You, O LORD, among the nations, and sing praises to Your name,

title: Psalms 18:50
text: magnifying the salvations to His king, and working mercy to His anointed, to David, and to his seed forevermore.

title: Psalms 19:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; and the expanse proclaims His handiwork.

title: Psalms 19:2
text: Day by day [they] pour forth speech, and night to night reveals knowledge.

title: Psalms 19:3
text: [There is] no speech nor [are] there words [where] their voice is not heard.

title: Psalms 19:4
text: Their line has gone out through all the earth and their words to the end of the world. In them He has set a tabernacle for the sun,

title: Psalms 19:5
text: and he comes forth as a bridegroom from his canopy; he rejoices as a strong man to run a race,

title: Psalms 19:6
text: going forth from the end of the heavens, and its course [is] to their ends. And there is nothing hid from its heat.

title: Psalms 19:7
text: The law of the LORD [is] perfect, converting the soul; the testimony of the LORD [is] sure, making the simple wise.

title: Psalms 19:8
text: The statutes of the LORD [are] right, rejoicing the heart; the commandments of the LORD [are] pure, giving light to the eyes.

title: Psalms 19:9
text: The fear of the LORD [is] clean, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD [are] true [and] righteous altogether,

title: Psalms 19:10
text: more to be desired than gold, even much fine gold; sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

title: Psalms 19:11
text: And Your servant is warned by them; in keeping them there [is] great reward.

title: Psalms 19:12
text: Who can understand [his] errors? Oh make me pure from secret [faults];

title: Psalms 19:13
text: and keep Your servant back from presumptuous [sins]; do not let them rule over me; then I shall be upright, and I shall be innocent of great transgression.

title: Psalms 19:14
text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.

title: Psalms 20:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. May the LORD hear you in the day of trouble, the name of the God of Jacob set you on high,

title: Psalms 20:2
text: sending you help from the sanctuary, and upholding you out of Zion.

title: Psalms 20:3
text: He will remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifice. Selah.

title: Psalms 20:4
text: May He grant you according to your own heart, and fulfill all your plans.

title: Psalms 20:5
text: We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up banners; may the LORD fulfill all your prayers.

title: Psalms 20:6
text: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He will hear him from His holy Heaven with the saving strengths of His right hand.

title: Psalms 20:7
text: Some [trust] in chariots, and some in horses; but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

title: Psalms 20:8
text: They have bowed down and fallen; but we have risen and stand upright.

title: Psalms 20:9
text: Save, O LORD; let the King hear us when we call.

title: Psalms 21:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. The king shall rejoice in Your strength, O LORD; and in Your salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

title: Psalms 21:2
text: You have given him his heart's desire, and have not withheld the prayer of his lips. Selah.

title: Psalms 21:3
text: For You go before him [with] the blessings of goodness; You set a crown of pure gold on his head.

title: Psalms 21:4
text: He asked life from You; You give to him length of days forever and ever.

title: Psalms 21:5
text: His glory [is] great in Your salvation; honor and majesty You have laid on him.

title: Psalms 21:6
text: For You have made him most blessed forever; You have rejoiced him in the gladness in Your holy face.

title: Psalms 21:7
text: For the king trusts in the LORD, and in the mercy of the Most High; he shall not be moved.

title: Psalms 21:8
text: Your hand shall find out all Your enemies; Your right hand shall find out those who hate You.

title: Psalms 21:9
text: You shall make them as a fiery oven in the time of Your presence; the LORD will swallow them up in His wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

title: Psalms 21:10
text: Their fruit shall You destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the sons of men.

title: Psalms 21:11
text: For they intended evil against You; they imagined a wicked thing; they are not able to prevail.

title: Psalms 21:12
text: For You shall make them turn the back; You shall make ready [Your arrows] on Your strings against their faces.

title: Psalms 21:13
text: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing, and praise Your power.

title: Psalms 22:1
text: To the Chief Musician, on the deer of the dawn. A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me, and [are] far from my deliverance, [and from] the words of my groaning?

title: Psalms 22:2
text: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but You do not answer; and in the night, and am not silent.

title: Psalms 22:3
text: But You [are] holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.

title: Psalms 22:4
text: Our fathers trusted in You; they trusted, and You delivered them.

title: Psalms 22:5
text: They cried to You, and were delivered; they trusted in You, and were not ashamed.

title: Psalms 22:6
text: But I [am] a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

title: Psalms 22:7
text: All who see me laugh me to scorn; they shoot out the lip; they shake the head, [saying],

title: Psalms 22:8
text: He trusted on the LORD; let Him deliver him; let Him rescue him, since He delights in him!

title: Psalms 22:9
text: For You [are He] who took me out of the womb, causing me to trust [when I was] on my mother's breasts.

title: Psalms 22:10
text: I was cast on You from the womb; You [are] my God from my mother's belly.

title: Psalms 22:11
text: Be not far from me; for trouble [is] near, for [there is] none to help.

title: Psalms 22:12
text: Many bulls have circled around me; strong [bulls] of Bashan have surrounded me.

title: Psalms 22:13
text: They opened wide their mouths on me, [like] a ripping and a roaring lion.

title: Psalms 22:14
text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are spread apart; my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

title: Psalms 22:15
text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue clings to my jaws;

title: Psalms 22:16
text: and You have brought me into the dust of death. For dogs have circled around me; the band of spoilers have hemmed me in, piercers of my hands and my feet.

title: Psalms 22:17
text: I can count all my bones; they look [and] stare at me.

title: Psalms 22:18
text: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.

title: Psalms 22:19
text: But You, O LORD, be not far from me; O my strength, hurry to help me!

title: Psalms 22:20
text: Deliver my soul from the sword, my only one from the dog's hand.

title: Psalms 22:21
text: Save me from the lion's mouth; from the wild oxen's horns. You have answered me.

title: Psalms 22:22
text: I will declare Your name to my brothers; in the midst of the congregation I will praise You.

title: Psalms 22:23
text: You who fear the LORD, praise Him; all of you, the seed of Jacob, glorify Him; and fear Him all the seed of Israel.

title: Psalms 22:24
text: For He has not despised nor hated the affliction of the afflicted; and He has not hidden His face from him, but when he cried to Him, He heard.

title: Psalms 22:25
text: My praise [shall be] of You in the great congregation; I will pay my vows before the ones who fear Him.

title: Psalms 22:26
text: The meek shall eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD shall praise Him; your heart shall live forever.

title: Psalms 22:27
text: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn to the LORD; and all the families of the nations shall worship before You.

title: Psalms 22:28
text: For the kingdom [is] the LORD's; and He [is] the ruler among the nations.

title: Psalms 22:29
text: All the fat [ones] on the earth shall eat and worship; all those who go down to the dust shall bow before Him; and none can keep alive his own soul.

title: Psalms 22:30
text: A seed shall serve Him; it shall be spoken of the LORD to the [coming] generation.

title: Psalms 22:31
text: They shall come, and shall declare His righteousness to a people that shall [yet] be born, that He has done [this].

title: Psalms 23:1
text: A Psalm of David. The LORD [is] my Shepherd; I shall not want.

title: Psalms 23:2
text: He makes me to lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside the still waters.

title: Psalms 23:3
text: He restores my soul; He leads me in paths of righteousness for His name's sake.

title: Psalms 23:4
text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for You [are] with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

title: Psalms 23:5
text: You prepare a table for me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; my cup runs over.

title: Psalms 23:6
text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life; and I shall dwell in the house of the LORD forever.

title: Psalms 24:1
text: A Psalm of David. The earth [is] the LORD's, and the fullness of it; the world, and those who dwell in it.

title: Psalms 24:2
text: For He has founded it on the seas, and established it on the rivers.

title: Psalms 24:3
text: Who shall go up into the hill of the LORD? Or who shall stand in His holy place?

title: Psalms 24:4
text: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to vanity, and has not sworn deceitfully.

title: Psalms 24:5
text: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

title: Psalms 24:6
text: This [is] the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, [O God] of Jacob. Selah.

title: Psalms 24:7
text: Lift up your heads, O gates; and be lifted up, O everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

title: Psalms 24:8
text: Who [is] this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

title: Psalms 24:9
text: Lift up your heads, O gates; even lift up, O everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

title: Psalms 24:10
text: Who [is] this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, He [is] the King of glory. Selah.

title: Psalms 25:1
text: A Psalm of David. To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul.

title: Psalms 25:2
text: O my God, I trust in You; do not let me be ashamed, let not my enemies triumph over me.

title: Psalms 25:3
text: Yea, let none who wait on You be ashamed; let them be ashamed who sin without cause.

title: Psalms 25:4
text: Make me know Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.

title: Psalms 25:5
text: Lead me in Your truth, and teach me; for You [are] the God of my salvation; on You I wait all the day long.

title: Psalms 25:6
text: Remember, O LORD, Your tender mercies and Your loving-kindnesses; for they [are] from eternity.

title: Psalms 25:7
text: Do not remember the sins of my youth, or my rebellings; according to Your mercy remember me for Your goodness' sake, O LORD.

title: Psalms 25:8
text: Good and upright [is] the LORD; therefore He will teach sinners in the way.

title: Psalms 25:9
text: The meek He will guide in judgment; and the meek He will teach His way.

title: Psalms 25:10
text: All the paths of the LORD [are] mercy and truth to those who keep His covenant and His testimonies.

title: Psalms 25:11
text: For Your name's sake, O LORD, pardon my iniquity; for it [is] great.

title: Psalms 25:12
text: What man [is] he who fears the LORD? He shall teach him in the way that he shall choose.

title: Psalms 25:13
text: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

title: Psalms 25:14
text: The secret of the LORD [is] with those who fear Him; and He will show them His covenant.

title: Psalms 25:15
text: My eyes [are] ever toward the LORD; for He shall pluck my feet out of the net.

title: Psalms 25:16
text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I [am] wasted and afflicted.

title: Psalms 25:17
text: The troubles of my heart are enlarged; bring me out of my distresses.

title: Psalms 25:18
text: Look on my affliction and my pain, and forgive all my sins.

title: Psalms 25:19
text: Look on my enemies; for they are many; and they hate me [with] cruel hatred.

title: Psalms 25:20
text: Keep my soul, and deliver me; let me not be ashamed, for I put my trust in You.

title: Psalms 25:21
text: Let purity and uprightness keep me; for I wait on You.

title: Psalms 25:22
text: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

title: Psalms 26:1
text: A Psalm of David. Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in my truthfulness. I have trusted also in the LORD; I shall not slide.

title: Psalms 26:2
text: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; purify my heart and my mind.

title: Psalms 26:3
text: For Your loving-kindness [is] before my eyes; and I have walked in Your truth.

title: Psalms 26:4
text: I have not sat with lying men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

title: Psalms 26:5
text: I have hated the congregation of evil-doers, and will not sit with the wicked.

title: Psalms 26:6
text: I will wash my hands in innocency; so I will go around Your altar, O LORD,

title: Psalms 26:7
text: so that I may cry out with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all Your wonderful works.

title: Psalms 26:8
text: LORD, I have loved the dwelling place of Your house, and the place where Your honor dwells.

title: Psalms 26:9
text: Do not take away my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men

title: Psalms 26:10
text: in whose hands [is] a plot, and their right hand is full of a bribe.

title: Psalms 26:11
text: But I will walk in my truthfulness; redeem me and be merciful to me.

title: Psalms 26:12
text: My foot stands in an even place; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.

title: Psalms 27:1
text: A Psalm of David. The LORD [is] my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The LORD [is] the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

title: Psalms 27:2
text: When the wicked, my enemies and my foes, came on me to eat my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

title: Psalms 27:3
text: Though an army should camp against me, my heart shall not fear; though war should rise against me, in this I am trusting.

title: Psalms 27:4
text: One [thing] I have desired from the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to pray in His temple.

title: Psalms 27:5
text: For in the time of trouble He shall hide me in His shelter, in the secrecy of His tabernacle He shall hide me; He shall set me up on a rock.

title: Psalms 27:6
text: And now my head shall be lifted up above my enemies, my encirclers; and I will offer sacrifices of joy in His tabernacle. I will sing; yea, I will sing praises to the LORD.

title: Psalms 27:7
text: Hear, O LORD, [when] I cry with my voice; and have mercy on me, and answer me.

title: Psalms 27:8
text: My heart says to You, Seek my face; Your face, O LORD, I will seek;

title: Psalms 27:9
text: Hide not Your face from me. Turn not Your servant away in anger; You have been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

title: Psalms 27:10
text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

title: Psalms 27:11
text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of my enemies.

title: Psalms 27:12
text: Deliver me not over to the will of my enemies; for false witnesses have risen up against me, and he that breathes out cruelty.

title: Psalms 27:13
text: [I would have] fainted unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

title: Psalms 27:14
text: Hope in the LORD; be of good courage, and He shall make your heart strong; yea, hope in the LORD.

title: Psalms 28:1
text: A Psalm of David. I will cry to You, O LORD; my Rock, do not be deaf to me, lest, [if] You be silent to me, I become like those who go down into the pit.

title: Psalms 28:2
text: Hear the voice of my prayers, when I cry to You, when I lift up my hands toward Your Holy Place.

title: Psalms 28:3
text: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors, yet evil [is] in their hearts.

title: Psalms 28:4
text: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their practices, give them according to the work of their hands; give them what they deserve.

title: Psalms 28:5
text: Because they do not pay attention to the works of the LORD and to the work of His hands, He shall destroy them and never build them up.

title: Psalms 28:6
text: Blessed [is] the LORD, because He has heard the voice of my prayers.

title: Psalms 28:7
text: The LORD [is] my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in Him, and I am helped; therefore my heart greatly rejoices; and with my song I will praise Him.

title: Psalms 28:8
text: The LORD [is] a strength to them, and He [is] the saving strength of His anointed.

title: Psalms 28:9
text: Save Your people, and bless Your inheritance; feed them also, and lift them up forever.

title: Psalms 29:1
text: A Psalm of David. Give to the LORD, O you mighty, give to the LORD glory and strength.

title: Psalms 29:2
text: Give to the LORD the glory due to His name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

title: Psalms 29:3
text: The voice of the LORD [is] on the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD [is] above many waters.

title: Psalms 29:4
text: The voice of the LORD [is] in power, the voice of the LORD [is] in majesty.

title: Psalms 29:5
text: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; yea, the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon.

title: Psalms 29:6
text: He also makes them to skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.

title: Psalms 29:7
text: The voice of the LORD goes through flames of fire.

title: Psalms 29:8
text: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

title: Psalms 29:9
text: The voice of the LORD causes the does to calve, and uncovers the forests; and in His temple all of it [is] saying, Glory!

title: Psalms 29:10
text: The LORD sits on the flood; yea, the LORD sits as King forever.

title: Psalms 29:11
text: The LORD will give strength to His people; the LORD will bless His people with peace.

title: Psalms 30:1
text: A Psalm and Song at the dedication of the House of David. I will praise You, O LORD; for You have lifted me up, and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.

title: Psalms 30:2
text: O LORD my God, I cried to You, and You have healed me.

title: Psalms 30:3
text: O LORD, You have brought up my soul from the grave; You have kept me alive, so that I should not go down to the Pit.

title: Psalms 30:4
text: Sing praises to the LORD, O you saints of His, and give thanks at the memory of His holiness.

title: Psalms 30:5
text: For His anger [is only] a moment; in His favor [is] life. Weeping may endure for a night, but joy [comes] in the morning.

title: Psalms 30:6
text: And in my blessedness I said, I shall never be moved.

title: Psalms 30:7
text: O LORD, by Your favor You have made my mountain to stand strong; You hid Your face, [and] I was troubled.

title: Psalms 30:8
text: I cried to You, O LORD; and I prayed to the LORD.

title: Psalms 30:9
text: What profit [is] in my blood, in going down to the pit? Shall the dust praise You? Shall it tell of Your truth?

title: Psalms 30:10
text: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy on me; LORD, be my helper.

title: Psalms 30:11
text: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me; You have torn off my sackcloth, and have clothed me [with] gladness,

title: Psalms 30:12
text: so that [my] glory may sing praise to You, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks to You forever.

title: Psalms 31:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I put my trust; let me never be ashamed; deliver me in Your righteousness.

title: Psalms 31:2
text: Bow down Your ear to me; deliver me quickly; be my strong rock, a fortress to save me.

title: Psalms 31:3
text: For You [are] my rock and my fortress; and for Your name's sake lead me and guide me.

title: Psalms 31:4
text: Bring me out of the net that they hid for me, for You [are] my strength.

title: Psalms 31:5
text: Into Your hand I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

title: Psalms 31:6
text: I have hated those who take heed to lying vanities; but I trust in the LORD.

title: Psalms 31:7
text: I will be glad and rejoice in Your mercy; for You have looked on my affliction; You have known my soul in troubles;

title: Psalms 31:8
text: and have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; You have set my feet in a broad place.

title: Psalms 31:9
text: Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I am in trouble; my eye has become old with grief, my soul and my belly.

title: Psalms 31:10
text: For my life is ending with grief, and my years with sighing; my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones have wasted away.

title: Psalms 31:11
text: I was a reproach among all my foes, but especially among my neighbors, and a fear to my friends; those who saw me outside fled from me.

title: Psalms 31:12
text: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind; I am like a broken vessel.

title: Psalms 31:13
text: For I have heard the slander of many; fear [is] on every side; because of their plottings together against me, they planned to take away my life.

title: Psalms 31:14
text: But I trusted in You, O LORD; I said, You [are] my God.

title: Psalms 31:15
text: My times [are] in Your hand; deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

title: Psalms 31:16
text: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me in Your mercy.

title: Psalms 31:17
text: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called on You; Let the wicked be ashamed; let them be silent in the grave.

title: Psalms 31:18
text: Let the lying lips be put to silence; [the lips] which speak proudly against the righteous, with pride and scorn.

title: Psalms 31:19
text: How great [is] Your goodness, which You have laid up for those who fear You; You have worked for those who trust in You before the sons of men!

title: Psalms 31:20
text: You shall hide them in the secrecy of Your presence from the pride of man; You shall hide them in a shelter away from the strife of tongues.

title: Psalms 31:21
text: Blessed [is] the LORD; for He has worked His mercy wondrously in a besieged city.

title: Psalms 31:22
text: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before Your eyes; surely You heard the voice of my cries, when I cried to You.

title: Psalms 31:23
text: O love the LORD, all you saints of His; the LORD preserves the faithful, and plentifully rewards the proud doer.

title: Psalms 31:24
text: Be strong, and He will make your heart stronger, all you who hope in the LORD.

title: Psalms 32:1
text: A Psalm of David. A Contemplation. Blessed [is] the man whose transgression [is] forgiven, whose sin [is] covered.

title: Psalms 32:2
text: Blessed [is] the man to whom the LORD does not charge iniquity, and in whose spirit there [is] no guile.

title: Psalms 32:3
text: When I kept silence, my bones became old through my roaring all the day long.

title: Psalms 32:4
text: For by day and by night Your hand [was] heavy on me; my sap is turned into the droughts of summer. Selah.

title: Psalms 32:5
text: I confessed my sin to You, and my iniquity I have not hidden. I said, I will confess my transgression to the LORD; and You forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

title: Psalms 32:6
text: For this let every godly one pray to You, in a time when You may be found; surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come near him.

title: Psalms 32:7
text: You [are] my hiding place; You shall preserve me from trouble; You shall circle [me] with songs of deliverance. Selah.

title: Psalms 32:8
text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you should go; I will counsel you, My eye [shall be] on you.

title: Psalms 32:9
text: Be not like the horse, [or] like the mule, who have no understanding, whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, so [that] they do not come near you.

title: Psalms 32:10
text: The wicked [has] many sorrows, but mercy embraces him who trusts in the LORD.

title: Psalms 32:11
text: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous; and shout for joy, all [you] upright in heart.

title: Psalms 33:1
text: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous [ones;] praise is becoming for the upright.

title: Psalms 33:2
text: Praise the LORD with lyre; sing to Him with a harp of ten strings.

title: Psalms 33:3
text: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with shouts of joy.

title: Psalms 33:4
text: For the word of the LORD [is] right; and all His works [are] in truth.

title: Psalms 33:5
text: [He] loves righteousness and judgment; the earth is full of the mercy of the LORD.

title: Psalms 33:6
text: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of His mouth.

title: Psalms 33:7
text: He gathered the waters of the sea like a heap, setting the depths in storehouses.

title: Psalms 33:8
text: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world stand in awe of Him.

title: Psalms 33:9
text: For He spoke, and it was [done]; He commanded, and it stood.

title: Psalms 33:10
text: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; He breaks the plots of the people.

title: Psalms 33:11
text: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the thoughts of His heart to all generations.

title: Psalms 33:12
text: Blessed [is] the nation whose God [is] the LORD; the people He has chosen for His inheritance.

title: Psalms 33:13
text: The LORD looks down from Heaven; He beholds all the sons of mankind.

title: Psalms 33:14
text: From His dwelling place He looks on all the people of the earth.

title: Psalms 33:15
text: Together He forms their hearts; His understanding [is] to all their works.

title: Psalms 33:16
text: The king is not saved by a great army; a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

title: Psalms 33:17
text: A horse [is] a vain thing for safety; neither shall he deliver by his great strength.

title: Psalms 33:18
text: Behold, the eye of the LORD [is] to those who fear Him, on those who hope in His mercy;

title: Psalms 33:19
text: to deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

title: Psalms 33:20
text: Our soul waits for the LORD; He [is] our help and our shield.

title: Psalms 33:21
text: For our heart shall rejoice in Him, because we trust in His holy name.

title: Psalms 33:22
text: Let Your mercy, O LORD, be on us, according as we hope in You.

title: Psalms 34:1
text: A Psalm of David, when he changed his behavior before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise always [shall be] in my mouth.

title: Psalms 34:2
text: My soul shall make its boast in the LORD; the humble shall hear and be glad.

title: Psalms 34:3
text: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt His name together.

title: Psalms 34:4
text: I sought the LORD, and He heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

title: Psalms 34:5
text: They looked to Him, and were filled with light; and their faces were not ashamed.

title: Psalms 34:6
text: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard, and saved him out of all his troubles.

title: Psalms 34:7
text: The Angel of the LORD camps round about those who fear Him, and delivers them.

title: Psalms 34:8
text: Taste and see that the LORD [is] good; blessed [is] the man [who] trusts in Him.

title: Psalms 34:9
text: O fear the LORD, His holy ones; for [there is] nothing lacking to those who fear Him.

title: Psalms 34:10
text: The young lions lack, and suffer hunger; but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.

title: Psalms 34:11
text: Come, listen to me, [my] sons; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

title: Psalms 34:12
text: Who [is] the man that desires life, and loves days, that he may see good?

title: Psalms 34:13
text: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking guile.

title: Psalms 34:14
text: Depart from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

title: Psalms 34:15
text: The eyes of the LORD [are] on the righteous, and His ears [are open] to their cry.

title: Psalms 34:16
text: The face of the LORD [is] against those who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.

title: Psalms 34:17
text: [The righteous] cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

title: Psalms 34:18
text: The LORD [is] near to the broken-hearted; and saves those who are of a contrite spirit.

title: Psalms 34:19
text: Many [are] the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

title: Psalms 34:20
text: He keeps all his bones; not one of them is broken.

title: Psalms 34:21
text: Evil shall slay the wicked; and those who hate the righteous shall be held guilty.

title: Psalms 34:22
text: The LORD redeems the soul of His servants; and none of them who trust in Him shall be guilty.

title: Psalms 35:1
text: A Psalm of David. Strive, O LORD, with those who strive with me; fight against those who fight against me.

title: Psalms 35:2
text: Take hold of a shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

title: Psalms 35:3
text: Also draw out the spear and the lance against those who pursue me; say to my soul, I [am] your salvation.

title: Psalms 35:4
text: Let them be humbled and put to shame, those who seek after my soul; let them be turned back and be brought to blushing, those who plot evil to me.

title: Psalms 35:5
text: Let them be as chaff before the wind; and let the Angel of the LORD drive [them] away.

title: Psalms 35:6
text: Let their way be dark and slippery; and let the Angel of the LORD pursue them.

title: Psalms 35:7
text: For without cause they have spread their net for me [in] a pit-net; without cause they have dug for my soul.

title: Psalms 35:8
text: Let destruction come upon him, he will not know; and let his net which he has hidden concealed catch him, let him fall in it, into destruction.

title: Psalms 35:9
text: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD; it shall rejoice in His salvation.

title: Psalms 35:10
text: All my bones shall say, O LORD, who [is] like You, who delivers the poor from those stronger than he; yea, the poor and the needy from him who plunders him?

title: Psalms 35:11
text: Cruel witnesses rose up; they asked of me that which I never knew.

title: Psalms 35:12
text: They rewarded me evil for good; bereaving my soul.

title: Psalms 35:13
text: But when they were sick, my clothing [was] sackcloth; I humbled my soul with fastings; and my prayer returned into my own bosom.

title: Psalms 35:14
text: As a friend, as to my brother, I walked; as one who mourns for a mother, I was bowed down, mourning.

title: Psalms 35:15
text: But in my stumbling they rejoiced, and gathered themselves; the defamers gathered themselves against me, and I knew not; they tore and were not silent,

title: Psalms 35:16
text: with the hypocrites, mockers, [for] a cake, they gnashed on me with their teeth.

title: Psalms 35:17
text: O LORD, how long will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my only one from the lions.

title: Psalms 35:18
text: I will give You thanks in the great congregation; I will praise You among a mighty people.

title: Psalms 35:19
text: Let not those who are my lying enemies rejoice over me, those who hate me without cause wink [with] the eye.

title: Psalms 35:20
text: For they do not speak peace; but they think deceitful things against the quiet ones of the earth.

title: Psalms 35:21
text: And they widen their mouths against me; they say, Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen.

title: Psalms 35:22
text: You have seen, O LORD; do not keep silence; O LORD, do not be far from me.

title: Psalms 35:23
text: Stir up Yourself and awaken to my judgment, to my cause, my God and my Lord.

title: Psalms 35:24
text: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to Your righteousness; and do not let them rejoice over me.

title: Psalms 35:25
text: Let them not say in their hearts, Aha! Our Soul! Let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

title: Psalms 35:26
text: Let them be clothed [with] shame and dishonor together, [those] who magnify themselves over me.

title: Psalms 35:27
text: Let those who delight in my justification shout and rejoice; and they shall say without ceasing, The Lord be magnified, delighting in the peace of His servant.

title: Psalms 35:28
text: And my tongue shall speak of Your righteousness, of Your praise all the day long.

title: Psalms 36:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. [The oracle] utters transgression to the wicked within my heart. [There is] no fear of God before his eyes.

title: Psalms 36:2
text: For he flatters himself in his own eyes in order to find his iniquity, to hate [it].

title: Psalms 36:3
text: The words of his mouth [are] evil and deceit; he has stopped acting wise and doing good.

title: Psalms 36:4
text: He plots evil on his bed; he sets himself in a way [that is] not good; he does not hate evil.

title: Psalms 36:5
text: Your mercy, O LORD, [is] in the heavens; Your faithfulness [reaches] to the clouds.

title: Psalms 36:6
text: Your righteousness [is] like the great mountains; Your judgments [are] a great deep; O LORD, You keep man and beast.

title: Psalms 36:7
text: How precious [is] Your loving-kindness, O God! And the sons of men take refuge under the shadow of Your wing.

title: Psalms 36:8
text: They shall be satisfied with the fatness of Your house; and You shall make them drink of the river of Your pleasures.

title: Psalms 36:9
text: For with You [is] the fountain of life; in Your light we shall see light.

title: Psalms 36:10
text: O continue Your loving-kindness to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 36:11
text: Do not let the foot of pride come against me, and do not let the hand of the wicked move me.

title: Psalms 36:12
text: There the evil-doers have fallen; they are cast down, and cannot rise.

title: Psalms 37:1
text: A Psalm of David. Do not fret yourself with evil doers; and do not be envious against the workers of iniquity.

title: Psalms 37:2
text: For they shall soon wither like the grass; and fade as the green herb.

title: Psalms 37:3
text: Trust in the LORD, and do good; you shall dwell in the land, and you shall be fed on truth.

title: Psalms 37:4
text: Delight yourself also in the LORD, and He shall give you the desires of your heart.

title: Psalms 37:5
text: Roll your way on the LORD; trust also in Him, and He will work.

title: Psalms 37:6
text: And He shall bring forth your righteousness like the light, and your judgment like the noonday.

title: Psalms 37:7
text: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for Him; do not fret yourself because of him who prospers in his way, because of him who practices wickedness.

title: Psalms 37:8
text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; do not fret yourself to do evil.

title: Psalms 37:9
text: For evildoers shall be cut off; but those who wait on the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

title: Psalms 37:10
text: [It is] but a little while, and the wicked shall not be; yea, you shall search his place, and he shall not be.

title: Psalms 37:11
text: But the meek shall inherit the earth, and shall delight themselves in the overflowing of peace.

title: Psalms 37:12
text: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes on him with his teeth.

title: Psalms 37:13
text: The LORD laughs at him; for He sees that his day is coming.

title: Psalms 37:14
text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who walk uprightly.

title: Psalms 37:15
text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

title: Psalms 37:16
text: A little to the righteous [is] better than the riches of many wicked.

title: Psalms 37:17
text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; but the LORD upholds the righteous.

title: Psalms 37:18
text: The LORD knows the days of the upright, and their inheritance shall be forever.

title: Psalms 37:19
text: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time; and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

title: Psalms 37:20
text: But the wicked shall pass, and the enemies of the LORD [shall be] like the beauty of pastures; they are consumed, like smoke they perish.

title: Psalms 37:21
text: The wicked borrows, and never pays again; but the righteous shows mercy, and gives.

title: Psalms 37:22
text: For His blessed ones shall inherit the earth; and those cursed by Him shall be cut off.

title: Psalms 37:23
text: The steps of a [good] man are ordered by the LORD; and He delights in his way.

title: Psalms 37:24
text: Though he fall, he shall not be cast down; for the LORD upholds his hand.

title: Psalms 37:25
text: I have been young, and am old; yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, or his seed begging bread.

title: Psalms 37:26
text: All the day long he deals graciously, and lends; and his seed [is] blessed.

title: Psalms 37:27
text: Depart from evil and do good; and live forevermore.

title: Psalms 37:28
text: For the LORD loves judgment and does not forsake His saints; they are kept forever; but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

title: Psalms 37:29
text: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell in it forever.

title: Psalms 37:30
text: The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, and his tongue talks of judgment.

title: Psalms 37:31
text: The law of his God [is] in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

title: Psalms 37:32
text: The wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to kill him.

title: Psalms 37:33
text: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor allow [him] to be found guilty when he is judged.

title: Psalms 37:34
text: Wait on the LORD, and keep His way, and He shall lift you up to inherit the earth; when the wicked are cut off, you shall see [it].

title: Psalms 37:35
text: I have seen the wicked ruthless, and spreading himself like a luxuriant native [tree].

title: Psalms 37:36
text: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he [was] not; and I looked for him, but he could not be found.

title: Psalms 37:37
text: Watch the perfect and behold the upright one; for the end of [that] man [is] peace.

title: Psalms 37:38
text: But the sinners are destroyed together; the end of the wicked is cut off.

title: Psalms 37:39
text: But the salvation of the righteous [is] from the LORD; [He is] their strength in the time of trouble.

title: Psalms 37:40
text: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them; He shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in Him.

title: Psalms 38:1
text: A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your wrath; neither chasten me in Your fury.

title: Psalms 38:2
text: For Your arrows stick fast in me, and Your hand presses heavily on me.

title: Psalms 38:3
text: [There is] no soundness in my flesh because of Your anger; nor rest in my bones because of my sin.

title: Psalms 38:4
text: For my iniquities have gone over my head; like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

title: Psalms 38:5
text: My wounds have putrefied [and] rotted, because of my foolishness.

title: Psalms 38:6
text: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

title: Psalms 38:7
text: For my loins are filled with a burning; and there [is] no soundness in my flesh.

title: Psalms 38:8
text: I am feeble and painfully broken; I have roared because of the groanings of my heart.

title: Psalms 38:9
text: My Lord, all my desire [is] before You; and my sighing is not hidden from You.

title: Psalms 38:10
text: My heart pants; my strength fails me; as for the light of my eyes, it also is gone from me.

title: Psalms 38:11
text: My lovers and my friends stand apart from my plague; and my neighbors stand far off.

title: Psalms 38:12
text: And those who seek my life lay snares [for me]; and those who seek my hurt speak sly things, and utter deceits all the day long.

title: Psalms 38:13
text: But like a deaf one, I do not hear; and I [am] like a dumb one who opens not his mouth.

title: Psalms 38:14
text: And I am as a man who hears not, and in whose mouth [are] no reproofs.

title: Psalms 38:15
text: For in You, O LORD, do I hope; You will hear, O LORD my God.

title: Psalms 38:16
text: For I said, [Hear me], lest they rejoice over me; when my foot slips, they magnify themselves against me.

title: Psalms 38:17
text: For I [am] ready to fall, and my pain [is] always before me.

title: Psalms 38:18
text: For I will declare my iniquity; I am anxious from my sin.

title: Psalms 38:19
text: And my enemies [are] lively; they are strong; and my haters increase [by] deception.

title: Psalms 38:20
text: And those who give evil for good oppose me, because I follow good.

title: Psalms 38:21
text: Forsake me not, O LORD; O my God, be not far from me.

title: Psalms 38:22
text: Make haste to help me, O my LORD, my salvation.

title: Psalms 39:1
text: To the Chief Musician, to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. I said, I will take heed to my ways so that I do not sin with my tongue; I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked [are] before me.

title: Psalms 39:2
text: I became dumb, keeping still; I was silent, from good; and my pain was stirred.

title: Psalms 39:3
text: My heart was hot within me; while I was musing, the fire burned; I spoke with my tongue:

title: Psalms 39:4
text: O LORD, make me to know my end, and the measure of my days, what it [is]; I know how frail I [am].

title: Psalms 39:5
text: Behold, You have made my days [as] a handbreadth, and my age [is] as nothing before You. Surely every man standing [is] altogether vanity. Selah.

title: Psalms 39:6
text: Surely a man walks about like a shadow! Surely they are in an uproar in vain. He heaps up, and does not know who shall gather them.

title: Psalms 39:7
text: And now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope [is] in You.

title: Psalms 39:8
text: Deliver me from all my transgressions; make me not the reproach of the fool.

title: Psalms 39:9
text: I was dumb, I did not open my mouth; because You have done [it].

title: Psalms 39:10
text: Remove Your stroke away from me; I am destroyed by the blow of Your hand.

title: Psalms 39:11
text: You correct a man for iniquity with rebukes, and you make his desires vanish away like a moth. Surely every man [is] vanity. Selah.

title: Psalms 39:12
text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry. Do not be silent at my tears; for I [am] a stranger with You, a pilgrim, as all my fathers [were].

title: Psalms 39:13
text: Look away from me, and I will smile before I go away and be no more.

title: Psalms 40:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. I waited patiently for the LORD; and He bowed down to me, and heard my cry.

title: Psalms 40:2
text: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay, [and] set my feet on a rock, and gave sureness to my steps.

title: Psalms 40:3
text: And He has put a new song in my mouth, praise to our God; many shall see [it] and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

title: Psalms 40:4
text: Blessed [is] the man who makes the LORD his trust and does not turn to the proud, nor to those who turn aside [to] a lie.

title: Psalms 40:5
text: O LORD my God, many things You have done, Your wonderful works and Your thoughts [which] [are] toward us; they cannot be set in order to You; I will declare and speak, for they are more than can be numbered.

title: Psalms 40:6
text: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire; My ears You have opened; burnt offering and sin offering You have not asked.

title: Psalms 40:7
text: Then I said, Lo, I come, in the volume of the Book [it is] written of Me;

title: Psalms 40:8
text: I delight to do Your will, O My God; and Your law [is] within My heart.

title: Psalms 40:9
text: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation; lo, I have not kept back My lips, O LORD, You know.

title: Psalms 40:10
text: I have not hidden Your righteousness within my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and Your salvation; I have not hidden Your loving-kindness and Your truth from the great congregation.

title: Psalms 40:11
text: Do not withhold Your tender mercies from me, O LORD; let Your loving-kindness and Your truth always watch over me.

title: Psalms 40:12
text: For evils without number have hemmed me in; my sins have taken hold on me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails me.

title: Psalms 40:13
text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; O LORD, make haste to help me.

title: Psalms 40:14
text: Let them be ashamed and humbled together, those who seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame, those who wish me evil.

title: Psalms 40:15
text: Let them be desolate as a reward for their shame, those who say to me, Aha, aha!

title: Psalms 40:16
text: Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You, and the ones loving your salvation always say, Let the LORD be magnified.

title: Psalms 40:17
text: But I [am] poor and needy; the LORD will care for me; You [are] my help and my deliverer; O my God, do not wait.

title: Psalms 41:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Blessed [is] he who acts wisely toward the poor; the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.

title: Psalms 41:2
text: The LORD will watch over him and keep him alive; [and] he shall be blessed on the earth; and You will not deliver him to the soul of his enemies.

title: Psalms 41:3
text: The LORD will hold him up on the bed of sickness; You will change all his bed in his illness.

title: Psalms 41:4
text: I said, LORD, be merciful to me; heal my soul; for I have sinned against You.

title: Psalms 41:5
text: My enemies speak evil of me, [saying], When will he die, and his name perish?

title: Psalms 41:6
text: And when he comes to see [me], he speaks vanity; his heart gathers iniquity to itself; he goes out and speaks of it.

title: Psalms 41:7
text: All my haters me whisper against me; they plot evil against me.

title: Psalms 41:8
text: They say, a wicked thing is poured out on him, and he who lies down shall rise no more.

title: Psalms 41:9
text: Even a man, my friend, in whom I trusted, who ate of my bread, has lifted up [his] heel against me.

title: Psalms 41:10
text: But You, O LORD, be merciful to me, and raise me up, so that I may repay them.

title: Psalms 41:11
text: By this I know that You delight in me, because my enemy does not triumph over me.

title: Psalms 41:12
text: And I, in my integrity You uphold me; and You set me before Your face forever.

title: Psalms 41:13
text: Blessed [is] the LORD God of Israel, from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen and Amen!

title: Psalms 42:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A contemplation; for the sons of Korah. As the hart pants after the water brooks, so my soul pants after You, O God.

title: Psalms 42:2
text: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God; when shall I come and appear before God?

title: Psalms 42:3
text: My tears have been my food day and night, while they say to me all the day, Where [is] your God?

title: Psalms 42:4
text: When I remember these [things], I pour out my soul on me; for I had gone with the multitude; I went with them to the house of God with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping the feast.

title: Psalms 42:5
text: Why are you cast down, O my soul, and moan within me? Hope in God; for I shall praise Him [for] the salvation of His face.

title: Psalms 42:6
text: O my God, my soul is cast down within me; therefore I will remember You from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermons, from mount Mizar.

title: Psalms 42:7
text: Deep calls to deep at the noise of Your waterfalls; all Your waves and Your billows have gone over me.

title: Psalms 42:8
text: The LORD will command His loving-kindness in the daytime, and in the night His song [shall be] with me, my prayer to the God of my life.

title: Psalms 42:9
text: I will say to God my rock, Why have You forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the cruelty of the enemy?

title: Psalms 42:10
text: [As] with a sword in my bones, my enemies shame me; while they say daily to me, Where [is] your God?

title: Psalms 42:11
text: Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why do you moan within me? Hope in God; for I still praise Him, the salvation of my face, and my God.

title: Psalms 43:1
text: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

title: Psalms 43:2
text: For You [are] the God of my strength; why do You cast me off? Why do I go mourning under the affliction of the enemy?

title: Psalms 43:3
text: Oh send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me; let them bring me to Your holy hill, and to Your tabernacles.

title: Psalms 43:4
text: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy; yea, on the harp I will praise You, O God, my God.

title: Psalms 43:5
text: Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why do you moan within me? Hope in God; for I still praise Him, the salvation of my face, and my God.

title: Psalms 44:1
text: To the Chief Musician. For the sons of Korah, a contemplation. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work which You did in their days, in the days of old.

title: Psalms 44:2
text: You drove out the nations [with] Your hand, and planted them; You brought evil on peoples and cast them out.

title: Psalms 44:3
text: For they did not get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but [it was] Your right hand, and Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.

title: Psalms 44:4
text: You [are] my king, O God; command victories for Jacob.

title: Psalms 44:5
text: Through You we will push our enemies; through Your name we will trample those who rise up against us.

title: Psalms 44:6
text: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

title: Psalms 44:7
text: But You have saved us from our enemies, and have put them to shame, those who hated us.

title: Psalms 44:8
text: In God we boast all the day long, and praise Your name forever. Selah.

title: Psalms 44:9
text: Now You have cast us off, and have shamed us, and You do not go forth with our armies.

title: Psalms 44:10
text: You make us turn back from the adversary; and our haters plunder for themselves.

title: Psalms 44:11
text: You have given us like sheep [for] food, and have scattered us among the nations.

title: Psalms 44:12
text: You have sold Your people for nothing, and You did not increase by their price.

title: Psalms 44:13
text: You make us a curse to our neighbors, a scorn and a mockery to those who are round about us.

title: Psalms 44:14
text: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the people.

title: Psalms 44:15
text: My shame [is] always before me, and the shame of my face has covered me:

title: Psalms 44:16
text: because of the voice of the slanderer and the blasphemer; before the enemy and avenger.

title: Psalms 44:17
text: All this has come on us; yet we have not forgotten You nor dealt falsely in Your covenant.

title: Psalms 44:18
text: Our heart is not turned back, nor have our steps turned aside from Your way,

title: Psalms 44:19
text: though You have crushed us in the place of jackals and covered us with the shadow of death.

title: Psalms 44:20
text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god,

title: Psalms 44:21
text: shall not God search this out? For He knows the secrets of the heart.

title: Psalms 44:22
text: Yea, for Your sake we are put to death all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

title: Psalms 44:23
text: Awaken! Why do You sleep, O LORD? Arise! Do not cast [us] off forever.

title: Psalms 44:24
text: Why do You hide Your face, [and] forget our affliction and distress?

title: Psalms 44:25
text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly holds fast to the earth.

title: Psalms 44:26
text: Arise [for] our help, and redeem us for the sake of Your mercy.

title: Psalms 45:1
text: To the Chief Musician. Concerning the Lilies, for the sons of Korah, a contemplation; A Song of Loves. My heart is overflowing [with] a good matter; I speak of my works to the King; my tongue [is] the pen of a ready writer.

title: Psalms 45:2
text: You are the fairest of the sons of men; grace is poured into Your lips; therefore God has blessed You forever.

title: Psalms 45:3
text: Gird Your sword on [Your] thigh, O mighty one, [with] Your glory and Your majesty.

title: Psalms 45:4
text: And ride prosperously [in] Your majesty, because of truth and meekness [and] righteousness; and Your right hand shall teach You fearful things.

title: Psalms 45:5
text: Your arrows [are] sharp in the heart of the King's enemies; peoples fall under You.

title: Psalms 45:6
text: Your throne, O God, [is] forever and ever; the staff of Your kingdom [is] a staff of righteousness.

title: Psalms 45:7
text: You love righteousness, and hate wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of gladness above Your fellows.

title: Psalms 45:8
text: All Your garments [smell] of myrrh, and aloes [and] cassia, out of the ivory palaces, by which they have made You glad.

title: Psalms 45:9
text: Kings' daughters [are] among Your precious ones; on Your right hand stands the queen in gold of Ophir.

title: Psalms 45:10
text: Listen, O daughter, and look; and bow down your ear; and forget your own people and your father's house.

title: Psalms 45:11
text: And cause the King greatly to desire your beauty, for He [is] your Lord, and you shall worship Him.

title: Psalms 45:12
text: And the daughter of Tyre [shall be there] with a gift; even the rich among the peoples shall stroke your face.

title: Psalms 45:13
text: The king's daughter [is] all glorious within; her clothing [is] trimmed with gold.

title: Psalms 45:14
text: She shall be brought to the king in clothing of needlework; the virgins, her companions after her, shall be brought to You.

title: Psalms 45:15
text: They shall be led with joy and gladness; they shall enter into the King's palace.

title: Psalms 45:16
text: Your sons shall be in the place of your fathers; you will make them princes in all the land.

title: Psalms 45:17
text: I will make Your name to be remembered in all generations; therefore the people shall praise You forever and ever.

title: Psalms 46:1
text: To the Chief Musician. For the sons of Korah. A Song "For the Virgins." God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

title: Psalms 46:2
text: Therefore we will not fear when the earth changes, and when mountains [are] slipping into the heart of the seas.

title: Psalms 46:3
text: Let its waters roar and foam; let the mountains shake with the swelling of it. Selah.

title: Psalms 46:4
text: [There is] a river, its channels gladden the city of God glad, the holy [place] of the tabernacles of the Most High.

title: Psalms 46:5
text: God [is] in the midst of her; she shall not be moved; God shall help her at the turning of the morning.

title: Psalms 46:6
text: The nations raged, the kingdoms were shaken; He uttered His voice, the earth melted.

title: Psalms 46:7
text: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; the God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah.

title: Psalms 46:8
text: Come, behold the works of the LORD, who makes ruins on the earth;

title: Psalms 46:9
text: who makes wars to cease to the ends of the earth; He breaks the bow, and cuts the spear in two; He burns the chariots in the fire.

title: Psalms 46:10
text: Be still, and know that I [am] God! I will be praised among the nations, I will be praised in the earth.

title: Psalms 46:11
text: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; the God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah.

title: Psalms 47:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. Clap your hand, all you peoples; shout to God with the voice of triumph.

title: Psalms 47:2
text: For the LORD Most High [is] awesome, a great king over all the earth.

title: Psalms 47:3
text: He shall humble the peoples under us, and nations under our feet.

title: Psalms 47:4
text: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the majesty of Jacob whom He loved. Selah.

title: Psalms 47:5
text: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

title: Psalms 47:6
text: Sing praise to God, sing praise; sing praise to our King, sing praise.

title: Psalms 47:7
text: For God [is] King of all the earth; sing praises with understanding.

title: Psalms 47:8
text: God reigns over the nations, God sits on the throne of His holiness.

title: Psalms 47:9
text: The rulers of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth [are] God's; He is lifted up on high.

title: Psalms 48:1
text: A Song and Psalm for the Sons of Korah. Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of His holiness.

title: Psalms 48:2
text: Beautiful on high, the joy of the whole earth, [is] mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

title: Psalms 48:3
text: God is known in her strongholds for a refuge.

title: Psalms 48:4
text: For, lo, the kings were gathered; they passed by together.

title: Psalms 48:5
text: They saw, so they marvelled; they were troubled, [and] hurried away.

title: Psalms 48:6
text: Fear took hold on them there, [and] pain, like a woman in labor.

title: Psalms 48:7
text: You break the ships of Tarshish with an east wind;

title: Psalms 48:8
text: as we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

title: Psalms 48:9
text: We have thought of Your loving-kindness, O God, in the midst of Your temple.

title: Psalms 48:10
text: According to Your name, O God, so [is] Your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness; let mount Zion rejoice!

title: Psalms 48:11
text: Let the daughters of Judah shout for joy because of Your judgments!

title: Psalms 48:12
text: Walk around Zion, and go all around it; count the towers of it,

title: Psalms 48:13
text: Set your heart on its ramparts, pass between its strongholds; so that you may tell [it] to the coming generation.

title: Psalms 48:14
text: For this God [is] our God forever and ever; He will be [our] guide [even] to death.

title: Psalms 49:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples; give ear, all inhabitants of the world;

title: Psalms 49:2
text: both sons of mankind, and sons of man, rich and poor together;

title: Psalms 49:3
text: my mouth shall speak of wise things; and the thoughts of my heart [shall be] of understanding.

title: Psalms 49:4
text: I will bow down my ear to a parable; I will open my dark saying on the harp.

title: Psalms 49:5
text: Why should I fear in the days of evil, [when] the perversity of my ambushers will surround me?

title: Psalms 49:6
text: Those who trust in their wealth, and their many riches, boast themselves.

title: Psalms 49:7
text: A man cannot at all redeem a brother, nor give to God a ransom for him,

title: Psalms 49:8
text: for the redemption of their soul [is] precious, and it ceases forever,

title: Psalms 49:9
text: yea, he shall yet live forever; he shall never see corruption.

title: Psalms 49:10
text: For he sees wise men die; likewise the fool and the animal-like ones perish, and leave their wealth to others.

title: Psalms 49:11
text: Their inward [thought is that] their houses shall [go on] forever, and their dwelling-places to all generations; they call [their] lands after their own names.

title: Psalms 49:12
text: But man, though high in honor, does not remain; he is like the animals [that] perish.

title: Psalms 49:13
text: This way of theirs [is] their foolishness; yet their followers delight in their sayings. Selah.

title: Psalms 49:14
text: Like sheep they are appointed to the grave; death shall reign [for] them; and the upright shall have the rule over them in the morning; and their form [is] for rotting; the grave [is] their home.

title: Psalms 49:15
text: But God will redeem my soul from the hand of the grave; for He will take me. Selah.

title: Psalms 49:16
text: Be not afraid when one becomes rich, when the glory of his house increases;

title: Psalms 49:17
text: for when he dies he shall take nothing away; his glory shall not go down after him.

title: Psalms 49:18
text: For in his life he blessed his soul; yea, they praise you when you do well to yourself.

title: Psalms 49:19
text: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

title: Psalms 49:20
text: Man in honor, but without understanding, is like the animals; they shall perish.

title: Psalms 50:1
text: A Psalm of Asaph. The mighty God, the LORD, has spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun to [its] going down.

title: Psalms 50:2
text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God has shone.

title: Psalms 50:3
text: Our God comes, and He is not silent; a fire shall devour before Him, and it shall be very stormy all around Him.

title: Psalms 50:4
text: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, so that He may judge His people.

title: Psalms 50:5
text: Gather My saints to Me; and those who cut My covenant by sacrifice.

title: Psalms 50:6
text: And the heavens shall declare His righteousness; for God Himself [is] judge. Selah.

title: Psalms 50:7
text: Hear, My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you; I [am] God, your God.

title: Psalms 50:8
text: I will not reprove you for your sacrifices; yea, your burnt offerings [are] continually before Me.

title: Psalms 50:9
text: I will take no bull out of your house, [nor] he-goats out of your folds.

title: Psalms 50:10
text: For every beast of the forest [is] Mine, [and] the cattle on a thousand hills.

title: Psalms 50:11
text: I know all the birds of the mountains; and the wild beasts of the field [are] Mine.

title: Psalms 50:12
text: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world [is] Mine, and the fullness of it.

title: Psalms 50:13
text: Will I eat the flesh of the mighty, or drink the blood of goats?

title: Psalms 50:14
text: Offer to God thanksgiving; and pay your vows to the Most High;

title: Psalms 50:15
text: and call on Me in the day of trouble; and I will deliver you, and you shall glorify Me.

title: Psalms 50:16
text: But to the wicked, God says, What [is it] to you, to declare My statutes, and to take up My covenant in your mouth?

title: Psalms 50:17
text: Yea, you hate to be taught, and you toss My words behind you.

title: Psalms 50:18
