text: When you saw a thief, then you were pleased to be with him, and you [have taken] part with adulterers.

title: Psalms 50:19
text: You give your mouth to evil, and your tongue frames deceit.

title: Psalms 50:20
text: You sit; you speak against your brother; you slander your own mother's son.

title: Psalms 50:21
text: These [things] you have done, and I have kept silence; you thought [that] I was like yourself, [but] I will rebuke you, and set in order before your eyes.

title: Psalms 50:22
text: Now think of this, you who forget God, lest I tear [you] in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

title: Psalms 50:23
text: Whoever offers praise glorifies Me; and he who sets a way, I will show him the salvation of God.

title: Psalms 51:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving-kindness; according to the multitude of Your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

title: Psalms 51:2
text: Wash me completely from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

title: Psalms 51:3
text: For I confess my transgressions; and my sin [is] ever before me.

title: Psalms 51:4
text: Against You, You only, have I sinned, and done evil in Your sight; that You might be justified when You speak, [and] be clear when You judge.

title: Psalms 51:5
text: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, and in sin did my mother conceive me.

title: Psalms 51:6
text: Behold, You desire truth in the inward parts; and in the hidden [part] You shall make me to know wisdom.

title: Psalms 51:7
text: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

title: Psalms 51:8
text: Make me to hear joy and gladness; [that] the bones [which] You have broken may rejoice.

title: Psalms 51:9
text: Hide Your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.

title: Psalms 51:10
text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

title: Psalms 51:11
text: Cast me not away from Your presence, and take not Your Holy Spirit from me.

title: Psalms 51:12
text: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and uphold me [with] a willing spirit.

title: Psalms 51:13
text: [Then] I will teach transgressors Your ways; and sinners shall be converted to You.

title: Psalms 51:14
text: Deliver me from the guilt of shedding blood, O God, O God of my salvation, [and] my tongue shall sing aloud of Your righteousness.

title: Psalms 51:15
text: O LORD, open my lips, and my mouth shall show forth Your praise.

title: Psalms 51:16
text: For You do not desire sacrifice; or else I would give [it]; You do not delight in burnt offering.

title: Psalms 51:17
text: The sacrifices of God [are] a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.

title: Psalms 51:18
text: Do good in Your good pleasure to Zion; build the walls of Jerusalem.

title: Psalms 51:19
text: Then shall You be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering; then they shall offer bulls on Your altar.

title: Psalms 52:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A contemplation. A Psalm of David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said to him, David has come to the house of Ahimelech. Why do you boast yourself in evil, O mighty man? The mercy of God [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 52:2
text: Your tongue devises evil, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

title: Psalms 52:3
text: You love evil more than good, [and] lying more than to speak righteousness. Selah.

title: Psalms 52:4
text: You love all devouring words, O deceitful tongue.

title: Psalms 52:5
text: God will likewise destroy you forever; He shall take you away, and pluck you out of [your] tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

title: Psalms 52:6
text: And the righteous shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him, [saying],

title: Psalms 52:7
text: Behold, the man [who] did not make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, he was strong in his wickedness.

title: Psalms 52:8
text: But I [am] like a green olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the mercy of God forever and ever.

title: Psalms 52:9
text: I will praise You forever, because You have done [it]; and I will wait [on] Your name; for [it is] good before Your saints.

title: Psalms 53:1
text: To the Chief Musician on Mahalath. A contemplation. A Psalm of David. The fool has said in his heart, [There is] no God. They acted corruptly, and have worked out abominable wickedness; [there is] not one doing good.

title: Psalms 53:2
text: God looked down from Heaven on the sons of mankind to see if [any] was discerning, who was seeking God.

title: Psalms 53:3
text: Every one has turned away; they have altogether become filthy; not one is doing good, no, not even one.

title: Psalms 53:4
text: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? They eat up my people [as] they eat bread; they have not called on God.

title: Psalms 53:5
text: There they dreaded [with] dread, [where] no dread was; for God has scattered the bones of him who camps against you; you have put [them] to shame because God rejects them.

title: Psalms 53:6
text: Who will give from Zion the salvation of Israel? When God brings back the captivity of His people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

title: Psalms 54:1
text: To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation. A Psalm of David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Does not David hide himself among us? Save me, O God, by Your name, and judge me by Your strength.

title: Psalms 54:2
text: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

title: Psalms 54:3
text: For strangers have risen up against me, and cruel men seek after my soul; they have not set God before them. Selah.

title: Psalms 54:4
text: Behold, God [is] my helper; the LORD [is] with those who uphold my soul.

title: Psalms 54:5
text: He shall reward evil to my enemies; cut them off in Your truth.

title: Psalms 54:6
text: I will freely sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for [it is] good.

title: Psalms 54:7
text: For He has delivered me out of all trouble; and my eye has seen [its desire] on my enemies.

title: Psalms 55:1
text: To the Chief Musician. For stringed instruments. A contemplation. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not Yourself from my cry.

title: Psalms 55:2
text: Attend to me, and hear me; I wander and I moan in my complaint,

title: Psalms 55:3
text: from the voice of the enemy, from the oppression of the wicked, for they shake trouble over me, and in wrath they hate me.

title: Psalms 55:4
text: My heart is pained within me; and the terrors of death have fallen on me.

title: Psalms 55:5
text: Fear and trembling have come on me, and horror has covered me.

title: Psalms 55:6
text: And I said, Who will give to me wings like a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.

title: Psalms 55:7
text: Lo, I would wander far off; I would lodge in the desert. Selah.

title: Psalms 55:8
text: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm [and] tempest.

title: Psalms 55:9
text: Swallow up, O LORD, [and] divide their tongues; for I have seen violence and fighting in the city.

title: Psalms 55:10
text: They go around her on her walls by day and night; and evil and sorrow [are] in her midst.

title: Psalms 55:11
text: Covetings [are] in her midst; oppression and guile will not depart from her streets.

title: Psalms 55:12
text: For [it is] not an enemy [who] reviled me; then I could have borne [it]; [it is] not one who hates me [who] magnified [himself] against me; or I would hide myself from him;

title: Psalms 55:13
text: but [it is] you, a man my rank, my guide and my friend.

title: Psalms 55:14
text: We took sweet counsel together, [and] walked to the house of God in company.

title: Psalms 55:15
text: Let desolation take hold on them, [and] let them go down alive [into] hell; for evils [are] among them in their dwellings.

title: Psalms 55:16
text: I, [even] I, will call to God, and the LORD will save me.

title: Psalms 55:17
text: Evening and morning, and at noon, I will pray and cry aloud; and He shall hear my voice.

title: Psalms 55:18
text: He has delivered my soul in peace from the battle [that was] against me; for there were many with me.

title: Psalms 55:19
text: God shall hear and answer them, even He who is enthroned of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they do not fear God.

title: Psalms 55:20
text: He has put forth his hands against those who were at peace with him; he has broken his covenant.

title: Psalms 55:21
text: The butterings of his mouth [were] forked, but war [was] in his heart; his words were softer than oil, yet they [were] drawn swords.

title: Psalms 55:22
text: Cast your burden on the LORD, and He will keep you; He will never allow the righteous to waver.

title: Psalms 55:23
text: But You, O God, will bring them down into the pit of ruin; bloody and deceitful men shall not [live] half their days; but I will trust in You.

title: Psalms 56:1
text: To the Chief Musician. Concerning the silent dove-- those far off. Of David, a secret treasure--when the Philistines took him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for man would swallow me up; fighting daily, he presses me down.

title: Psalms 56:2
text: My watchers panted for me daily; for many [are] they who proudly fight against me.

title: Psalms 56:3
text: When I am afraid I will trust in You.

title: Psalms 56:4
text: In God I will praise His word; in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do to me.

title: Psalms 56:5
text: All day long they pervert my words; all their thoughts [are] against me for evil.

title: Psalms 56:6
text: They stir up strife; they hide themselves; they watch my steps as they wait for my soul.

title: Psalms 56:7
text: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.

title: Psalms 56:8
text: You number my wandering; O put my tears into Your bottle; [are they] not in Your Book?

title: Psalms 56:9
text: When I cry, then my enemies will be turned back. This I know, for God [is] with me.

title: Psalms 56:10
text: In God I will praise [His] word; in the LORD will I praise [His] word.

title: Psalms 56:11
text: In God I have put my trust; I will not be afraid of what man can do to me.

title: Psalms 56:12
text: Your vows [are] on me, O God; I will give praises to You.

title: Psalms 56:13
text: For You have delivered my soul from death; [have You] not [kept] my feet from falling, [so that] I may walk before God in the light of the living?

title: Psalms 57:1
text: To the Chief Musician. Do not destroy. A secret treasure of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave. Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me; for my soul trusts in You; yea, in the shadow of Your wings I will make my hiding-place, until [these] great troubles pass by.

title: Psalms 57:2
text: I will cry to God most high, to God who does all [things] for me.

title: Psalms 57:3
text: He shall send from Heaven, and save me [from] the scorn of him who would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth His mercy and His truth.

title: Psalms 57:4
text: My soul [is] among lions; I lie [among] those on fire, the sons of men whose teeth [are] spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

title: Psalms 57:5
text: Be praised above the heavens, O God; [let] Your glory [be] above all the earth.

title: Psalms 57:6
text: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down; [they have] dug a pit before me, they have fallen into it. Selah.

title: Psalms 57:7
text: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise.

title: Psalms 57:8
text: Wake up, my soul! Wake up, harp and lyre! I will awake the dawn.

title: Psalms 57:9
text: I will praise You, O LORD, among the peoples; I will sing to You among the nations.

title: Psalms 57:10
text: For Your mercy [is] great to the heavens, and Your truth to the clouds.

title: Psalms 57:11
text: Be exalted above the heavens, O God; [let] Your glory [be] above all the earth.

title: Psalms 58:1
text: To the Chief Musician. Do not destroy. A secret treasure of David. Will you indeed speak righteousness in silence? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?

title: Psalms 58:2
text: Yes, in heart you work the evil, you weigh the violence of your hands in the land.

title: Psalms 58:3
text: The wicked are estranged from the womb; [they go] astray from the womb, speaking lies.

title: Psalms 58:4
text: Their poison [is] like the poison of a snake; like the deaf adder, he stops his ear,

title: Psalms 58:5
text: which will not listen to the charmer's voice, a skillful caster of spells.

title: Psalms 58:6
text: O God, break their teeth in their mouth; break out the big teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

title: Psalms 58:7
text: Let them melt away like waters; they run off to them; he bends his arrows, [let them be] as though [they were] cut off.

title: Psalms 58:8
text: [Let them be] as a snail goes [into] melting; [as] a miscarriage of a woman, they do not see the sun.

title: Psalms 58:9
text: Before your pots can feel the thorns, whether green or glowing, He shall sweep it away.

title: Psalms 58:10
text: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance; he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

title: Psalms 58:11
text: And man shall say, Truly, [there is] a reward for the righteous; truly, [there is] a God judging in the earth.

title: Psalms 59:1
text: To the Chief Musician. Do not destroy. A secret treasure of David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; defend me from those who rise up against me.

title: Psalms 59:2
text: Deliver me from the workers of evil and save me from bloody men.

title: Psalms 59:3
text: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; the mighty are gathered against me; not [for] my transgression, nor [for] my sin, O LORD.

title: Psalms 59:4
text: Without [my] fault they run and prepare themselves; awaken to help me, and look [on me].

title: Psalms 59:5
text: And You, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the nations; do not be merciful to any plotting evil. Selah.

title: Psalms 59:6
text: They return at evening; they make a noise like a dog, and go around the city.

title: Psalms 59:7
text: Behold, they bellow out with their mouth; swords [are] in their lips; for [they say], Who hears?

title: Psalms 59:8
text: But You, O Jehovah, shall laugh at them; You will mock at all the nations.

title: Psalms 59:9
text: O my Strength, let me look to You, for God [is] my strong tower.

title: Psalms 59:10
text: The God of my mercy shall go before me; God shall let me see [my desire] on my enemies.

title: Psalms 59:11
text: Do not kill them, lest my people forget; scatter them by Your power and bring them down, O LORD our shield.

title: Psalms 59:12
text: [For] the sin of their mouth [is] the word of their lips, even let them even be taken in their pride; and for cursing and the lying [which] they speak.

title: Psalms 59:13
text: Consume [them] in wrath; consume, so that they may not be; and let them know that God rules in Jacob to the ends of the earth. Selah.

title: Psalms 59:14
text: And at evening they shall return; let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

title: Psalms 59:15
text: Let them wander up and down for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.

title: Psalms 59:16
text: But I will sing of Your power; yes, I will sing aloud of Your mercy in the morning; for You have been my strong tower and hiding-place in the day of my trouble.

title: Psalms 59:17
text: To You, O my strength, I will sing; for God [is] my strong tower [and] the God of my mercy.

title: Psalms 60:1
text: To the Chief Musician. On the Lily of Testimony. A secret treasure of David, to teach; when he struggled with Aram-naharaim and with Aram of Zobah, when Joab returned and struck twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. O God, You have cast us off, You have scattered us, You were angry; take us back.

title: Psalms 60:2
text: You made the earth tremble; You tore it; heal the breaks of it, for it is shaking.

title: Psalms 60:3
text: You have shown Your people hard things; You have made us to drink the wine of trembling.

title: Psalms 60:4
text: You have given a banner to those who fear You, to lift it up because of the truth. Selah.

title: Psalms 60:5
text: Save [with] Your right hand and answer me, that Your beloved may be delivered.

title: Psalms 60:6
text: God has spoken in His holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem and measure out the valley of Succoth.

title: Psalms 60:7
text: Gilead [is] Mine, and Manasseh [is] Mine; and Ephraim [is] the strength of My head, Judah [is] My lawgiver;

title: Psalms 60:8
text: Moab [is] My washpot; over Edom I will cast out My shoe; over Philistia I cry in triumph.

title: Psalms 60:9
text: Who will bring me [into] the strong city? Who will lead me into Edom?

title: Psalms 60:10
text: Have not You, O God, cast us off? And will You, O God, not go out with our armies?

title: Psalms 60:11
text: Give us help against [our] foe; for vain [is] the help of man.

title: Psalms 60:12
text: Through God we shall do great things; for [it is] He who shall trample our enemies.

title: Psalms 61:1
text: To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.

title: Psalms 61:2
text: From the end of the earth I cry to You when my heart is faint; Lead me to the Rock higher than I.

title: Psalms 61:3
text: For You have been a shelter for me, a strong tower before the enemy.

title: Psalms 61:4
text: I will dwell in Your tabernacle forever; I will trust in the hiding place of Your wings. Selah.

title: Psalms 61:5
text: For You, O God, have heard my vows; You have given an inheritance to those who fear Your name.

title: Psalms 61:6
text: You will add to the days of the king's life; his years will be for many generations.

title: Psalms 61:7
text: He shall abide before God forever; prepare mercy and truth to preserve him.

title: Psalms 61:8
text: So I will sing praise to Your name forever, so that I may daily pay my vows.

title: Psalms 62:1
text: To the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. Only to God is my soul in silence; from Him [comes] my salvation.

title: Psalms 62:2
text: He only [is] my rock and my salvation; [He is] my tower; I shall not be greatly moved.

title: Psalms 62:3
text: How long will you imagine mischief against a man? You will shatter him, all of you; you shall be like a bowing wall and a tottering fence.

title: Psalms 62:4
text: Surely they have plotted to cast [him] down from his great height; they delight in lies; they bless with their mouth, but they curse in their heart. Selah.

title: Psalms 62:5
text: My soul, be silent only to God; for my hope [is] from Him.

title: Psalms 62:6
text: He only [is] my rock and my salvation; He [is] my strong tower; I shall not be shaken.

title: Psalms 62:7
text: In God [is] my salvation and my glory; the rock of my strength; my hiding-place [is] in God.

title: Psalms 62:8
text: Trust in Him at all times; you people, pour out your heart before Him; God [is] a hiding-place for us. Selah.

title: Psalms 62:9
text: Surely the sons of men [are] vanity; the sons of men [are] a lie; they go up in the scales; they [are] altogether [lighter] than vanity.

title: Psalms 62:10
text: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery; if riches increase, do not set your heart [on] them.

title: Psalms 62:11
text: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power [belongs] to God.

title: Psalms 62:12
text: Also to You, O LORD, [belongs] mercy; for You give to every man according to his work.

title: Psalms 63:1
text: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah. O God, You [are] my God; I will seek You earnestly; my soul thirsts for You; my flesh longs for You, as in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

title: Psalms 63:2
text: so I have seen You in the holy place, seeing Your power and Your glory.

title: Psalms 63:3
text: Because Your loving-kindness [is] better than life, my lips shall praise You.

title: Psalms 63:4
text: So I will bless You while I live; I will lift up my hands in Your name.

title: Psalms 63:5
text: My soul shall be satisfied as [with] marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise [You] with joyful lips,

title: Psalms 63:6
text: when I remember You on my bed and think of You in the night watches.

title: Psalms 63:7
text: Because You have been my help, therefore in the shadow of Your wings I will rejoice.

title: Psalms 63:8
text: My soul follows hard after You; Your right hand upholds me.

title: Psalms 63:9
text: But those [who] seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the depths of the earth.

title: Psalms 63:10
text: They shall fall by the sword; they shall be a serving for jackals.

title: Psalms 63:11
text: But the king shall rejoice in God; everyone who swears by Him shall glory; but the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.

title: Psalms 64:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; guard my life from fear of the enemy.

title: Psalms 64:2
text: Hide me from the council of those who injure, from the rebelling of the workers of iniquity,

title: Psalms 64:3
text: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, they tread their arrows, [even] a bitter word,

title: Psalms 64:4
text: so that they may shoot at the blameless one from a lurking place; suddenly they shoot at him, and fear not.

title: Psalms 64:5
text: They encourage themselves [in] an evil plan; they talk of laying snares secretly; they say, Who shall see them?

title: Psalms 64:6
text: They search out injustice, [saying], We have finished hiding a hidden plot. Yea, the inward part of man and [the] heart [are] deep.

title: Psalms 64:7
text: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly they shall be wounded.

title: Psalms 64:8
text: So they shall be confounded; their tongue [falls] on themselves; everyone seeing them shall flee.

title: Psalms 64:9
text: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall in wisdom think of His doing.

title: Psalms 64:10
text: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in Him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

title: Psalms 65:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm and Song of David. To You silence is praise, O God, in Zion; and to You is a vow paid.

title: Psalms 65:2
text: To You who hears prayer, all flesh comes.

title: Psalms 65:3
text: Things of iniquity are mightier than I; [as for] our transgressions, You shall purge them away.

title: Psalms 65:4
text: Blessed [is] the [one] whom You choose, and cause to come near You. He shall dwell [in] Your courts; we shall be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, of Your holy temple.

title: Psalms 65:5
text: [By] awesome things in righteousness You will answer us, O God of our salvation; who are the hope of all the ends of the earth and the sea, of [those] far away.

title: Psalms 65:6
text: The mountains are established by Your strength, banded together with might,

title: Psalms 65:7
text: who stills the noise of the sea, the roar of their waves, and the uproar of the peoples.

title: Psalms 65:8
text: And the inhabitants of the furthermost places are afraid of Your signs; You make the beginning of the morning and the evening rejoice.

title: Psalms 65:9
text: You visit the earth and water it; You greatly enrich it; the river of God is full of water; You provide their grain, for in this way You have prepared it.

title: Psalms 65:10
text: You fill its terraces with water; You deepen its furrows; You make it soft with showers; You bless the sprouting of it.

title: Psalms 65:11
text: You crown the year with Your goodness, and Your paths drop fatness.

title: Psalms 65:12
text: They drop [on] the pastures of the wilderness; and the little hills gird themselves [with] joy.

title: Psalms 65:13
text: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with grain; they shout for joy and sing.

title: Psalms 66:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Song. A Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth.

title: Psalms 66:2
text: Sing forth the honor of His name; make His praise glorious.

title: Psalms 66:3
text: Say to God, How awesome [are] Your works! Through the greatness of Your power, Your enemies pretend obedience to You.

title: Psalms 66:4
text: All the earth shall worship You, and shall sing [to] You; they praise Your name. Selah.

title: Psalms 66:5
text: Come and see the works of God; [He is] awesome in His deeds toward the sons of men.

title: Psalms 66:6
text: He turns the sea into dry [land]; they went through the flood on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.

title: Psalms 66:7
text: He rules by His power forever; His eyes behold the nations; let not the rebels lift themselves up. Selah.

title: Psalms 66:8
text: O bless our God, O peoples, and make the voice of His praise to be heard;

title: Psalms 66:9
text: who holds our soul in life, and does not allow our feet to slide.

title: Psalms 66:10
text: For You have proved us, O God; You have tested us, as silver is refined.

title: Psalms 66:11
text: You have brought us into the net; You have laid affliction on our loins.

title: Psalms 66:12
text: You have allowed men to ride at our head; we have gone through fire and through water, but You have brought us out to plenty.

title: Psalms 66:13
text: I will go into Your house with burnt offerings; I will pay You my vows,

title: Psalms 66:14
text: [those] which my lips have uttered and my mouth has spoken in my trouble.

title: Psalms 66:15
text: I will offer to You burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

title: Psalms 66:16
text: Come [and] hear, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for my soul.

title: Psalms 66:17
text: I cried to Him with my mouth, and exaltations [were] under my tongue.

title: Psalms 66:18
text: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the LORD will not hear;

title: Psalms 66:19
text: Surely God has heard; He has attended to the voice of my prayer.

title: Psalms 66:20
text: Blessed [is] God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor His mercy from me.

title: Psalms 67:1
text: To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song. May God be merciful to us, and bless us, and cause His face to shine on us. Selah.

title: Psalms 67:2
text: So that Your way may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.

title: Psalms 67:3
text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples thank You.

title: Psalms 67:4
text: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy; for You shall judge the peoples righteously and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

title: Psalms 67:5
text: Let the peoples give thanks to You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.

title: Psalms 67:6
text: The earth shall yield its increase; [and] God, our own God, shall bless us.

title: Psalms 67:7
text: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.

title: Psalms 68:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. A Song. Let God arise, let His enemies be scattered; also let those who hate Him flee before Him.

title: Psalms 68:2
text: As smoke is driven away, You drive [them] away; as wax melts before the fire, let the wicked perish in the presence of God.

title: Psalms 68:3
text: But the righteous are glad; they rejoice before God. Yes, let them exceedingly rejoice.

title: Psalms 68:4
text: Sing to God, sing praises to His name; praise Him who rides on the heavens by His name JEHOVAH, and rejoice before Him.

title: Psalms 68:5
text: In His holy dwelling God [is] the father of the fatherless, and the judge of the widows.

title: Psalms 68:6
text: God causes the lonely to live at home; He brings out those who are bound with chains; but the rebellious dwell in a dry [land].

title: Psalms 68:7
text: O God, when You marched before Your people, when You walked through the wilderness; Selah.

title: Psalms 68:8
text: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God; Sinai itself [was moved] at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

title: Psalms 68:9
text: You, O God, sent a plentiful rain, by which You upheld Your inheritance when it was weary.

title: Psalms 68:10
text: Your flock has dwelt in it; You, O God, have prepared in Your goodness for the poor.

title: Psalms 68:11
text: The Lord gave the word; the bearers of it [were] a great army.

title: Psalms 68:12
text: Kings of armies fled away; and she who stayed at home divided the plunder.

title: Psalms 68:13
text: When you lie among the sheepfolds, the wings of a dove [are] covered with silver, and its pinions with the shimmer of gold.

title: Psalms 68:14
text: When the Almighty scatters kings in it, it snows on Salmon.

title: Psalms 68:15
text: The mountain of Bashan [is] God's mountain; the Bashan range [is] a mountain of peaks.

title: Psalms 68:16
text: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountain range, [at the] mountain God has chosen for His resting place? Yes, the LORD will dwell [in it] forever.

title: Psalms 68:17
text: The chariots of God [are] myriads, thousands of thousands; the Lord [is] among them, in Sinai, in the holy place.

title: Psalms 68:18
text: You have gone up on high; You have led captivity captive; You have received gifts for men, yes, [for] the rebellious also, that [You] might dwell among them, O Jehovah God.

title: Psalms 68:19
text: Blessed [is] the LORD; He daily bears burdens for us, the God of our salvation. Selah.

title: Psalms 68:20
text: Our God [is] the God of salvation; and to the LORD [are] the issues of death.

title: Psalms 68:21
text: Yea, God shall wound the head of His enemies, [and] the hairy crown of him who walks on in his guilt.

title: Psalms 68:22
text: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan; I will bring back [My people] from the depths of the sea;

title: Psalms 68:23
text: so that your foot may be dipped in the blood of [your] enemies, and the tongue of your dogs in it.

title: Psalms 68:24
text: They have seen Your goings, O God; the goings of my God, my King, in the holy place.

title: Psalms 68:25
text: The singers went before, then the musicians came; among [them were] the virgins playing the timbrels.

title: Psalms 68:26
text: O bless God in the congregations, the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

title: Psalms 68:27
text: There [is] little Benjamin [with] their ruler, the leaders of Judah and their multitude, the leaders of Zebulun, and the leaders of Naphtali.

title: Psalms 68:28
text: Your God has commanded your strength; O God, be strong [in] that which You have worked out for us.

title: Psalms 68:29
text: Because of Your temple in Jerusalem, kings shall bring a present to You.

title: Psalms 68:30
text: Rebuke the wild beasts of the reeds, the herd of bulls, with the calves of the peoples, trampling down with the pieces of silver. He scatters the people [who] delight in war.

title: Psalms 68:31
text: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall stretch out her hands to God.

title: Psalms 68:32
text: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises to the Lord. Selah.

title: Psalms 68:33
text: To Him who rides on the heavens of heavens of old; lo, He sends out His voice, a mighty voice.

title: Psalms 68:34
text: Give strength to God over Israel; His majesty and His strength in the skies.

title: Psalms 68:35
text: O God, You [are] overwhelming out of Your holy places; the God of Israel [is] He who gives strength and powers to the people. Blessed [is] God.

title: Psalms 69:1
text: To the Chief Musician. Concerning the Lilies. A Psalm of David. Save me, O God! for the waters have come in on [my] soul.

title: Psalms 69:2
text: I sink in deep mire, where [there is] no standing; I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

title: Psalms 69:3
text: I am weary from my crying; my throat is dried; my eyes fail while I wait for my God.

title: Psalms 69:4
text: They who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; they who would destroy me are mighty, my lying enemies. Then I restored [what] I did not take away.

title: Psalms 69:5
text: O God, You know my foolishness, and my guiltiness [is] not hidden from You.

title: Psalms 69:6
text: Do not let those who wait on You, O LORD God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake; let not the ones who seek You be ashamed for my sake, O God of Israel,

title: Psalms 69:7
text: because I have borne reproach for Your sake, shame has covered my face.

title: Psalms 69:8
text: I have become a stranger to My brothers, and a foreigner to My mother's children.

title: Psalms 69:9
text: For the zeal of Your house has eaten Me up; and the reproaches of those who reproached You have fallen on Me.

title: Psalms 69:10
text: When I humbled my soul with fasting, it turned to my reproach.

title: Psalms 69:11
text: I also made sackcloth my clothing, and I became a proverb to them.

title: Psalms 69:12
text: They who sit in the gate speak against me; and I [was] the song of the drunkards.

title: Psalms 69:13
text: But [as for] me, my prayer [is] to You, O LORD, [in] a pleasing time; O God, in the multitude of Your mercy hear me, in the truth of Your salvation.

title: Psalms 69:14
text: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink; let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

title: Psalms 69:15
text: Do not let the flood of waters overflow me, nor let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut its mouth on me.

title: Psalms 69:16
text: Hear me, O LORD, for Your loving-kindness [is] good; turn to me according to the multitude of Your tender mercies.

title: Psalms 69:17
text: And hide not Your face from Your servant; for I am in trouble; hear me quickly.

title: Psalms 69:18
text: Draw near my soul, and redeem it; deliver me because of my enemies.

title: Psalms 69:19
text: You have known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor; my enemies [are] all before You.

title: Psalms 69:20
text: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness; and I looked [for some] to mourn with me, but [there was] none; and for comforters, but I found none.

title: Psalms 69:21
text: They also gave Me gall for my food; and in My thirst they gave Me vinegar to drink.

title: Psalms 69:22
text: Let their table become a snare before them; and to those at ease a trap.

title: Psalms 69:23
text: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they do not see; and make their loins shake without ceasing.

title: Psalms 69:24
text: Pour out Your wrath on them, and let the glow of Your anger take hold of them.

title: Psalms 69:25
text: Let their dwelling be wasted; let none dwell in their tents.

title: Psalms 69:26
text: For they persecute [him] whom You have stricken, and they talk to the grief of those You pierced.

title: Psalms 69:27
text: Add iniquity to their iniquity, and let them not come into Your righteousness.

title: Psalms 69:28
text: Let them be blotted out of the Book of Life, and not be written with the righteous.

title: Psalms 69:29
text: But I [am] poor and sorrowful; let Your salvation, O God, set me up on high.

title: Psalms 69:30
text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify Him with thanksgiving.

title: Psalms 69:31
text: [This] also shall please the LORD better than an ox, [or] a bull that has horns and hoofs.

title: Psalms 69:32
text: The humble shall see [and] be glad; and your heart shall live, you who seek God.

title: Psalms 69:33
text: For the LORD hears the needy, and does not despise His prisoners.

title: Psalms 69:34
text: Let the heavens and earth praise Him, the seas, and everything that moves in them.

title: Psalms 69:35
text: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah; so that they may dwell there, and possess it.

title: Psalms 69:36
text: And the seed of His servants shall inherit it, and they who love His name shall dwell in it.

title: Psalms 70:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance. [Make haste], O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.

title: Psalms 70:2
text: Let them be ashamed and turned pale, those who seek after my soul; let them be turned backward and blush, those who desire my hurt.

title: Psalms 70:3
text: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame, those who say, Aha, aha!

title: Psalms 70:4
text: Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; and let those who love Your salvation say without ending, Let God be magnified.

title: Psalms 70:5
text: But I [am] poor and needy; make haste to me, O God; You [are] my help and my deliverer; O LORD, wait no longer!

title: Psalms 71:1
text: In You, O LORD, I put my trust; let me never be put to shame.

title: Psalms 71:2
text: Deliver me in Your righteousness, and cause me to escape; bow down Your ear to me, and save me.

title: Psalms 71:3
text: Be a rock of refuge for me, to which I may always go; You have commanded to save me; for You [are] my Rock and my Fortress.

title: Psalms 71:4
text: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel [man].

title: Psalms 71:5
text: For You [are] my hope, O Lord God, my trust from my youth.

title: Psalms 71:6
text: On You I have rested from the womb; You are He who took me out of my mother's bowels; my praise always [shall be] of You.

title: Psalms 71:7
text: I am like a wonder to many, but You [are] my strong tower.

title: Psalms 71:8
text: Let my mouth be filled [with] Your praise, [with] Your honor all the day.

title: Psalms 71:9
text: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails.

title: Psalms 71:10
text: For my enemies speak against me; and those who watch for my soul plot together,

title: Psalms 71:11
text: saying, God has forsaken him; pursue and take him, for [there is] none to deliver [him].

title: Psalms 71:12
text: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste for my help.

title: Psalms 71:13
text: Let them be ashamed; let those who are enemies of my soul be consumed; let them be covered [with] reproach and dishonor, those who seek my hurt.

title: Psalms 71:14
text: But I will hope without ceasing, and I will add more in all Your praise.

title: Psalms 71:15
text: My mouth shall show forth Your righteousness [and] Your salvation all the day; for I do not know how many they are.

title: Psalms 71:16
text: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will speak of Your righteousness, of Yours alone.

title: Psalms 71:17
text: O God, You have taught me from my youth; and before now I have declared Your wonderful works.

title: Psalms 71:18
text: And now when I am old and gray-headed, O God, do not leave me; until I have declared Your strength to [this] generation, and Your power to everyone who is to come.

title: Psalms 71:19
text: And Your righteousness, O God, [is] very high, who have done great things. O God, who [is] like You,

title: Psalms 71:20
text: who has shown me great and evil distresses; You will turn [me]; You will make me live. You will turn me from the depths of the earth, You will bring me up.

title: Psalms 71:21
text: You will increase my greatness and surround [and] comfort me on every side.

title: Psalms 71:22
text: I will also praise You with a harp. O my God, I will sing Your truth; to You I will sing with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.

title: Psalms 71:23
text: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing to You, and my soul, which You have redeemed.

title: Psalms 71:24
text: My tongue also shall muse on Your righteousness all the day long; for those who seek my evil have turned pale, they are brought to shame.

title: Psalms 72:1
text: A Psalm of Solomon. Give the King Your judgments, O God, and Your righteousness to the King's son.

title: Psalms 72:2
text: He will judge Your people in righteousness, and Your poor with judgment.

title: Psalms 72:3
text: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills by righteousness.

title: Psalms 72:4
text: He shall judge the poor of the people; He shall save the children of the needy, and shall crush in pieces the cruel one.

title: Psalms 72:5
text: They shall fear You [as long as] the sun and moon [endure], throughout all generations.

title: Psalms 72:6
text: He shall come down like rain on the mown grass, like showers [that] water the earth.

title: Psalms 72:7
text: In His days the righteous shall flourish; and abundance of peace, until the moon [is] not.

title: Psalms 72:8
text: He shall also have the rule from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

title: Psalms 72:9
text: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before Him; and His enemies shall lick the dust.

title: Psalms 72:10
text: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents; the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

title: Psalms 72:11
text: Yes, all kings shall fall down before Him; all nations shall serve Him.

title: Psalms 72:12
text: For He shall deliver the needy when he cries; and the poor [with] no helper.

title: Psalms 72:13
text: He shall have pity on the poor and needy and shall save the souls of the needy.

title: Psalms 72:14
text: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence; and their blood shall be precious in His sight.

title: Psalms 72:15
text: And He shall live, and to Him shall be given the gold of Sheba; and prayer shall always be made for Him; He shall bless Him all the day long.

title: Psalms 72:16
text: There shall be a fullness of grain in the earth on the top of the mountains; its fruit shall shake like Lebanon, and [they] of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

title: Psalms 72:17
text: His name shall endure forever; His name shall be continued as long as the sun; and [men] shall be blessed in Him; all nations shall call Him blessed.

title: Psalms 72:18
text: Blessed [is] the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does wonderful things.

title: Psalms 72:19
text: And blessed [be] His glorious name forever; and all the earth is filled [with] His glory! Amen and Amen.

title: Psalms 72:20
text: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

title: Psalms 73:1
text: A Psalm of Asaph. Truly God [is] good to Israel, to the pure of heart.

title: Psalms 73:2
text: And I, my foot had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.

title: Psalms 73:3
text: For I was jealous of the proud, [when] I saw the peace of the wicked.

title: Psalms 73:4
text: For [there are] no bands in their death; but their strength [is] fat.

title: Psalms 73:5
text: They [are] not in trouble [like other] men; neither are they plagued like other men.

title: Psalms 73:6
text: Therefore pride enchains them; violence covers them [like] a robe.

title: Psalms 73:7
text: Their eyes stand out with fatness; they have more than the heart could imagine.

title: Psalms 73:8
text: They scoff and speak in malice of cruelty; from on high they speak.

title: Psalms 73:9
text: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walks through the earth.

title: Psalms 73:10
text: Therefore His people return here, and waters of a full [cup are] wrung out to them.

title: Psalms 73:11
text: And they say, How does God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?

title: Psalms 73:12
text: Behold, these [are] the ungodly, who are at ease in the world; they increase [in] riches.

title: Psalms 73:13
text: Surely I have made my heart pure [in] vain, and washed my hands in innocence.

title: Psalms 73:14
text: For all the day long I have been plagued, and chastened every morning.

title: Psalms 73:15
text: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I would deceive a generation of Your sons.

title: Psalms 73:16
text: When I thought deeply in order to understand this, it [was] painful for me,

title: Psalms 73:17
text: until I went into the sanctuary of God; [then] I understood their end.

title: Psalms 73:18
text: Surely You set them in slippery places; You cast them down into ruin.

title: Psalms 73:19
text: How have they been [brought] into grief, as in a moment! They are fully eaten up with terrors,

title: Psalms 73:20
text: like a dream when [one] awakens; so, O LORD, when You awake, You shall despise their image.

title: Psalms 73:21
text: For my heart was grieved and I was pricked [in] my reins.

title: Psalms 73:22
text: So foolish [was] I, and I did not know; I was [like] a beast before You.

title: Psalms 73:23
text: But I [am] always with You; You have held [me] by my right hand.

title: Psalms 73:24
text: You shall lead me with Your counsel, and afterward receive me [to] glory.

title: Psalms 73:25
text: Whom have I in Heaven? And besides You I desire none on earth.

title: Psalms 73:26
text: My flesh and my heart fail; [but] God [is] the strength of my heart, and my part forever.

title: Psalms 73:27
text: For lo, those who are far from You shall perish; You have destroyed all who go lusting away from You.

title: Psalms 73:28
text: And I, [it is] good for me to draw near to God; I have put my trust in the LORD God, to declare all Your works.

title: Psalms 74:1
text: An Instruction of Asaph. O God, have You cast [us] off forever? Will Your anger smoke against the sheep of Your pasture?

title: Psalms 74:2
text: Remember Your congregation, [which] You have purchased of old, the rod of Your inheritance which You have redeemed; this mount Zion in [which] You have dwelt.

title: Psalms 74:3
text: Lift up Your feet to the never-ending ruins, even all that the enemy has done wickedly in the sanctuary.

title: Psalms 74:4
text: Your enemies roar in the midst of Your congregation; they set up their own banners [for] signs.

title: Psalms 74:5
text: He is known as one bringing axes on high, on the thick trees.

title: Psalms 74:6
text: And now all its carvings too, they break down with axes and hammers.

title: Psalms 74:7
text: They have cast fire into Your sanctuary; they have defiled the dwelling-place of Your name to the ground.

title: Psalms 74:8
text: They said in their hearts, Together let us rage against them; they have burned up all God's meeting-places in the land.

title: Psalms 74:9
text: We did not see our signs; [there is] no prophet any more; neither [is there] among us any who knows how long.

title: Psalms 74:10
text: O God, how long shall the enemy speak evil? Shall the enemy blaspheme Your name forever?

title: Psalms 74:11
text: Why do You withdraw Your hand, even Your right hand? Draw [it] out of Your bosom.

title: Psalms 74:12
text: For God [is] my king of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth,

title: Psalms 74:13
text: You divide the sea by Your strength; You break the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters.

title: Psalms 74:14
text: You cracked open the heads of leviathan, and gave him to [be food] to the people living in the wilderness.

title: Psalms 74:15
text: You divide the fountain and the flood; You dry up mighty rivers.

title: Psalms 74:16
text: The day [is] Yours, the night also [is] Yours; You have prepared the light and the sun.

title: Psalms 74:17
text: You have set all the borders of the earth; You have made summer and winter.

title: Psalms 74:18
text: Remember this, the enemy has cursed, O LORD, and the foolish people have blasphemed Your name.

title: Psalms 74:19
text: Do not deliver the soul of Your turtle dove to the multitude; forget not the congregation of Your poor forever.

title: Psalms 74:20
text: Look to the covenant; for the dark places of the earth are full of the houses of evil.

title: Psalms 74:21
text: Oh let not the ill-treated ones return ashamed; let the poor and needy praise Your name.

title: Psalms 74:22
text: Arise, O God, plead Your own cause; remember how the foolish man curses You daily.

title: Psalms 74:23
text: Forget not the voice of Your enemies; the noise of those who rise up against You keeps on increasing.

title: Psalms 75:1
text: To the Chief Musician. Do not destroy. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song. To You, O God, we have given thanks, to You we have given thanks; for Your name is near, Your wonderful works declared.

title: Psalms 75:2
text: When I take the appointed time, I will judge uprightly.

title: Psalms 75:3
text: The earth and all its people are melting away; I hold up its pillars. Selah.

title: Psalms 75:4
text: I said to the proud, Do not boast; and to the wicked, Do not lift up the horn;

title: Psalms 75:5
text: do not lift up your horn on high; [nor] speak [with] a stiff neck.

title: Psalms 75:6
text: For lifting up [comes] neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

title: Psalms 75:7
text: But God [is] the judge; [He] puts down one and sets up another.

title: Psalms 75:8
text: For in the hand of the LORD [there is] a cup, and the wine is red; it is fully mixed; and He pours out from it; but the dregs of it, all the wicked of the earth shall drain its dregs [and] drink.

title: Psalms 75:9
text: But I will declare forever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

title: Psalms 75:10
text: Also I will cut off all the horns of the wicked; [but] the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

title: Psalms 76:1
text: To the Chief Musician. For stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song. God [is] known in Judah, His name is great in Israel.

title: Psalms 76:2
text: And His abode is in Salem; and His dwelling-place in Zion.

title: Psalms 76:3
text: There He broke the fiery arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

title: Psalms 76:4
text: You [are] more glorious [and] excellent than the mountains of prey.

title: Psalms 76:5
text: The stouthearted have been stripped; they slept their sleep; and none of the men of might have found their hands.

title: Psalms 76:6
text: By Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the horse and the chariot have sunk into a sleep.

title: Psalms 76:7
text: You, [even] You, [are] terrifying, and who can stand when once You are angry?

title: Psalms 76:8
text: You cause judgment to be heard from Heaven; the earth feared and was still,

title: Psalms 76:9
text: when God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

title: Psalms 76:10
text: Surely the wrath of man shall praise You; the wrath that is left, You shall bind up.

title: Psalms 76:11
text: Vow, and pay to the LORD your God; let all that are around Him bring presents to the Fearful One.

title: Psalms 76:12
text: He shall cut off the spirit in princes; [He is] feared by the kings of the earth.

title: Psalms 77:1
text: To the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I cried to God with my voice, to God [is] my voice; and He gave ear to me.

title: Psalms 77:2
text: In the day of my trouble I sought the LORD; my hand was poured in the night, and ceased not; my soul refused to be comforted.

title: Psalms 77:3
text: I remembered God, and was troubled; I complained, and my spirit fainted. Selah.

title: Psalms 77:4
text: You keep my eyes awake; I am troubled and I cannot speak.

title: Psalms 77:5
text: I have thought on the days of old, the years of ages [past].

title: Psalms 77:6
text: I remember my song in the night; I speak with my own heart, and my spirit carefully searches.

title: Psalms 77:7
text: Will the Lord cast off forever? And will He be favorable no more?

title: Psalms 77:8
text: Is His mercy gone forever? Has [His] word failed for all generations?

title: Psalms 77:9
text: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has He in anger shut up His tender mercies? Selah.

title: Psalms 77:10
text: And I said, This [is] my weakness, the years of the right hand of the Most High.

title: Psalms 77:11
text: I will remember the works of the LORD; surely I will remember Your wonders of old.

title: Psalms 77:12
text: I will also think on all Your work, and talk of Your doings.

title: Psalms 77:13
text: Your way, O God, [is] in holiness; who [is] so great a God as our God?

title: Psalms 77:14
text: You [are] the God who does wonders; You have declared Your strength among the people.

title: Psalms 77:15
text: You have with [Your] arm redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

title: Psalms 77:16
text: The waters saw You, O God, the waters saw You; they were afraid; the depths also were troubled.

title: Psalms 77:17
text: The clouds poured out water; the skies sent out a sound; Your arrows also flew here and there.

title: Psalms 77:18
text: The voice of Your thunder [was] in the sky; the lightnings lit up the world; the earth trembled and shook.

title: Psalms 77:19
text: Your way [is] in the sea, and Your path in the great waters, and Your footsteps are not known.

title: Psalms 77:20
text: You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

title: Psalms 78:1
text: An instruction of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, [to] my law; bow down your ears to the words of my mouth.

title: Psalms 78:2
text: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will speak dark sayings of old,

title: Psalms 78:3
text: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

title: Psalms 78:4
text: We will not hide [them] from their sons, showing to the generations to come the praises of the LORD, and His strength, and His wonderful works that He has done.

title: Psalms 78:5
text: For He set up a testimony in Jacob, and ordered a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers, that they should teach them to their sons;

title: Psalms 78:6
text: so that the generation to come might know; sons shall be born, and they shall arise [and] tell their sons,

title: Psalms 78:7
text: so that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep His commandments;

title: Psalms 78:8
text: and might not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation [that] did not set their heart aright, and whose spirit was not faithful with God.

title: Psalms 78:9
text: The sons of Ephraim, armed shooters of bows, turned back in the day of battle.

title: Psalms 78:10
text: They did not keep the covenant of God, and refused to walk in His law.

title: Psalms 78:11
text: And they forgot His works and His wonders which He had shown them.

title: Psalms 78:12
text: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, [in] the field of Zoan.

title: Psalms 78:13
text: He divided the sea and caused them to pass through; and He made the waters to stand in a heap.

title: Psalms 78:14
text: And in the daytime He led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

title: Psalms 78:15
text: He split the rocks in the wilderness, and let [them] drink, as [from] the great depths.

title: Psalms 78:16
text: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

title: Psalms 78:17
text: And they sinned still more against Him, by provoking the Most High in the wilderness.

title: Psalms 78:18
text: And they tempted God in their heart by asking food for their lust.

title: Psalms 78:19
text: And they spoke against God; they said, Can God set a table in the wilderness?

title: Psalms 78:20
text: Behold! He struck the rock so that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed. Can He also give bread? Can He provide flesh for His people?

title: Psalms 78:21
text: Therefore the LORD heard, and was made furious; so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel,

title: Psalms 78:22
text: because they did not believe in God, and did not trust in His salvation;

title: Psalms 78:23
text: though He had commanded the clouds from above, and had opened the doors of the heavens;

title: Psalms 78:24
text: and had rained down manna on them to eat, and He gave them of the grain of the heavens.

title: Psalms 78:25
text: Man ate the food of the mighty; He sent them meat to the full.

title: Psalms 78:26
text: He caused an east [wind] to blow in the sky; and by His power He brought in the south [wind].

title: Psalms 78:27
text: and He also rained flesh on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea;

title: Psalms 78:28
text: and He let [them] fall in the middle of their camp, all around their tents.

title: Psalms 78:29
text: So they ate, and were filled to the full; for He gave them their own desire.

title: Psalms 78:30
text: They were not turned away from their lust, but while their food [was] still in their mouths,

title: Psalms 78:31
text: the wrath of God came on them and killed the fattest of them, and struck down the chosen of Israel.

title: Psalms 78:32
text: For all this they still sinned, and did not believe because of His wonderful works.

title: Psalms 78:33
text: Therefore He ended their days in vanity and their years in trouble.

title: Psalms 78:34
text: When He killed them, then they looked for Him; and they turned back and sought after God.

title: Psalms 78:35
text: And they remembered that God [was] their rock, and the Most High God was their redeemer.

title: Psalms 78:36
text: But they flattered Him with their mouths, and they lied to Him with their tongues.

title: Psalms 78:37
text: For their heart was not right with Him, neither were they faithful in His covenant.

title: Psalms 78:38
text: But He, full of pity, forgave their iniquity, and did not destroy [them]; yea, many times He turned His anger away, and did not stir up all His wrath.

title: Psalms 78:39
text: For He remembered that they [were but] flesh, a wind that passes away and does not come again.

title: Psalms 78:40
text: How often they provoked Him in the wilderness, and grieved Him in the desert!

title: Psalms 78:41
text: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and pained to the Holy One of Israel.

title: Psalms 78:42
text: They did not remember His hand, the day when He delivered them from the enemy;

title: Psalms 78:43
text: how He had set His signs in Egypt, and His wonders in the fields of Zoan.

title: Psalms 78:44
text: He turned their rivers into blood, and their floods, [so that] they could not drink.

title: Psalms 78:45
text: He sent different kinds of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

title: Psalms 78:46
text: He also gave their crops to the stripping locust, and their labor to the locust.

title: Psalms 78:47
text: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with sleet.

title: Psalms 78:48
text: He gave up their cattle to the hail, and their flocks to bolts of fire.

title: Psalms 78:49
text: He sent on them the heat of His anger, wrath and fury and trouble, by sending evil angels.

title: Psalms 78:50
text: He made a way to His anger; He did not save their soul from death, but gave their life over to the plague,

title: Psalms 78:51
text: and struck all the first-born in Egypt, the first of the strong in the tents of Ham;

title: Psalms 78:52
text: and led His people forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

title: Psalms 78:53
text: And He led them on safely, so that they did not fear; but the sea flooded over their enemies.

title: Psalms 78:54
text: And He brought them within His own holy border, this mountain, [which] His right hand had bought.

title: Psalms 78:55
text: He also cast out the nations before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

title: Psalms 78:56
text: Yet they tempted and provoked the Most High God, and kept not His testimonies;

title: Psalms 78:57
text: but they turned back, and acted unfaithfully like their fathers; they were turned aside like a deceiving bow.

title: Psalms 78:58
text: For they provoked Him to anger with their high places, and moved Him to jealousy with their carved images.

title: Psalms 78:59
text: When God heard, He was angry, and turned away from Israel;

title: Psalms 78:60
text: so that He left the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent [which] He placed among men,

title: Psalms 78:61
text: and delivered His strength into captivity, and His glory into the enemy's hands.

title: Psalms 78:62
text: He also gave His people over to the sword, and was angry with His inheritance.

title: Psalms 78:63
text: The fire burned up their young men; and their maidens were not given in marriage.

title: Psalms 78:64
text: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows were not able to weep.

title: Psalms 78:65
text: Then the Lord awakened like one out of sleep, like a mighty man rejoicing with wine.

title: Psalms 78:66
text: And He drove His enemies backward; He put them to a never-ending shame.

title: Psalms 78:67
text: And He refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim;

title: Psalms 78:68
text: but chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which He loved.

title: Psalms 78:69
text: And He built His holy place like high [palaces], like the earth which He has founded forever.

title: Psalms 78:70
text: He also chose David His servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

title: Psalms 78:71
text: from following the ewes great with young He brought him to feed Jacob His people, and Israel His inheritance.

title: Psalms 78:72
text: And he fed them according to the pureness of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

title: Psalms 79:1
text: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the nations have come into Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple; they have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

title: Psalms 79:2
text: They have given the dead bodies of Your servants [as] food for the birds of the heavens, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.

title: Psalms 79:3
text: They have shed their blood like water round about Jerusalem, and none to bury.

title: Psalms 79:4
text: We have become a shame to our neighbors, a scorn and mockery to those who are around us.

title: Psalms 79:5
text: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Shall Your jealousy burn like fire?

title: Psalms 79:6
text: Pour out Your wrath on the nations who have not known You, and on the kingdoms who have not called on Your name.

title: Psalms 79:7
text: For [they have] eaten up Jacob, and wasted his dwelling-place.

title: Psalms 79:8
text: O do not remember against us our former sins; let Your tender mercies meet us quickly; for we are brought very low.

title: Psalms 79:9
text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; and deliver us, and atone for our sins, for Your name's sake.

title: Psalms 79:10
text: Why should the nations say, Where [is] their God? Let Him be known among the nations before our eyes [by] the revenging of the blood of Your servants [which is] shed.

title: Psalms 79:11
text: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before You; according to the greatness of Your power, leave a remnant of those who are to die,

title: Psalms 79:12
text: and give to our neighbors their curse sevenfold into their bosom, the curse with which they have cursed You, O Lord.

title: Psalms 79:13
text: Then we, Your people and sheep of Your pasture, will give You thanks forever; we will show forth Your praise to all generations.

title: Psalms 80:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Testimony Concerning the Lilies. A Psalm of Asaph. Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, You who lead Joseph like a flock; You dwelling between the cherubs, shine forth.

title: Psalms 80:2
text: Stir up Your strength before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, and come, save us.

title: Psalms 80:3
text: Turn us again, O God, and cause Your face to shine, and we shall be saved!

title: Psalms 80:4
text: O LORD God of hosts, how long will You be angry against the prayer of Your people?

title: Psalms 80:5
text: You feed them with the bread of tears; and give them tears to drink in great measure.

title: Psalms 80:6
text: You make us a strife for our neighbors; and our enemies laugh among themselves.

title: Psalms 80:7
text: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause Your face to shine; and we shall be saved.

title: Psalms 80:8
text: You have brought a vine out of Egypt; You have cast out the nations and planted it.

title: Psalms 80:9
text: You cleared before it, and caused it to take deep root; and it filled the land.

title: Psalms 80:10
text: The hills were covered [with] its shadow, and its boughs [were as] the great cedars.

title: Psalms 80:11
text: It sent out its boughs to the sea, and its branches to the river.

title: Psalms 80:12
text: Why have You broken down its hedges, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

title: Psalms 80:13
text: The boar out of the wood wastes it, and the wild beast of the field eats it.

title: Psalms 80:14
text: Return, we beg You, O God of hosts; look down from Heaven, and behold, and visit this vine,

title: Psalms 80:15
text: and the vineyard which Your right hand has planted, and the Son [that] You make strong for Yourself.

title: Psalms 80:16
text: [It is] burned with fire, and cut down; they perish at the rebuke of Your holy face.

title: Psalms 80:17
text: Let Your hand be on the Man of Your right hand, on the Son of man [whom] You have made strong for Yourself.

title: Psalms 80:18
text: So we will not go back from You; make us live, and we will call on Your name.

title: Psalms 80:19
text: Turn us again, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine, and we shall be saved.

title: Psalms 81:1
text: To the Chief Musician. On Gittith, A Psalm of Asaph. Sing aloud to God our strength; shout for joy to the God of Jacob.

title: Psalms 81:2
text: Lift up a psalm, and bring the timbrel here, the pleasing lyre and harp.

title: Psalms 81:3
text: Blow the ram's horn in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

title: Psalms 81:4
text: For this [was] a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

title: Psalms 81:5
text: This He ordained in Joseph [for] a testimony, when He went out over the land of Egypt; I heard a language I understood not.

title: Psalms 81:6
text: I removed his shoulder from the burden; his hands were delivered from the pots.

title: Psalms 81:7
text: You called in trouble, and I delivered you; I answered you in the secret place of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

title: Psalms 81:8
text: Hear, O My people, and I will testify to you; O Israel, if you will listen to Me,

title: Psalms 81:9
text: there shall be no strange god in you; nor shall you worship any strange god.

title: Psalms 81:10
text: I [am] the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt; open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

title: Psalms 81:11
text: But My people would not listen to My voice, and Israel would have none of Me.

title: Psalms 81:12
text: So I gave them up to the stubbornness of their own hearts; [and] they walked in their own conceits.

title: Psalms 81:13
text: Oh that My people had listened to Me, [and] Israel had walked in My ways!

title: Psalms 81:14
text: I would soon have humbled their enemies, and would have turned My hand against their foes.

title: Psalms 81:15
text: The haters of the LORD would have been found liars to Him, and their time would have lasted forever.

title: Psalms 81:16
text: And He would have fed them also with the finest of the wheat; and [with] honey out of the rock I would have satisfied you.

title: Psalms 82:1
text: A Psalm of Asaph. God stands in the congregation of God; in the midst of the gods He judges.

title: Psalms 82:2
text: How long will you judge unjustly and lift up the faces of the wicked? Selah.

title: Psalms 82:3
text: Defend the poor and fatherless; do justice to the afflicted and needy.

title: Psalms 82:4
text: Deliver the poor and needy; save [them] out of the hand of the wicked.

title: Psalms 82:5
text: They neither know nor will understand; they walk on in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

title: Psalms 82:6
text: I have said, You [are] gods; and all of you sons of the Most High.

title: Psalms 82:7
text: But you shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

title: Psalms 82:8
text: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for You shall inherit in all nations.

title: Psalms 83:1
text: A Song. A Psalm of Asaph. Keep not silence, O God; do not be speechless, and be not still, O God.

title: Psalms 83:2
text: For lo, Your enemies roar; and those who hate You have lifted up their head.

title: Psalms 83:3
text: They take shrewd counsel against Your people, and plot against Your hidden ones.

title: Psalms 83:4
text: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from [being] a nation, so that the name Israel may be remembered no more.

title: Psalms 83:5
text: For with one heart they have plotted together; they have made a covenant against You--

title: Psalms 83:6
text: the tents of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarites;

title: Psalms 83:7
text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the people of Tyre;

title: Psalms 83:8
text: and Assyria has joined with them; they have helped the sons of Lot. Selah.

title: Psalms 83:9
text: Do to them as [to] Midian, as [to] Sisera, as [to] Jabin at the torrent Kishon;

title: Psalms 83:10
text: who perished at Endor; they became [as] dung for the earth.

title: Psalms 83:11
text: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb; yea, all their princes like Zebah, and like Zalmunna;

title: Psalms 83:12
text: who said, Let us take possession for ourselves of the houses of God.

title: Psalms 83:13
text: O my God, make them like a wheel; like the stubble before the wind.

title: Psalms 83:14
text: As the fire burns a forest, and as the flame sets the mountains on fire,

title: Psalms 83:15
text: so pursue them with Your tempest, and make them afraid with Your storm.

title: Psalms 83:16
text: Fill their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.

title: Psalms 83:17
text: Let them be ashamed and troubled forever; yea, let them be put to shame, and lost;

title: Psalms 83:18
text: so that [men] may know that Your name is JEHOVAH, that You alone [are] the Most High over all the earth.

title: Psalms 84:1
text: To the Chief Musician. On Gittith. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. How lovely [are] Your tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

title: Psalms 84:2
text: My soul longs, yea, even faints for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh shout for joy to the living God.

title: Psalms 84:3
text: Even the sparrow has found a house, and the swallow a nest for herself where she may lay her young, Your altars, O LORD of hosts, my king and my God.

title: Psalms 84:4
text: Blessed [are] they who dwell in Your house; they will still praise You. Selah.

title: Psalms 84:5
text: Blessed [is] the man [whose] strength [is] in You; [Your] ways [are] in their hearts.

title: Psalms 84:6
text: Passing through the valley of weeping, they will make it a fountain; the early rain also covers [it with] blessings.

title: Psalms 84:7
text: They go from strength to strength, appearing in Zion before God.

title: Psalms 84:8
text: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

title: Psalms 84:9
text: Behold, O God, our shield, and look on the face of Your anointed.

title: Psalms 84:10
text: For a day in Your courts [is] better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than dwell in the tents of wickedness.

title: Psalms 84:11
text: For the LORD God [is] a sun and shield; the LORD will give grace and glory; no good [thing] will He withhold from those who walk uprightly.

title: Psalms 84:12
text: O LORD of hosts, blessed [is] the man who trusts in You.

title: Psalms 85:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. O LORD, You have been gracious to Your land; You have brought back the captivity of Jacob.

title: Psalms 85:2
text: You have forgiven the iniquity of Your people; You have covered all their sins. Selah.

title: Psalms 85:3
text: You have taken away all Your wrath; You have turned from the heat of Your anger.

title: Psalms 85:4
text: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause Your anger toward us to cease.

title: Psalms 85:5
text: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?

title: Psalms 85:6
text: Will You not give us life again, so that Your people may rejoice in You?

title: Psalms 85:7
text: Show us Your mercy, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.

title: Psalms 85:8
text: I will hear what God the LORD will speak; for He will speak peace to His people, and to His saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

title: Psalms 85:9
text: Surely His salvation [is] near those that fear Him, so that glory may dwell in our land.

title: Psalms 85:10
text: Mercy and truth have met together; righteousness and peace have kissed [each other].

title: Psalms 85:11
text: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from Heaven.

title: Psalms 85:12
text: Yea, the LORD shall give good; and our land shall yield its increase.

title: Psalms 85:13
text: Righteousness shall go before Him and shall set [us] in the way of His steps.

title: Psalms 86:1
text: A Prayer of David. Bow down Your ear, O LORD, hear me; for I [am] poor and needy.

title: Psalms 86:2
text: Preserve my soul; for I [am] holy; O You my God, save Your servant who trusts in You.

title: Psalms 86:3
text: Be merciful to me, O Lord; for I cry to You daily.

title: Psalms 86:4
text: Give joy to the soul of Your servant; for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

title: Psalms 86:5
text: For You, Lord, [are] good and ready to forgive, and rich in mercy to all those who call on You.

title: Psalms 86:6
text: Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer; and attend to the voice of my prayers.

title: Psalms 86:7
text: In the day of my trouble I will call on You; for You will answer me.

title: Psalms 86:8
text: Among the gods [there is] none like You, O Lord; non [are] like Your works.

title: Psalms 86:9
text: All nations whom You have made shall come and worship before You, O Lord, and shall glorify Your name.

title: Psalms 86:10
text: For You [are] great and do wonderful things; You alone [are] God.

title: Psalms 86:11
text: Teach me Your way, O LORD; I will walk in Your truth; my heart rejoices to fear Your name.

title: Psalms 86:12
text: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify Your name forevermore.

title: Psalms 86:13
text: For great [is] Your mercy toward me; and You have delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

title: Psalms 86:14
text: O God, the proud have risen against me, and the company of violent [men] have sought after my life, and have not set You before them.

title: Psalms 86:15
text: But You, O God, [are] God full of pity, and gracious, long-suffering, and rich in mercy and truth.

title: Psalms 86:16
text: Oh turn to me, and have mercy on me; give Your strength to Your servant, and save the son of Your handmaid.

title: Psalms 86:17
text: Show me a token for good, so that they who hate me may see and be ashamed; because You, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

title: Psalms 87:1
text: A Psalm for the sons of Korah, A Song. His foundation [is] in the holy mountains.

title: Psalms 87:2
text: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

title: Psalms 87:3
text: Glorious things [are] spoken of you, O city of God. Selah.

title: Psalms 87:4
text: I will mention Rahab and Babylon to those who know me; behold, Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this [man] was born there.

title: Psalms 87:5
text: And to Zion it shall be said, [This] man and [that] man was born in her; and the Highest shall establish her.

title: Psalms 87:6
text: The LORD shall count, in recording the peoples, [that] this [man] was born there. Selah.

title: Psalms 87:7
text: And the singers, the players of the pipe: all my springs [are] in You!

title: Psalms 88:1
text: A Song. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. To the Chief Musician. On Mahalath, to make humble. A Poem of Heman the Ezrahite. O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before You.

title: Psalms 88:2
text: Let my prayer come before You; bow down Your ear to my cry.

title: Psalms 88:3
text: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near the grave.

title: Psalms 88:4
text: I am counted with those who go down to the Pit; I am like a feeble man;

title: Psalms 88:5
text: free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom You remember no more; and by Your hand they are cut off.

title: Psalms 88:6
text: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

title: Psalms 88:7
text: Your wrath lies hard on me, and You have afflicted [me] with all Your waves. Selah.

title: Psalms 88:8
text: You have taken my friends away from me; You have made me a hateful thing to them. [I am] shut up, and I cannot go out.

title: Psalms 88:9
text: My eye mourns because of affliction; O LORD, I have called daily on You; I have stretched out my hands to You.

title: Psalms 88:10
text: For will You do wonders to the dead? Shall the dead rise [and] praise You? Selah.

title: Psalms 88:11
text: Shall Your loving-kindness be declared in the grave? [Or] Your faithfulness in ruin?

title: Psalms 88:12
text: Shall Your wonders be known in the dark, and Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

title: Psalms 88:13
text: But to You I have cried, O LORD; and in the morning my prayer shall go before You.

title: Psalms 88:14
text: O LORD, why do You cast off my soul? [Why] do You hide Your face from me?

title: Psalms 88:15
text: I [am] afflicted and ready to die from my youth up; while I suffer Your terrors, I pine away.

title: Psalms 88:16
text: Your fierce wrath goes over me; Your terrors have cut me off.

title: Psalms 88:17
text: They surrounded me like waters all the day long; they have come together around me.

title: Psalms 88:18
text: You have taken lover and friend far from me, [and] those who know me into darkness.

title: Psalms 89:1
text: A Poem of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the mercies of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will make known Your faithfulness to all generations.

title: Psalms 89:2
text: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up forever; You shall establish Your faithfulness in the heavens.

title: Psalms 89:3
text: I have cut a covenant with My chosen; I have sworn to David My servant,

title: Psalms 89:4
text: Your seed will I establish forever, and build up your throne to all generations. Selah.

title: Psalms 89:5
text: And the heavens shall praise Your wonders, O LORD, Your faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

title: Psalms 89:6
text: For who in the sky [or] can be ranked [with] the LORD? Who among the mighty is like the LORD?

title: Psalms 89:7
text: God is greatly to be feared in the congregation of the saints, and to be adored by all around Him.

title: Psalms 89:8
text: O LORD God of hosts, who [is] a strong LORD like You? And Your faithfulness is round about You?

title: Psalms 89:9
text: You rule the raging of the sea; when its waves arise, You still them.

title: Psalms 89:10
text: You have broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; You have scattered Your enemies with Your strong arm.

title: Psalms 89:11
text: The heavens [are] Yours, the earth also [is] Yours; You have founded the world and its fullness.

title: Psalms 89:12
text: The north and the south, You have created them; Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in Your name.

title: Psalms 89:13
text: You have a mighty arm; Your hand is strong, [and] Your right hand is high.

title: Psalms 89:14
text: Justice and judgment [are] the foundation of Your throne; mercy and truth shall go before Your face.

title: Psalms 89:15
text: Blessed [is] the people that knows the joyful sound; they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of Your face.

title: Psalms 89:16
