text: In Your name they shall rejoice all the day; and in Your righteousness they shall be lifted up.

title: Psalms 89:17
text: For You [are] the glory of their strength; and in Your favor our horn shall be lifted up.

title: Psalms 89:18
text: For the LORD [is] our shield; yea, our king [is] the Holy One of Israel.

title: Psalms 89:19
text: Then You spoke in a vision to Your holy one, and You said, I have laid help on a mighty one; I have lifted up a chosen one out of the people.

title: Psalms 89:20
text: I have found David, My servant; with My holy oil I have anointed him.

title: Psalms 89:21
text: My hand shall be always with him; My arm also shall make him strong.

title: Psalms 89:22
text: The enemy shall not use force on him, nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

title: Psalms 89:23
text: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague those who hate him.

title: Psalms 89:24
text: But My faithfulness and My mercy [shall be] with him; and in My name his horn [shall be] lifted up.

title: Psalms 89:25
text: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

title: Psalms 89:26
text: He shall cry to Me, My Father, You [are] my God, and the rock of my salvation.

title: Psalms 89:27
text: And I will make him [My] first-born, higher than the kings of the earth.

title: Psalms 89:28
text: I will keep My mercy for him forever, and My covenant shall stand fast with him.

title: Psalms 89:29
text: Also I have set his seed forever, and his throne as the days of the heavens.

title: Psalms 89:30
text: If his children forsake My law, and do not walk in My judgments;

title: Psalms 89:31
text: if they profane My statutes, and do not keep My commandments;

title: Psalms 89:32
text: then I will visit their wickedness with the rod, and their sin with stripes.

title: Psalms 89:33
text: But I will not completely take My loving-kindness from him, and I will not be false in My faithfulness.

title: Psalms 89:34
text: I will not break My covenant, nor change the thing that has gone out of My lips.

title: Psalms 89:35
text: Once I have sworn by My holiness that I will not lie to David.

title: Psalms 89:36
text: His seed shall endure forever, and his throne as the sun before Me.

title: Psalms 89:37
text: It shall be established forever like the moon, and [like] a faithful witness in the heavens. Selah.

title: Psalms 89:38
text: But You have cast off and rejected [us]; You have been angry with Your anointed.

title: Psalms 89:39
text: You have turned away from the covenant of Your servant; You have defiled his crown to the ground.

title: Psalms 89:40
text: You have broken down all his hedges; You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

title: Psalms 89:41
text: All who pass by the way plunder him; he is a curse to his neighbors.

title: Psalms 89:42
text: You have set up the right hand of his enemies; You have made all [his] enemies rejoice.

title: Psalms 89:43
text: You also have turned back the edge of his sword and have not made him stand in the battle.

title: Psalms 89:44
text: You have made his glory to cease, and have thrown his throne down to the ground.

title: Psalms 89:45
text: The days of his youth You have shortened; You have covered him [with] shame. Selah.

title: Psalms 89:46
text: How long, LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Shall Your wrath burn like fire?

title: Psalms 89:47
text: Remember, I pray, how short my time is; why have You made all men in vain?

title: Psalms 89:48
text: What man lives and never sees death? Shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

title: Psalms 89:49
text: O Lord, where [are] Your former loving-kindnesses [which] You swore to David in Your truth?

title: Psalms 89:50
text: Remember, Lord, the scorn of Your servants; [how] I bear in my bosom the insult of all the mighty people,

title: Psalms 89:51
text: [with] which Your enemies have cursed, O LORD; [with] which they have cursed the footsteps of Your anointed.

title: Psalms 89:52
text: Blessed [is] the LORD forevermore. Amen and Amen.

title: Psalms 90:1
text: A Prayer of Moses, the man of God. O LORD, You have been our dwelling-place in all generations.

title: Psalms 90:2
text: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever You had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting You [are] God.

title: Psalms 90:3
text: You turn man to dust, and say, Return, sons of men.

title: Psalms 90:4
text: For a thousand years in Your sight [are] as yesterday when it is past, and [as] a watch in the night.

title: Psalms 90:5
text: You carry them away as with a flood; they are [as] a sleep; in the morning [they are] like grass which grows up.

title: Psalms 90:6
text: In the morning it sprouts and shoots up; in the evening it is cut down, and dries up.

title: Psalms 90:7
text: For we are burned up by Your anger, and by Your wrath we are troubled.

title: Psalms 90:8
text: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret [sins] in the light of Your face.

title: Psalms 90:9
text: For all our days pass away in Your wrath; we finish our years like a murmur.

title: Psalms 90:10
text: The days of our years [are] threescore years and ten; and if by strength they [are] fourscore years, yet their pride [is] labor and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

title: Psalms 90:11
text: Who knows the power of Your anger? And as Your fear [is, so is] Your wrath.

title: Psalms 90:12
text: So teach us to number our days, so that we may bring a heart of wisdom.

title: Psalms 90:13
text: Return, O LORD! How long? And give pity to Your servants.

title: Psalms 90:14
text: Satisfy us early with Your mercy, so that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

title: Psalms 90:15
text: Make us glad according to the days of our affliction, the years [in which] we have seen evil.

title: Psalms 90:16
text: Let Your work appear to Your servants, and Your glory to their sons.

title: Psalms 90:17
text: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be on us; and establish the work of our hands on us; yea, the work of our hands, establish it.

title: Psalms 91:1
text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High shall rest [under] the shadow of the Almighty.

title: Psalms 91:2
text: I will say of the LORD, my refuge and my fortress; my God; in Him I will trust.

title: Psalms 91:3
text: Surely He will deliver you from the fowler's trap [and] from the destroying plague.

title: Psalms 91:4
text: He shall cover you with His feathers, and under His wings you shall trust. His truth [shall be your] shield, and buckler.

title: Psalms 91:5
text: You shall not fear the terror by night; nor because of the arrow [that] flies by day;

title: Psalms 91:6
text: [nor] for the plague [that] walks in darkness, of the destruction laying waste at noonday.

title: Psalms 91:7
text: A thousand shall fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; it shall not come near you.

title: Psalms 91:8
text: Only with your eyes you shall look and see the reward of the wicked.

title: Psalms 91:9
text: Because You, O LORD, [are] My refuge; [if] you have made the Most High Your dwelling-place,

title: Psalms 91:10
text: no evil shall befall You, nor shall any plague come near Your dwelling.

title: Psalms 91:11
text: For He shall give His angels charge over You, to keep You in all Your ways.

title: Psalms 91:12
text: They shall bear You up in [their] hands, lest You dash your foot against a stone.

title: Psalms 91:13
text: You shall tread on the lion and adder; the young lion and the jackal You shall trample underfoot.

title: Psalms 91:14
text: Because He has set His love on Me, therefore I will deliver him; I will set Him on high, because He has known My name.

title: Psalms 91:15
text: He shall call on Me, and I will answer Him; I [will be] with Him in trouble; I will deliver Him, and honor Him.

title: Psalms 91:16
text: With long life I will satisfy him, and show him My salvation.

title: Psalms 92:1
text: A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day. [It is] good to give thanks to the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High;

title: Psalms 92:2
text: to show forth Your loving-kindness in the morning, and Your faithfulness every night;

title: Psalms 92:3
text: on the ten [strings], and on the harp, with sounding music on the lyre.

title: Psalms 92:4
text: For You, LORD, have made Me glad with Your work; I will triumph in the works of Your hands.

title: Psalms 92:5
text: O LORD, how great are Your works; Your purposes are very deep.

title: Psalms 92:6
text: A beastly man does not know; nor does a fool understand this.

title: Psalms 92:7
text: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity blossom, [it is] that they shall be destroyed forever;

title: Psalms 92:8
text: but You, LORD, are high forever.

title: Psalms 92:9
text: For, lo, Your enemies, O LORD; for lo, Your enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

title: Psalms 92:10
text: But You shall lift up my horn as the wild ox; and I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

title: Psalms 92:11
text: Also my eye shall see [my desire] on my enemies, and my ears shall hear the wicked who rise up against me.

title: Psalms 92:12
text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree; he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

title: Psalms 92:13
text: Those that are planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

title: Psalms 92:14
text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flowering;

title: Psalms 92:15
text: to show that the LORD [is] upright; [He is] my rock, and no unrighteousness [is] in Him.

title: Psalms 93:1
text: The LORD reigns, He is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength. He clothed Himself and the world is established; it shall not be shaken.

title: Psalms 93:2
text: Your throne [is] established of old; You [are] from everlasting.

title: Psalms 93:3
text: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voices; the floods lift up their waves.

title: Psalms 93:4
text: The LORD on high [is] mightier than the noise of many waters, than the mighty waves of the sea.

title: Psalms 93:5
text: Your testimonies are very sure; holiness becomes Your house forever, O LORD.

title: Psalms 94:1
text: O God of vengeance, Jehovah, God of vengeance, shine forth!

title: Psalms 94:2
text: Lift up Yourself, Judge of the earth; give a just repayment to the proud.

title: Psalms 94:3
text: How long [shall] the wicked, O LORD, how long shall the wicked exult?

title: Psalms 94:4
text: They gush; they speak impudent things; all the workers of iniquity speak proudly.

title: Psalms 94:5
text: They crush Your people, O LORD, and afflict Your inheritance.

title: Psalms 94:6
text: They kill the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

title: Psalms 94:7
text: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, nor shall the God of Jacob observe [it].

title: Psalms 94:8
text: Understand, you beastly ones among the people; and fools, when will you be wise?

title: Psalms 94:9
text: He who planted the ear, shall He not hear? He who formed the eye, shall He not see?

title: Psalms 94:10
text: He who chastens the nations, shall He not correct, He who teaches man knowledge?

title: Psalms 94:11
text: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they [are] vain.

title: Psalms 94:12
text: Blessed [is] the man whom You chasten, O LORD, to teach him out of Your law;

title: Psalms 94:13
text: that You may give him rest from the days of trouble, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

title: Psalms 94:14
text: For the LORD will not cast off His people, nor will He forsake His inheritance.

title: Psalms 94:15
text: But judgment shall return to righteousness; and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

title: Psalms 94:16
text: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

title: Psalms 94:17
text: Unless the LORD [had been] my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

title: Psalms 94:18
text: When I said, My foot slips; Your mercy, O LORD, held me up.

title: Psalms 94:19
text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Your comforts delight my soul.

title: Psalms 94:20
text: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship [with] You, which frames mischief by a law?

title: Psalms 94:21
text: They gather themselves against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

title: Psalms 94:22
text: But the LORD is my defense; and my God [is] the rock of my refuge.

title: Psalms 94:23
text: And He will bring on them their own iniquity, and He will cut them off in their evil. The LORD our God shall cut them off.

title: Psalms 95:1
text: Oh come, let us sing to the LORD; let us make a joyful noise to the Rock of our salvation.

title: Psalms 95:2
text: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to Him with psalms.

title: Psalms 95:3
text: For the LORD [is] a great God, and a great King above all gods.

title: Psalms 95:4
text: In His hand [are] the deep places of the earth; the strength of the hills [is] also His.

title: Psalms 95:5
text: The sea [is] His, and He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.

title: Psalms 95:6
text: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

title: Psalms 95:7
text: For He [is] our God, and we [are] the people of His pasture, and the sheep of His hand. Today if you will hear His voice,

title: Psalms 95:8
text: harden not your heart, as [in the day] of strife, as [in the day] of testing in the wilderness;

title: Psalms 95:9
text: when your fathers tempted Me, tested Me, and saw My work.

title: Psalms 95:10
text: For forty years I was grieved with [this] generation, and said, It [is] a people who go astray in their hearts, and they have not known My ways;

title: Psalms 95:11
text: to whom I swore in My wrath that they should not enter into My rest.

title: Psalms 96:1
text: Oh sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.

title: Psalms 96:2
text: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; show forth His salvation from day to day.

title: Psalms 96:3
text: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all people.

title: Psalms 96:4
text: For the LORD [is] great, and greatly to be praised; He [is] to be feared above all gods.

title: Psalms 96:5
text: For all the gods of the nations [are] idols; but the LORD made the heavens.

title: Psalms 96:6
text: Honor and majesty [are] before Him; strength and beauty [are] in His sanctuary.

title: Psalms 96:7
text: Give to the LORD, O families of the people; give to the LORD glory and strength.

title: Psalms 96:8
text: Give to the LORD the glory [due to] His name; bring an offering, and come into His courts.

title: Psalms 96:9
text: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness; fear before Him, all the earth.

title: Psalms 96:10
text: Say among the nations, the LORD reigns; and the world shall be established; it shall not be moved; He shall judge the peoples in uprightness.

title: Psalms 96:11
text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fullness of it.

title: Psalms 96:12
text: Let the field be joyful, and all that [is] in it; then shall all the trees of the forest rejoice

title: Psalms 96:13
text: before the LORD; for He comes, for He comes to judge the earth; He shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with His truth.

title: Psalms 97:1
text: The LORD reigns; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of islands be glad.

title: Psalms 97:2
text: Clouds and darkness [are] all around Him; righteousness and judgment [are] the foundation of His throne.

title: Psalms 97:3
text: A fire goes before Him and burns up His enemies round about.

title: Psalms 97:4
text: His lightnings lit up the world; the earth saw and trembled.

title: Psalms 97:5
text: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the LORD of the whole earth.

title: Psalms 97:6
text: The heavens declare His righteousness, and all the people see His glory.

title: Psalms 97:7
text: All those who serve graven images [are] ashamed, those who boast themselves in idols; all gods bow down before Him.

title: Psalms 97:8
text: Zion heard and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of Your judgments, O LORD.

title: Psalms 97:9
text: For You, LORD, [are] high above all the earth; You are lifted on high far above all gods.

title: Psalms 97:10
text: You who love the LORD, hate evil; He keeps the souls of His saints; He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

title: Psalms 97:11
text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 97:12
text: Rejoice in the LORD, righteous ones; and give thanks at the memory of His holiness.

title: Psalms 98:1
text: A Psalm. O sing to the LORD a new song; for He has done marvelous things; His right hand and His holy arm have saved for Him.

title: Psalms 98:2
text: The LORD has made known His salvation; His righteousness He has unveiled to the eyes of the nations.

title: Psalms 98:3
text: He has remembered His mercy and His truth toward the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our. GOD.

title: Psalms 98:4
text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; breakout, and rejoice, and sing praise.

title: Psalms 98:5
text: Sing to the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

title: Psalms 98:6
text: With trumpets and sound of a horn make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.

title: Psalms 98:7
text: Let the sea roar, and the fullness of it; the world, and those who live in it.

title: Psalms 98:8
text: Let the floods clap [their] hands; let the hills be joyful together

title: Psalms 98:9
text: before the LORD; for He comes to judge the earth; with righteousness He shall judge the world, and the peoples in uprightness.

title: Psalms 99:1
text: The LORD reigns; let the peoples tremble. [He] sits [between] the cherubs; let the earth quake.

title: Psalms 99:2
text: The LORD [is] great in Zion; and He [is] high above all the peoples.

title: Psalms 99:3
text: Let them praise Your great and fearful name; it [is] holy.

title: Psalms 99:4
text: The king's strength also loved judgment; You established uprightness; You worked judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

title: Psalms 99:5
text: Praise the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He [is] holy.

title: Psalms 99:6
text: Moses and Aaron [were] among His priests, and Samuel among those who called on His name; they called on the LORD, and He answered them.

title: Psalms 99:7
text: He spoke to them in the cloudy pillar; they kept His testimonies and the ordinance [that] He gave them.

title: Psalms 99:8
text: You answered them, O LORD our God; You were a God who forgave them, though You take vengeance for their deeds.

title: Psalms 99:9
text: Praise the LORD our God, and worship at His holy hill; for the LORD our God [is] holy.

title: Psalms 100:1
text: A Psalm of praise. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all you lands.

title: Psalms 100:2
text: Worship the LORD with gladness; come before His presence with singing.

title: Psalms 100:3
text: Know that the LORD, He [is] God. He has made us, and not we ourselves; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.

title: Psalms 100:4
text: Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, [and] into His courts with praise; be thankful to Him, [and] bless His name.

title: Psalms 100:5
text: For the LORD [is] good; His mercy [is] everlasting; and His truth [endures] to all generations.

title: Psalms 101:1
text: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and judgment; to You, O LORD, I will sing praise.

title: Psalms 101:2
text: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when will You come to me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

title: Psalms 101:3
text: I will set no wicked thing before my eyes. I have hated the work of those who turn aside; it shall not hold on to me.

title: Psalms 101:4
text: A perverse heart will depart from me; I will not know the wicked.

title: Psalms 101:5
text: [Whoever] secretly slanders his neighbor, I will cut him off; him who has a high look and a proud heart, I will not allow.

title: Psalms 101:6
text: My eyes [shall be] on the faithful of the land, so that they may dwell with me; he who walks in a perfect way, he shall serve Me.

title: Psalms 101:7
text: [He] who works falsely shall not dwell within my house; he who tells lies shall not stay in my sight.

title: Psalms 101:8
text: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land, so that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

title: Psalms 102:1
text: A prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come to You.

title: Psalms 102:2
text: Hide not Your face from me in the day when I am in trouble; bow down Your ear to me; in the day I call, answer me quickly.

title: Psalms 102:3
text: For my days go up like smoke, and my bones glow like a firebrand.

title: Psalms 102:4
text: My heart is stricken, and dried like grass, so that I forget to eat my bread.

title: Psalms 102:5
text: Because of the voice of my groaning, my bones hold fast to my skin.

title: Psalms 102:6
text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am like an owl of the desert.

title: Psalms 102:7
text: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone on the house top.

title: Psalms 102:8
text: My enemies curse me all the day; and they who are mad against me are sworn against me.

title: Psalms 102:9
text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and have mixed my drink with weeping,

title: Psalms 102:10
text: because of Your anger and Your wrath; for You have lifted me up and cast me down.

title: Psalms 102:11
text: My days [are] like a shadow stretched out; and I wither like grass.

title: Psalms 102:12
text: But You, O LORD, shall endure forever; and Your memory to all generations.

title: Psalms 102:13
text: You shall arise, [and] have mercy on Zion; for the time to pity her, yea, the set time, has come.

title: Psalms 102:14
text: For Your servants take pleasure in its stones, and pity its dust.

title: Psalms 102:15
text: So the nations shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth Your glory.

title: Psalms 102:16
text: When the LORD shall build up Zion, He shall appear in His glory.

title: Psalms 102:17
text: He will turn to the prayer of the forsaken and not despise their prayer.

title: Psalms 102:18
text: This shall be written for the generation to come; and the people who shall be created shall praise the LORD.

title: Psalms 102:19
text: For He has looked down from the height of His sanctuary; from Heaven the LORD beheld the earth;

title: Psalms 102:20
text: to hear the groaning of the prisoner, to set free the sons of death;

title: Psalms 102:21
text: to declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and His praise in Jerusalem;

title: Psalms 102:22
text: when the peoples and the kingdoms have gathered together to serve the LORD.

title: Psalms 102:23
text: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

title: Psalms 102:24
text: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days; Your years [are] through the generation of generations.

title: Psalms 102:25
text: Of old You have laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens [are] the work of Your hands.

title: Psalms 102:26
text: They shall perish, but You shall endure; yea, all of them shall become old like a garment; like a robe You shall change them, and they shall be changed;

title: Psalms 102:27
text: but You [are] He, and Your years shall have no end.

title: Psalms 102:28
text: The sons of Your servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before You.

title: Psalms 103:1
text: [A Psalm] of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; and all that is within me, [bless] His holy name.

title: Psalms 103:2
text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits;

title: Psalms 103:3
text: who forgives all your iniquities; who heals all your diseases;

title: Psalms 103:4
text: who redeems your life from ruin; who crowns you [with] loving-kindness and tender mercies;

title: Psalms 103:5
text: who satisfies your mouth with good; your youth is renewed like the eagle's.

title: Psalms 103:6
text: The LORD works righteousness and judgment for all who are pressed down.

title: Psalms 103:7
text: He made known His ways to Moses, His acts to the sons of Israel.

title: Psalms 103:8
text: The LORD [is] merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and rich in mercy.

title: Psalms 103:9
text: He will not always chasten, nor will He keep His [anger] forever.

title: Psalms 103:10
text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

title: Psalms 103:11
text: For as the heavens [are] high above the earth, [so] is His mercy toward those who fear Him.

title: Psalms 103:12
text: As far as the east [is] from the west, [so] far has He removed our transgressions from us.

title: Psalms 103:13
text: As a father pities his children, the LORD pities those who fear Him.

title: Psalms 103:14
text: For He knows our form; He remembers that we [are] dust.

title: Psalms 103:15
text: [As for] man, his days [are] as grass; as a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

title: Psalms 103:16
text: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone; and its place shall know it no more.

title: Psalms 103:17
text: But the mercy of the LORD [is] from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear Him, and His righteousness [is] to sons of sons;

title: Psalms 103:18
text: to those who keep His covenant, and to those who remember to do His commandments.

title: Psalms 103:19
text: The LORD has prepared His throne in the heavens; and His kingdom rules over all.

title: Psalms 103:20
text: Bless the LORD, O angels of His, who excel in strength, who do His command, listening to the voice of His word.

title: Psalms 103:21
text: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, ministers of His who do His pleasure.

title: Psalms 103:22
text: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His rule; bless the LORD, O my soul.

title: Psalms 104:1
text: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, You are very great; You have put on honor and majesty,

title: Psalms 104:2
text: covering Yourself [with] light as with a robe; and stretching out the heavens like a curtain;

title: Psalms 104:3
text: He lays the beams [of] His upper rooms in the waters. He sets the clouds [as] His chariots; He walks on the wings of the wind;

title: Psalms 104:4
text: He makes His angels spirits, His ministers a flaming fire.

title: Psalms 104:5
text: He laid the earth on its foundations; it shall not be shaken forever.

title: Psalms 104:6
text: You covered the deep as with a robe; the waters stand above the mountains.

title: Psalms 104:7
text: At Your rebuke they flee; at the voice of Your thunder they hurry away.

title: Psalms 104:8
text: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys to the place which You have founded for them.

title: Psalms 104:9
text: You have set a bound that they may not pass over, so that they do not turn again to cover the earth.

title: Psalms 104:10
text: [He] sends the springs into the valleys; they flow between the hills.

title: Psalms 104:11
text: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild asses break their thirst.

title: Psalms 104:12
text: By them the birds of the heavens will have their place of rest; they sing among the branches.

title: Psalms 104:13
text: [He] waters the hills from His upper rooms; the earth is satisfied with the fruit of Your works.

title: Psalms 104:14
text: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, and plants for the service of man, to bring forth food out of the earth,

title: Psalms 104:15
text: and wine cheers the heart of man, and oil makes his face shine, and bread sustains the heart of man.

title: Psalms 104:16
text: The trees of the LORD [are] full, the cedars of Lebanon which He has planted;

title: Psalms 104:17
text: where the birds make their nests; the fir trees [are] the house of the stork.

title: Psalms 104:18
text: The high hills [are] for the wild goats, and the rocks [are] a refuge for the badgers.

title: Psalms 104:19
text: He appointed the moon for seasons; the sun knows its going down.

title: Psalms 104:20
text: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the beasts of the forest creep forth.

title: Psalms 104:21
text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

title: Psalms 104:22
text: The sun rises; they are gathered, and go to their dens to lie down.

title: Psalms 104:23
text: Man goes out to his work and to his labor until the evening.

title: Psalms 104:24
text: O LORD, how many are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your riches.

title: Psalms 104:25
text: This [is] the great and wide sea, in which [are] creeping things without number, both small and great animals.

title: Psalms 104:26
text: There the ships go; You made this great sea animal to play in it.

title: Psalms 104:27
text: These all wait on You, that You may give them their food in due season.

title: Psalms 104:28
text: You give to them, they gather; You open Your hand; they [are] filled with good.

title: Psalms 104:29
text: You hide Your face, they [are] troubled; You take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.

title: Psalms 104:30
text: You send forth Your Spirit, they are created; and You renew the face of the earth.

title: Psalms 104:31
text: The glory of the LORD shall endure forever; the LORD shall rejoice in His works.

title: Psalms 104:32
text: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the hills, and they smoke.

title: Psalms 104:33
text: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

title: Psalms 104:34
text: My thoughts of Him shall be sweet; I will be glad in the LORD.

title: Psalms 104:35
text: Let the sinners perish from the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 105:1
text: O give thanks to the LORD; call on His name; make known His deeds among the people.

title: Psalms 105:2
text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; talk of all His wonderful works.

title: Psalms 105:3
text: Glory in His holy name; let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

title: Psalms 105:4
text: Seek the LORD and His strength; seek His face evermore.

title: Psalms 105:5
text: Remember His marvelous works which He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,

title: Psalms 105:6
text: seed of His servant Abraham, sons of Jacob His chosen.

title: Psalms 105:7
text: He [is] the LORD our God; His judgments [are] in all the earth.

title: Psalms 105:8
text: He has remembered His covenant forever, the word [which] He commanded to a thousand generations;

title: Psalms 105:9
text: the covenant which He made with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac;

title: Psalms 105:10
text: and He confirmed it to Jacob for a law, and to Israel [for] an everlasting covenant,

title: Psalms 105:11
text: saying, To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

title: Psalms 105:12
text: when they were [a few] men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

title: Psalms 105:13
text: When they went from one nation to another, from a kingdom to another people,

title: Psalms 105:14
text: He allowed no man to do them wrong; yea, He reproved kings for their sakes,

title: Psalms 105:15
text: [saying], Touch not my anointed, and do My prophets no harm.

title: Psalms 105:16
text: And He called for a famine on the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.

title: Psalms 105:17
text: He sent a man before them, Joseph, [being] sold for a servant;

title: Psalms 105:18
text: whose feet they hurt with chains; he was laid in iron,

title: Psalms 105:19
text: until the time that his word came, the word of the LORD refined him.

title: Psalms 105:20
text: The king sent and set him free; the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

title: Psalms 105:21
text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all he owned,

title: Psalms 105:22
text: to chain his leaders at his pleasure, and teach his elders wisdom.

title: Psalms 105:23
text: Israel also came [into] Egypt, and Jacob resided in the land of Ham.

title: Psalms 105:24
text: And He increased His people greatly and made them stronger than their enemies.

title: Psalms 105:25
text: He turned their heart to hate His people, to deal craftily with His servants.

title: Psalms 105:26
text: He sent Moses His servant, [and] Aaron whom He had chosen.

title: Psalms 105:27
text: They showed His signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

title: Psalms 105:28
text: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they did not rebel against His word.

title: Psalms 105:29
text: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

title: Psalms 105:30
text: Their land swarmed with frogs in the rooms of their kings.

title: Psalms 105:31
text: He spoke, and there came [fly] swarms and gnats in all their borders.

title: Psalms 105:32
text: He gave them hail [for] rain [and] flaming fire in their land.

title: Psalms 105:33
text: He struck their vines also and their fig trees, and broke the trees of their borders.

title: Psalms 105:34
text: [He] spoke, and locusts came, and larvae without number;

title: Psalms 105:35
text: and they ate up all the plants in their land, and ate the fruit of their ground.

title: Psalms 105:36
text: He also struck all the first-born in their land, the chief of all their strength.

title: Psalms 105:37
text: He also brought them out with silver and gold; and there [was] not one feeble person among their tribes.

title: Psalms 105:38
text: Egypt was glad when they departed; for the fear of them had fallen on them.

title: Psalms 105:39
text: He spread a cloud for a covering, and fire to give light [in] the night.

title: Psalms 105:40
text: [They] asked, and He brought quail, and satisfied them [with] the food of heaven.

title: Psalms 105:41
text: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places [like] a river.

title: Psalms 105:42
text: For He remembered His holy promise [and] Abraham His servant.

title: Psalms 105:43
text: And He brought forth His people with joy, and His chosen with gladness,

title: Psalms 105:44
text: and gave them the lands of the nations; and they inherited the labor of the people,

title: Psalms 105:45
text: so that they might take heed to His statutes and keep His laws. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 106:1
text: Praise the LORD. O give thanks to the LORD; for [He is] good; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 106:2
text: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or cause all His praise to be heard?

title: Psalms 106:3
text: Blessed [are] those who keep judgment, he who does righteousness at all times.

title: Psalms 106:4
text: Remember me, O LORD, with the favor of Your people; O visit me with Your salvation,

title: Psalms 106:5
text: that I may see the good of Your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, to glory with Your inheritance.

title: Psalms 106:6
text: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

title: Psalms 106:7
text: Our fathers did not understand Your wonders in Egypt; they did not remember the multitude of Your mercies, but rebelled at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

title: Psalms 106:8
text: But He saved them for His name's sake, to make His mighty power known.

title: Psalms 106:9
text: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up; so He led them through the depths, [as] through the wilderness.

title: Psalms 106:10
text: And He saved them from the hand of the hater, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

title: Psalms 106:11
text: And the waters covered their enemies; there was not one of them left.

title: Psalms 106:12
text: Then they believed His words; they sang His praise.

title: Psalms 106:13
text: They hurried [and] forgot His works; they did not wait for His counsel;

title: Psalms 106:14
text: but they lusted greedily in the wilderness, and tested God in the desert.

title: Psalms 106:15
text: And He gave them what they asked, but sent leanness into their soul.

title: Psalms 106:16
text: And they were jealous of Moses in the camp, [and] Aaron the saint of the LORD.

title: Psalms 106:17
text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

title: Psalms 106:18
text: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

title: Psalms 106:19
text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped the melted image.

title: Psalms 106:20
text: And they changed their Glory into the likeness of an ox that eats grass.

title: Psalms 106:21
text: They forgot God their Deliverer, who had done great things in Egypt;

title: Psalms 106:22
text: wonderful works in the land of Ham, fearful things by the Red Sea.

title: Psalms 106:23
text: And He said that He would destroy them, if Moses His chosen had not stood before Him in the breach, to turn away His wrath, so that He should not destroy [them].

title: Psalms 106:24
text: And they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His word,

title: Psalms 106:25
text: but murmured in their tents, [and] did not listen to the voice of the LORD.

title: Psalms 106:26
text: And He lifted up His hand to them, to overthrow them in the wilderness;

title: Psalms 106:27
text: to overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

title: Psalms 106:28
text: And they joined themselves to Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead,

title: Psalms 106:29
text: and provoked [Him] to anger with their doings; and the plague broke in on them.

title: Psalms 106:30
text: Then Phinehas stood and interceded, and the plague was stayed.

title: Psalms 106:31
text: And it was counted to him for righteousness to all generations forevermore.

title: Psalms 106:32
text: And they angered [Him] at the waters of strife so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;

title: Psalms 106:33
text: because they provoked his spirit so that he spoke rashly with his lips.

title: Psalms 106:34
text: They did not destroy the nations [as] the LORD commanded them;

title: Psalms 106:35
text: but were mixed among the nations, and learned their works.

title: Psalms 106:36
text: And they served their idols, which were a snare to them.

title: Psalms 106:37
text: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons,

title: Psalms 106:38
text: and shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; and the land was defiled with blood.

title: Psalms 106:39
text: And they were defiled with their works, and went lusting in their doings.

title: Psalms 106:40
text: And the wrath of the LORD was kindled against His people, and He detested His inheritance.

title: Psalms 106:41
text: And He gave them into the hand of the nations; and those who hated them ruled over them.

title: Psalms 106:42
text: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled under their hand.

title: Psalms 106:43
text: Many times He delivered them, but they rebelled in their counsel and sank in their iniquities.

title: Psalms 106:44
text: And He looked on their affliction when He heard their cry;

title: Psalms 106:45
text: and He remembered [His] covenant for them, and was moved to pity, according to the multitude of His mercies.

title: Psalms 106:46
text: And He gave them to tender mercies before the face of all their captors.

title: Psalms 106:47
text: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to Your holy name [and] to triumph in Your praise.

title: Psalms 106:48
text: Blessed [is] the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting; and let all the people say, Amen. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 107:1
text: O give thanks to the LORD, for [He is] good; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 107:2
text: Let the redeemed of the LORD say [so], whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy,

title: Psalms 107:3
text: and gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

title: Psalms 107:4
text: They wandered in the wilderness, in a desert by the way; they found no city to dwell in.

title: Psalms 107:5
text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

title: Psalms 107:6
text: Then they cried to the LORD in their distress, and He delivered them out of their troubles.

title: Psalms 107:7
text: And He guided them by the right way, so as to go to a city to live in.

title: Psalms 107:8
text: Oh that men would praise the LORD [for] His goodness, and for His wonderful works to the sons of man!

title: Psalms 107:9
text: For He satisfies the thirsty soul, and fills the hungry soul [with] good.

title: Psalms 107:10
text: Those who sit in the darkness and in the shadow of death, [being] chained in affliction and iron;

title: Psalms 107:11
text: because they rebelled against the words of God, and despised the advice of the Most High.

title: Psalms 107:12
text: and He humbled their heart with labor; they fell down, and none [was] helping.

title: Psalms 107:13
text: Then they cried to the LORD in their distress, [and] He saved them out of their troubles.

title: Psalms 107:14
text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bands in two.

title: Psalms 107:15
text: Let them praise the LORD [for] His goodness, and for His wonderful works to the sons of man!

title: Psalms 107:16
text: For He has broken the gates of bronze, and cut the bars of iron in two.

title: Psalms 107:17
text: Fools are afflicted because of their rebellion, and because of their iniquities.

title: Psalms 107:18
text: Their soul hates all kinds of food; and they draw near the gates of death.

title: Psalms 107:19
text: Then they cry to the LORD in their distress, [and] He saves them out of their troubles.

title: Psalms 107:20
text: He sent His word and heals them, and delivers [them] from their pitfalls.

title: Psalms 107:21
text: Let them praise the LORD [for] His goodness, and [for] His wonderful works to the sons of man!

title: Psalms 107:22
text: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare His works with rejoicing!

title: Psalms 107:23
text: They who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;

title: Psalms 107:24
text: these see the works of the LORD and His wonders in the deep.

title: Psalms 107:25
text: For He commands and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

title: Psalms 107:26
text: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again [to] the depths; their soul is melted because of trouble.

title: Psalms 107:27
text: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and all their wisdom is swallowed up.

title: Psalms 107:28
text: And they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and He brings them out of their troubles.

title: Psalms 107:29
text: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

title: Psalms 107:30
text: And they are glad because they are quiet; so He brings them to their desired haven.

title: Psalms 107:31
text: Let them praise the LORD [for] His goodness, and for His wonderful works to the sons of man!

title: Psalms 107:32
text: And let them exalt Him in the congregation of the people, and praise Him in the gathering of the elders.

title: Psalms 107:33
text: He sets rivers to a wilderness and water-springs to thirsty ground;

title: Psalms 107:34
text: a fruitful land to a salty desert, because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

title: Psalms 107:35
text: He turns the wilderness into a water-ponds, and dry ground into water-springs.

title: Psalms 107:36
text: And He makes the hungry dwell there, so that they may prepare a city to live in;

title: Psalms 107:37
text: and sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

title: Psalms 107:38
text: He also blesses them, so that they are multiplied greatly; and does not allow their cattle to become few.

title: Psalms 107:39
text: Again, they have become few, and humbled through harshness, affliction, and sorrow.

title: Psalms 107:40
text: He pours scorn on nobles, and causes them to wander in the wilderness, [where there is] no path.

title: Psalms 107:41
text: But He raises up the poor from affliction and sets families like a flock.

title: Psalms 107:42
text: The upright shall see and rejoice; and all iniquity shall stop its mouth.

title: Psalms 107:43
text: Whoever [is] wise, and will observe these [things], they shall understand the mercies of the LORD.

title: Psalms 108:1
text: A Song, A Psalm of David. O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and I will give praise, even [with] my glory.

title: Psalms 108:2
text: Awake, harp and lyre; I will awake early.

title: Psalms 108:3
text: I will praise You, O LORD, among the peoples; and I will sing praises to You among the nations.

title: Psalms 108:4
text: For Your mercy [is] great above the heavens; and Your truth [reaches] to the clouds.

title: Psalms 108:5
text: Be lifted up, O God, above the heavens; and Your glory above all the earth;

title: Psalms 108:6
text: so that Your beloved may be delivered; save [with] Your right hand, and answer me.

title: Psalms 108:7
text: God has spoken in His holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and I will measure out the valley of Succoth.

title: Psalms 108:8
text: Gilead [is] Mine; Manasseh [is] Mine and Ephraim [is] the strength [of] My head; Judah [is] My lawgiver;

title: Psalms 108:9
text: Moab [is] My washpot; I will cast out My shoe over Edom; I will triumph over Philistia.

title: Psalms 108:10
text: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who will lead me into Edom?

title: Psalms 108:11
text: O God, have You not cast us off? And, O God, will You not go out with our armies?

title: Psalms 108:12
text: Give us help from trouble; for vain [is] the deliverance of man.

title: Psalms 108:13
text: Through God we shall do mighty things; for He shall trample our enemies.

title: Psalms 109:1
text: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, do not be silent;

title: Psalms 109:2
text: for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me; they spoke against me [with] a lying tongue.

title: Psalms 109:3
text: And they surrounded me [with] words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

title: Psalms 109:4
text: For my love they are my foes; but I [am in] prayer.

title: Psalms 109:5
text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

title: Psalms 109:6
text: Set a wicked man over him; and let an adversary stand at his right hand,

title: Psalms 109:7
text: when he is judged, let him be condemned; and let his prayer become sin.

title: Psalms 109:8
text: Let his days be few; let another take his office.

title: Psalms 109:9
text: Let his sons be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

title: Psalms 109:10
text: Let his sons always beg and be vagabonds, and seek [food] out of their ruins.

title: Psalms 109:11
text: Let the money-lender lay a snare for all that [is] his; and let strangers take the fruit of his labor.

title: Psalms 109:12
text: Let there be none to give mercy to him; nor [any] to favor his fatherless children.

title: Psalms 109:13
text: Let his posterity be cut off; [and] in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

title: Psalms 109:14
text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered to the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

title: Psalms 109:15
text: Let them be always before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth,

title: Psalms 109:16
text: because he did not remember to do mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, and sought to kill the broken-hearted.

title: Psalms 109:17
text: Yea, he loved cursing, so let it come to him; he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.

title: Psalms 109:18
text: As he clothed himself with cursing, as with his robe, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

title: Psalms 109:19
text: Let it be to him as the robe [which] covers him, and for a girdle with which he is always clothed.

title: Psalms 109:20
text: This [is] the reward of my foes from the LORD, and [of] them who speak evil against my soul.

title: Psalms 109:21
text: But You, Lord Jehovah, deal kindly with me for Your name's sake; because Your mercy [is] good, deliver me.

title: Psalms 109:22
text: For I [am] poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

title: Psalms 109:23
text: As a shadow when it is stretched out, I am gone; I am shaken off like the locust.

title: Psalms 109:24
text: My knees stumble from fasting; and my flesh is losing its fatness.

title: Psalms 109:25
text: And I became a shame to them; they looked on me; they shook their heads.

title: Psalms 109:26
text: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your mercy;

title: Psalms 109:27
text: and they will know that this [is] Your hand; that You, LORD, have done it.

title: Psalms 109:28
text: They will curse, but You will bless; they arise, and are ashamed; but let Your servant rejoice.

title: Psalms 109:29
text: Let my foes be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own shame, as with a cloak.

title: Psalms 109:30
text: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise Him among the multitude.

title: Psalms 109:31
text: For He shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save [him] from those who condemn his soul.

title: Psalms 110:1
text: A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord, Sit at My right hand until I place Your enemies as Your footstool.

title: Psalms 110:2
text: The LORD shall send the rod of Your strength out of Zion; rule in the midst of Your enemies.

title: Psalms 110:3
text: Your people [shall be] willing in the day of Your power, in holy adornment from the womb of the morning: You [have] the dew of Your youth.

title: Psalms 110:4
text: The LORD has sworn, and will not repent, You [are] a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

title: Psalms 110:5
text: The Lord at Your right hand shall strike through kings in the day of His wrath.

title: Psalms 110:6
text: He shall judge among the nations, He shall fill them with dead bodies; He shall shatter heads over much of the earth.

title: Psalms 110:7
text: He shall drink of the brook in the way; therefore He shall lift up the head.

title: Psalms 111:1
text: Praise the LORD! I will praise the LORD with all [my] heart, in the council of the upright, and of the congregation.

title: Psalms 111:2
text: The works of the LORD [are] great, sought out by all those who have pleasure in them.

title: Psalms 111:3
text: His work [is] honorable and glorious; and His righteousness [is] standing forever.

title: Psalms 111:4
text: He has made His wonderful works to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and full of pity.

title: Psalms 111:5
text: He has given food to those who fear Him; He will always be mindful of His covenant.

title: Psalms 111:6
text: He has shown His people the power of His works, to give to them the inheritance of the nations.

title: Psalms 111:7
text: The works of His hands [are] truth and judgment; all His commands [are] true,

title: Psalms 111:8
text: standing fast forever and ever; [they are] done in truth and uprightness.

title: Psalms 111:9
text: He sent redemption to His people; He has commanded His covenant forever; holy and awesome [is] His name.

title: Psalms 111:10
text: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of wisdom; all practicing them [have] good understanding; His praise stands forever.

title: Psalms 112:1
text: Praise the LORD! Blessed [is] the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in His commandments.

title: Psalms 112:2
text: His seed shall be mighty on earth; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

title: Psalms 112:3
text: Wealth and riches [shall be] in his house, and his righteousness stands forever.

title: Psalms 112:4
text: To the upright there arises light in the darkness; [he is] gracious and full of pity and righteousness.

title: Psalms 112:5
text: A good man shows favor, and lends; he will guide his business with fairness.

title: Psalms 112:6
text: Surely he shall not be moved forever; the righteous shall be remembered forever.

title: Psalms 112:7
text: He shall not be afraid of bad news; his heart [is] fixed, trusting in the LORD.

title: Psalms 112:8
text: His heart [is] sure; he shall not be afraid [though] he sees his oppressors.

title: Psalms 112:9
text: He has scattered abroad; he has given to the poor; his righteousness [endures] forever; his horn shall be lifted up with honor.

title: Psalms 112:10
text: The wicked shall see and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked shall perish.

title: Psalms 113:1
text: Praise the LORD! Praise, O servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

title: Psalms 113:2
text: Blessed [is] the name of the LORD from this time forth and forevermore.

title: Psalms 113:3
text: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD's name [is] to be praised.

title: Psalms 113:4
text: The LORD [is] high above all nations, and His glory above the heavens.

title: Psalms 113:5
text: Who [is] like the LORD our God, who dwells on high,

title: Psalms 113:6
text: who humbles [Himself] to behold [the] [things] in the heavens and in the earth!

title: Psalms 113:7
text: He raises up the poor out of the dust, [and] lifts the needy out of the dunghill,

title: Psalms 113:8
text: in order to make him sit with nobles, with the nobles of his people.

title: Psalms 113:9
text: He causes the barren to dwell in the house [as] a joyful mother of sons. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 114:1
text: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language,

title: Psalms 114:2
text: Judah was His sanctuary, [and] Israel was His kingdom.

title: Psalms 114:3
text: The sea saw [it] and fled; Jordan was driven back.

title: Psalms 114:4
text: The mountains skipped like rams, [and] the little hills like lambs.

title: Psalms 114:5
text: What [ailed] you, O sea, [that] you fled? O Jordan, that you turned back,

title: Psalms 114:6
text: O mountains [that] skipped like rams, O little hills like lambs?

title: Psalms 114:7
text: Earth, tremble at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

title: Psalms 114:8
text: who turned the rock [into] a pool of water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

title: Psalms 115:1
text: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name give glory, for Your mercy [and] for Your truth's sake.

title: Psalms 115:2
text: Why should the nations say, Where now [is] their God?

title: Psalms 115:3
text: But our God [is] in Heaven; He has done whatever He has pleased.

title: Psalms 115:4
text: Their idols [are] silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

title: Psalms 115:5
text: They [have] mouths, but they do not speak; they [have] eyes, but they do not see;

title: Psalms 115:6
text: they [have] ears, but they do not hear; they [have] noses, but they do not smell;

title: Psalms 115:7
text: they have hands, but they do not handle; they have feet, but they do not walk; they do not mutter through their throat.

title: Psalms 115:8
text: The ones who make them are like them, [and] everyone who trusts in them.

title: Psalms 115:9
text: O Israel, trust in the LORD; He [is] their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:10
text: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD; He [is] their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:11
text: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; He [is] their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:12
text: The LORD has been mindful of us; He will bless [us]; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.

title: Psalms 115:13
text: He will bless those who fear the LORD, [both] small and great.

title: Psalms 115:14
text: The LORD shall add on to you, even on you and on your sons.

title: Psalms 115:15
text: You [are] blessed of the LORD who made the heavens and the earth.

title: Psalms 115:16
text: The heavens, [even] the heavens, [are] the LORD's; but the earth He has given to the sons of men.

title: Psalms 115:17
text: The dead do not praise the LORD, nor do any who go down into silence.

title: Psalms 115:18
text: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and forevermore. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 116:1
text: I love the LORD because He hears my voice [and] my prayers.

title: Psalms 116:2
text: Because He has bowed down His ear to me, therefore I will call on [Him] in my days.

title: Psalms 116:3
text: The sorrows of death hemmed me in, and the pains of hell took hold on me; I found trouble and sorrow.

title: Psalms 116:4
text: Then I called on the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech You, deliver my soul.

title: Psalms 116:5
text: Gracious [is] the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God [is] merciful.

title: Psalms 116:6
text: The LORD keeps the simple; I was brought low, and He helped me.

title: Psalms 116:7
text: Return to your rest, O my soul; for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

title: Psalms 116:8
text: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from falling.

title: Psalms 116:9
text: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

title: Psalms 116:10
text: I believed, therefore I have spoken; I was greatly afflicted;

title: Psalms 116:11
text: I said in my haste, All men [are] liars.

title: Psalms 116:12
text: What shall I give to the LORD [for] all His benefits toward me?

title: Psalms 116:13
text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the name of the LORD.

title: Psalms 116:14
text: I will pay my vows to the LORD now in the presence of all His people.

title: Psalms 116:15
text: Precious in the sight of the LORD [is] the death of His saints.

title: Psalms 116:16
text: O LORD, truly I [am] Your servant; I [am] Your servant, and the son of Your handmaid; You have loosed my bonds.

title: Psalms 116:17
text: I will offer to You the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the name of the LORD.

title: Psalms 116:18
text: I will pay my vows to the LORD now in the presence of all His people,

title: Psalms 116:19
text: in the courts of the LORD's house, in the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 117:1
text: O praise the LORD, all nations; praise Him, all peoples.

title: Psalms 117:2
text: For His merciful kindness is great toward us; and the truth of the LORD [endures] forever. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 118:1
text: O give thanks to the LORD; for [He is] good; because His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 118:2
text: Let Israel now say that His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 118:3
text: Let the house of Aaron now say that His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 118:4
text: Let those who fear the LORD now say that His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 118:5
text: I called on the LORD in distress; the LORD answered me, and [set me] in a large place.

title: Psalms 118:6
text: The LORD [is] for me, I will not fear; what can man do to me?

title: Psalms 118:7
text: The LORD [is] for me among those who help me; and I will see [my desire] on those who hate me.

title: Psalms 118:8
text: [It is] better to trust in the LORD than to trust in man.

title: Psalms 118:9
text: [It is] better to trust in the LORD than to trust in princes.

title: Psalms 118:10
text: All the nations surround me, but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

title: Psalms 118:11
text: They surround me; yea, they surround me, but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

title: Psalms 118:12
text: They surround me like bees; they are put out like the fire of thorns; for in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

title: Psalms 118:13
text: You have thrust hard at me so that I might fall; but the LORD helped me.

title: Psalms 118:14
text: The LORD [is] my strength and song, and He is my salvation.

title: Psalms 118:15
text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation [is] in the tents of the righteous; the right hand of the LORD does mighty things.

title: Psalms 118:16
text: The right hand of the LORD is lifted up; the right hand of the LORD does mighty things.

title: Psalms 118:17
text: I shall not die, but live and declare the works of the LORD.

title: Psalms 118:18
text: The LORD has sorely chastened me; but He has not given me over to death.

title: Psalms 118:19
text: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will go into them, [and] I will praise the LORD.

title: Psalms 118:20
text: This [is] the gate of the LORD into which the righteous shall enter.

title: Psalms 118:21
text: I will praise You; for You have heard me, and are my salvation.

title: Psalms 118:22
text: The Stone [which] the builders refused has become the Head of the corner.

title: Psalms 118:23
text: This is from the LORD; it [is] marvelous in our eyes.

title: Psalms 118:24
text: This [is] the day [which] the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

title: Psalms 118:25
text: Save now, I beseech You, O LORD; O LORD, I beseech You, cause [us] to prosper now.

title: Psalms 118:26
text: Blessed [is] He coming in the name of the LORD; we have blessed You out of the house of the LORD.

title: Psalms 118:27
text: God [is] the LORD, who gives light to us. Tie the sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.

title: Psalms 118:28
text: You [are] my God, and I will exalt You; You [are] my God, I will praise You.

title: Psalms 118:29
text: Oh give thanks to the LORD; for [He is] good; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 119:1
text: ALEPH. Blessed [are] the upright in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

title: Psalms 119:2
text: Blessed [are] they who keep His testimonies, and who seek Him with all the heart.

title: Psalms 119:3
text: They also do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.

title: Psalms 119:4
text: You have commanded [us] to keep Your commandments carefully.

title: Psalms 119:5
text: O that my ways were fixed to keep Your statutes!

title: Psalms 119:6
text: Then I shall not be ashamed, when I have respect to all Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:7
text: I will praise You with uprightness of heart when I have learned Your righteous judgments.

title: Psalms 119:8
text: I will keep Your statutes; do not forsake me completely.

title: Psalms 119:9
text: BETH. With what shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed according to Your word.

title: Psalms 119:10
text: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me wander from Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:11
text: I have hidden Your word in my heart, so that I might not sin against You.

title: Psalms 119:12
text: Blessed [are] You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:13
text: With my lips I have declared all the judgments of Your mouth.

title: Psalms 119:14
text: I have rejoiced in the way of Your testimonies, [as much as] in all riches.

title: Psalms 119:15
text: I will think on Your commandments and have respect to Your ways.

title: Psalms 119:16
text: I will delight myself in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.

title: Psalms 119:17
text: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with Your servant, [that] I may live and keep Your word.

title: Psalms 119:18
text: Open my eyes, so that I may behold wonderful things out of Your law.

title: Psalms 119:19
text: I [am] a stranger in the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.

title: Psalms 119:20
text: My soul breaks for the longing that it has to Your judgments at all times.

title: Psalms 119:21
text: You have rebuked the proud [who are] cursed, who go astray from Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:22
text: Remove cursing and scorn from me; for I have kept Your testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:23
text: Princes also sat and spoke against me; [but] Your servant thought on Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:24
text: Your testimonies also [are] my delight [and] my advisers.

title: Psalms 119:25
text: DALETH. My soul clings to the dust; give me life according to Your word.

title: Psalms 119:26
text: I have declared my ways, and You hear me; teach me Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:27
text: Make me to understand the way of Your commandments, and I will speak of Your wonderful works.

title: Psalms 119:28
text: My soul weeps [for] grief; strengthen me according to Your word.

title: Psalms 119:29
text: Remove from me the way of lying; and grant me Your law graciously.

title: Psalms 119:30
text: I have chosen the way of truth; I have laid Your judgments [before me].

title: Psalms 119:31
text: I have stuck to Your testimonies; O LORD, do not put me to shame.

title: Psalms 119:32
text: I will run the way of Your commandments, when You shall enlarge my heart.

title: Psalms 119:33
text: HE. O LORD, teach me the way of Your statutes, and I shall keep it [to] the end.

title: Psalms 119:34
text: Give me understanding, and I shall keep Your law; yea, I shall observe it with all [my] heart.

title: Psalms 119:35
text: Cause me to walk in the path of Your commandments; for I delight in them.

title: Psalms 119:36
text: Bow my heart to Your testimonies, and not to unjust gain.

title: Psalms 119:37
text: Turn away my eyes from seeing vanity; in Your way give me life.

title: Psalms 119:38
text: Make Your word sure to Your servant, who [is devoted] to Your fear.

title: Psalms 119:39
text: Turn away my shame which I fear; for Your judgments [are] good.

title: Psalms 119:40
text: Behold, I have longed after Your commandments; in Your righteousness give me life.

title: Psalms 119:41
text: VAU. Let Your mercies come to me, O LORD, even according to Your salvation, according to Your word.

title: Psalms 119:42
text: And I shall have something to answer him who mocks me; for I trust in Your word.

title: Psalms 119:43
text: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in Your judgments.

title: Psalms 119:44
text: And I shall keep Your law continually forever and ever.

title: Psalms 119:45
text: And I will always walk in a broad place; for I seek Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:46
text: I will speak of Your testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

title: Psalms 119:47
text: And I will delight myself in Your commandments, which I have loved.

title: Psalms 119:48
text: And I will lift up my hands to Your commandments which I have loved; and I will think on Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:49
text: ZAYIN. Remember the word to Your servant, on which You have caused me to hope.

title: Psalms 119:50
text: This [is] my comfort in my affliction; for Your word has given me life.

title: Psalms 119:51
text: The proud have utterly scorned me; yet I have not turned aside from Your law.

title: Psalms 119:52
text: I remembered Your judgments of old, O LORD, and have comforted myself.

title: Psalms 119:53
text: Horror has taken hold on me because of the wicked who forsake Your law.

title: Psalms 119:54
text: Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

title: Psalms 119:55
text: I have remembered Your name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept Your law.

title: Psalms 119:56
text: This was done to me, because I kept Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:57
text: CHETH. [You are] my portion, O LORD; I have said that I would keep Your words.

title: Psalms 119:58
text: I looked for Your favor with all [my] heart; be merciful to me according to Your word.

title: Psalms 119:59
text: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet to Your testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:60
text: I made haste and did not delay to keep Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:61
text: The bands of the wicked have robbed me; [but] I have not forgotten Your law.

title: Psalms 119:62
text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to You because of Your righteous judgments.

title: Psalms 119:63
text: I [am] a companion of all who fear You, and of those who keep Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:64
text: O LORD, the earth is full of Your mercy; teach me Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:65
text: TETH. You have dealt well with Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.

title: Psalms 119:66
text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge; for I have believed Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:67
text: Before I was afflicted I went astray; but now I have kept Your word.

title: Psalms 119:68
text: You [are] good, and do good; teach me Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:69
text: The proud have forged a lie against me; I will keep Your commandments with all [my] heart.

title: Psalms 119:70
text: Their heart is without feeling, like fat; [but] I delight in Your law.

title: Psalms 119:71
text: [It is] good for me that I have been afflicted, so that I might learn Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:72
text: The law of Your mouth [is] better to me than thousands of gold and silver.

title: Psalms 119:73
text: JOD. Your hands have made me and formed me; give me understanding so that I may learn Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:74
text: They who fear You will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in Your word.

title: Psalms 119:75
text: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments [are] right, and that You have afflicted me in faithfulness.

title: Psalms 119:76
text: I beseech You, let Your merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to Your word to Your servant.

title: Psalms 119:77
text: Let Your tender mercies come to me so that I may live; for Your law [is] my delight.

title: Psalms 119:78
text: Let the proud be ashamed; for they perverted my cause with lying; I will think on Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:79
text: Let those who fear You turn to me, and those who have known Your testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:80
text: Let my heart be sound in Your statutes, so that I may not be ashamed.

title: Psalms 119:81
text: KAPH. My soul faints for Your salvation; I hope in Your word.

title: Psalms 119:82
text: My eyes fail for Your word, saying, When will You comfort me?

title: Psalms 119:83
text: For I am like a wineskin in the smoke; I do not forget Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:84
text: How many [are] the days of Your servant? When will You carry out judgment on my persecutors?

title: Psalms 119:85
text: The proud have dug pits for me, which [are] not according to Your law.

title: Psalms 119:86
text: All Your commandments [are] faithful; they persecute me [with] lying; help me.

title: Psalms 119:87
text: They had almost finished me on earth; but I did not forsake Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:88
text: According to Your loving-kindness give me life; so shall I keep the testimony of Your mouth.

title: Psalms 119:89
text: LAMED. Forever, O LORD, Your word is settled in the heavens.

title: Psalms 119:90
text: Your faithfulness [is] to all generations; You have founded the earth, and it remains.

title: Psalms 119:91
text: They stand to this day according to Your ordinances; for all [are] Your servants.

title: Psalms 119:92
text: Unless Your law [had been] my delight, I should then have perished in my affliction.

title: Psalms 119:93
text: I will never forget Your commandments; for with them You have given me life.

title: Psalms 119:94
text: I [am] Yours, save me; for I have sought Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:95
text: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; [but] I will think on Your testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:96
text: I have seen an end to all perfection; Your commandment [is] exceedingly broad.

title: Psalms 119:97
text: MEM. Oh how I love Your law! It [is] my meditation all the day.

title: Psalms 119:98
text: Through Your commandments You make me wiser than my enemies, for they [are] ever with me.

title: Psalms 119:99
text: I have more understanding than all my teachers; for Your testimonies [are] my prayer.

title: Psalms 119:100
text: I understand more than the old men, because I keep Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:101
text: I have kept my feet from every evil way, so that I might keep Your word.

title: Psalms 119:102
text: I have not departed from Your judgments; for You have taught me.

title: Psalms 119:103
text: How sweet are Your words to my taste! More than honey to my mouth!

title: Psalms 119:104
text: Through Your commandments I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.

title: Psalms 119:105
text: NUN. Your word [is] a lamp to my feet, and a light to my path.

title: Psalms 119:106
text: I have sworn, and I raised [it], that I will keep Your righteous judgments.

title: Psalms 119:107
text: I am afflicted very much; O LORD, give me life according to Your word.

title: Psalms 119:108
text: I pray You, take the free-will offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.

title: Psalms 119:109
text: My life [is] in my hand daily; yet I do not forget Your law.

title: Psalms 119:110
text: The wicked have laid a snare for me; yet I do not go astray from Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:111
text: I have taken Your testimonies as an inheritance forever; for they [are] the rejoicing of my heart.

title: Psalms 119:112
text: I have bowed down my heart to do Your statutes always to the end.

title: Psalms 119:113
text: SAMECH. I hate half-hearted [thoughts]; but Your law do I love.

title: Psalms 119:114
text: You [are] my hiding-place and my shield; I hope in Your word.

title: Psalms 119:115
text: Depart from me, you evil-doers, for I will keep the commandments of my God.

title: Psalms 119:116
text: Uphold me according to Your word, that I may live; and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

title: Psalms 119:117
text: Hold me up, and I shall be safe; and I will always have respect to Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:118
text: You have trampled all those who go astray from Your statutes; for their deceit [is] falsehood.

title: Psalms 119:119
text: You put away all the wicked of the earth [like] waste; therefore I love Your testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:120
text: My flesh trembles in fear of You; and I am afraid of Your judgments.

title: Psalms 119:121
text: AYIN. I have done the just and right [thing]; leave me not to those who crush me.

title: Psalms 119:122
text: Be surety for Your servant for good; let not the proud press me down.

title: Psalms 119:123
text: My eyes fail for Your salvation, and for the word of Your righteousness.

title: Psalms 119:124
text: Deal with Your servant according to Your mercy, and teach me Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:125
text: I [am] Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:126
text: [It is] time for the LORD to work; for they have broken Your law.

title: Psalms 119:127
text: Therefore I love Your commandments above gold; yea, even fine gold.

title: Psalms 119:128
text: Therefore I count all [Your] commandments concerning all things to be right; I hate every false way.

title: Psalms 119:129
text: PE. Your testimonies [are] wonderful; therefore my soul keeps them.

title: Psalms 119:130
text: The entrance of Your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.

title: Psalms 119:131
text: I opened my mouth and panted; for I longed for Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:132
text: Look on me, and be merciful to me, as You usually do to those who love Your name.

title: Psalms 119:133
text: Order my steps in Your word; and do not let any iniquity rule over me.

title: Psalms 119:134
text: Deliver me from the oppression of man; and I will keep Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:135
text: Make Your face shine on Your servant; and teach me Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:136
text: Rivers of water run down my eyes, because they do not keep Your law.

title: Psalms 119:137
text: TZADDI. You are righteous, O LORD, and Your judgments [are] right.

title: Psalms 119:138
text: In Your testimonies You have commanded righteousness and faithfulness exceedingly.

title: Psalms 119:139
text: My zeal has eaten me up, because my enemies have forgotten Your words.

title: Psalms 119:140
text: Your word [is] very pure; therefore Your servant loves it.

title: Psalms 119:141
text: I [am] small and despised; [yet] I do not forget Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:142
text: Your righteousness [is] an everlasting righteousness, and Your law [is] the truth.

title: Psalms 119:143
text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me; [yet] Your commandments [are] my delight.

title: Psalms 119:144
text: The righteousness of Your testimonies [is] everlasting; give me understanding, and I shall live.

title: Psalms 119:145
text: QOPH. I cried with [my] whole heart; hear me, O LORD; I will keep Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:146
text: I cried to You; save me, and I shall keep Your testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:147
text: I went before the dawning of the morning and cried; I hoped in Your word.

title: Psalms 119:148
text: My eyes go before the [night] watches, so that I might think on Your word.

title: Psalms 119:149
text: Hear my voice according to Your loving-kindness; O LORD, according to Your judgment give me life.

title: Psalms 119:150
text: They draw near, those who follow after wickedness; they are far from Your law.

title: Psalms 119:151
text: You [are] near, O LORD, and all Your commandments [are] truth.

title: Psalms 119:152
text: Concerning Your testimonies, I have known of old that You have founded them forever.

title: Psalms 119:153
text: RESH. Look on my affliction, and deliver me; for I do not forget Your law.

title: Psalms 119:154
text: Plead my cause, and deliver me; according to Your word give me life.

title: Psalms 119:155
text: Salvation [is] far from the wicked, for they do not seek Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:156
text: Great [are] Your tender mercies, O LORD; according to Your judgments give me life.

title: Psalms 119:157
text: Many [are] my persecutors and my enemies, yet I do not turn aside from Your testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:158
text: I saw the traitors, and was grieved because they did not keep Your word.

title: Psalms 119:159
text: See how I love Your commandments; O LORD, according to Your loving-kindness give me life.

title: Psalms 119:160
text: Your word [is] true from the beginning; and every one of Your righteous judgments [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 119:161
text: SHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in fear of Your word.

title: Psalms 119:162
text: I rejoice at Your word, as one who finds great spoil.

title: Psalms 119:163
text: I hate and despise lying; [but] I love Your law.

title: Psalms 119:164
text: I praise You seven [times] a day because of Your righteous judgments.

title: Psalms 119:165
text: Great peace [is to] those who love Your law, and [there is] no stumbling block for them.

title: Psalms 119:166
text: LORD, I have hoped for Your salvation, and have done Your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:167
text: My soul has kept Your testimonies; and I love them very much.

title: Psalms 119:168
text: I have kept Your commandments and Your testimonies; for all my ways [are] before You.

title: Psalms 119:169
text: TAU. Let my cry come near to You, O LORD; give me wisdom according to Your word.

title: Psalms 119:170
text: Let my prayer come before You; deliver me according to Your word.

title: Psalms 119:171
text: My lips shall utter praise, when You have taught me Your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:172
text: My tongue shall speak Your word, for all Your commandments [are] righteousness.

title: Psalms 119:173
