text: Let Your hand help me; for I have chosen Your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:174
text: I have longed for Your salvation, O LORD; and Your law [is] my delight.

title: Psalms 119:175
text: Let my soul live, and it shall praise You; and let Your judgments help me.

title: Psalms 119:176
text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek Your servant; for I do not forget Your commandments.

title: Psalms 120:1
text: A Song of degrees. In my trouble I cried to the LORD, and He heard me.

title: Psalms 120:2
text: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

title: Psalms 120:3
text: What shall be given to you? Or what shall be done to you, O false tongue?

title: Psalms 120:4
text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of broom.

title: Psalms 120:5
text: Woe is me, that I live in Mesech; I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

title: Psalms 120:6
text: My soul has long dwelt with a hater of peace.

title: Psalms 120:7
text: I [am] for peace; but when I speak, they [are] for war.

title: Psalms 121:1
text: A Song of degrees. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where shall my help come from?

title: Psalms 121:2
text: My help [comes] from the LORD, who made Heaven and earth.

title: Psalms 121:3
text: He will not allow your foot to be moved; He who keeps you will not slumber.

title: Psalms 121:4
text: Behold, He who keeps Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

title: Psalms 121:5
text: The LORD [is] your keeper; the LORD [is] your shade on your right hand.

title: Psalms 121:6
text: The sun shall not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.

title: Psalms 121:7
text: The LORD shall keep you from all evil; He shall keep your soul.

title: Psalms 121:8
text: The LORD shall keep your going out and your coming in from this time forth, and even forevermore.

title: Psalms 122:1
text: A Song of degrees; of David. I was glad when they said to me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

title: Psalms 122:2
text: Our feet shall stand within your gates, O Jerusalem.

title: Psalms 122:3
text: Jerusalem is built like a city that [is] all joined together as one;

title: Psalms 122:4
text: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, to the testimony of Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.

title: Psalms 122:5
text: For there were set the thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

title: Psalms 122:6
text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem; those who love you shall be blessed.

title: Psalms 122:7
text: Peace [be] within your walls, blessings within your palaces.

title: Psalms 122:8
text: For my brothers and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace [be] within you.

title: Psalms 122:9
text: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek your good.

title: Psalms 123:1
text: A Song of degrees. To You I lift up my eyes, O Dweller in Heaven.

title: Psalms 123:2
text: Behold, as the eyes of servants [look] to the hand of their masters; as the eyes of a maiden to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait on the LORD our God, until He shall have mercy on us.

title: Psalms 123:3
text: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy on us; for we are exceedingly filled with scorn.

title: Psalms 123:4
text: Our soul is exceedingly filled [with] the contempt of those who are at ease, with the scorn of the proud.

title: Psalms 124:1
text: A Song of degrees; of David. Except that [it was] the LORD who was for us, O may Israel say;

title: Psalms 124:2
text: Except that [it was] the LORD who was for us when men rose up against us,

title: Psalms 124:3
text: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;

title: Psalms 124:4
text: then the waters would have flowed over us, the stream would have gone over our soul;

title: Psalms 124:5
text: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

title: Psalms 124:6
text: Blessed [is] the LORD, who has not given us [as] a prey to their teeth.

title: Psalms 124:7
text: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the snare of the fowlers; the snare is broken, and we have escaped.

title: Psalms 124:8
text: Our help [is] in the name of the LORD, who made the heavens and earth.

title: Psalms 125:1
text: A Song of degrees. They who trust in the LORD [shall be] like Mount Zion; it is not shaken, but remains forever.

title: Psalms 125:2
text: As the mountains [are] all around Jerusalem, so the LORD [is] all around His people from this time and forever.

title: Psalms 125:3
text: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest on the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands to iniquity.

title: Psalms 125:4
text: Do good, O LORD, to the good, and to the upright in their hearts.

title: Psalms 125:5
text: And those who turn aside to their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity; peace [shall be] on Israel.

title: Psalms 126:1
text: A Song of degrees. When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like those who dream.

title: Psalms 126:2
text: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue [with] singing; then they said among the nations, The LORD has done great [things] with them.

title: Psalms 126:3
text: Great things [did] the LORD to work with us [and] we are glad.

title: Psalms 126:4
text: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.

title: Psalms 126:5
text: Those who sow in tears shall reap in joy.

title: Psalms 126:6
text: [He who] goes forth and weeps, bearing [precious] seed, shall [doubtless] come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves [with him].

title: Psalms 127:1
text: A Song of degrees for Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, they labor in vain who build it; unless the LORD keeps the city, the watchman stays awake in vain.

title: Psalms 127:2
text: [It is] vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows; [for] so He gives His beloved sleep.

title: Psalms 127:3
text: Lo, children [are] the inheritance of the LORD; the fruit of the womb [is] a reward.

title: Psalms 127:4
text: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so [are] the sons of the young.

title: Psalms 127:5
text: Blessed [is] the man who has his quiver full of them; they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

title: Psalms 128:1
text: A Song of degrees. Blessed [is] everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in His ways.

title: Psalms 128:2
text: For you shall surely eat the labor of your hands; you [shall be] happy, and all [is] well with you.

title: Psalms 128:3
text: Your wife [shall be] like a fruitful vine by the sides of your house; your sons [shall be] like olive plants around your table.

title: Psalms 128:4
text: Behold! So shall the man be blessed who fears the LORD.

title: Psalms 128:5
text: The LORD shall bless you out of Zion; and you shall see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

title: Psalms 128:6
text: Yea, you shall see the sons of your sons. Peace [be] on Israel.

title: Psalms 129:1
text: A Song of degrees. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth, Israel may now say;

title: Psalms 129:2
text: many times they have afflicted me from my youth; yet they have not prevailed over me.

title: Psalms 129:3
text: The plowers plowed on my back; they made their furrows long.

title: Psalms 129:4
text: The LORD [is] righteous; He cuts off the cords of the wicked.

title: Psalms 129:5
text: Let them all be ashamed and turned back, those who hate Zion.

title: Psalms 129:6
text: Let them be like the grass [on] the housetops, which dries up before it grows up,

title: Psalms 129:7
text: with which the reaper does not fill his hand, nor the binder of sheaves his bosom.

title: Psalms 129:8
text: And those who pass by have never said, The blessing of the LORD [be] on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.

title: Psalms 130:1
text: A Song of degrees. Out of the depths I have cried to You, O LORD.

title: Psalms 130:2
text: Lord, hear my voice, and let Your ears listen to the voice of My prayers.

title: Psalms 130:3
text: If You will keep [in mind] iniquities, O Jehovah, who shall stand, O Lord?

title: Psalms 130:4
text: But [there is] forgiveness with You, that You may be feared.

title: Psalms 130:5
text: I wait [for] the LORD, my soul waits, and in His word I hope.

title: Psalms 130:6
text: My soul [waits] for the LORD more than morning-watchers who are watching for the morning.

title: Psalms 130:7
text: Let Israel hope in the LORD; for with the LORD [there is] mercy, and with Him [is] plentiful redemption.

title: Psalms 130:8
text: And He shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

title: Psalms 131:1
text: A Song of degrees; of David. O LORD, my heart is not proud, nor my eyes lofty; nor have I walked in great things, nor in things too wondrous for me.

title: Psalms 131:2
text: Surely I have behaved and have quieted my soul, as one weaned by its mother; my soul on me [is] like one weaned.

title: Psalms 131:3
text: Let Israel hope in the LORD from this moment and forever.

title: Psalms 132:1
text: A Song of degrees. O LORD, remember David [and] all his afflictions,

title: Psalms 132:2
text: how he swore to the LORD; he vowed to the mighty One of Jacob.

title: Psalms 132:3
text: Surely I will not come into the tent of my house, nor go up into my bed;

title: Psalms 132:4
text: I will not give sleep to my eyes, [nor] slumber to my eyelids,

title: Psalms 132:5
text: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling-place for the Mighty One of Jacob.

title: Psalms 132:6
text: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah; we found it in the fields of the wood.

title: Psalms 132:7
text: We will go into His dwellings; we will worship at His footstool.

title: Psalms 132:8
text: Arise, O LORD, into Your rest; You, and the ark of Your strength.

title: Psalms 132:9
text: Let Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.

title: Psalms 132:10
text: For Your servant David's sake, turn not away the face of Your anointed.

title: Psalms 132:11
text: The LORD has sworn to David [in] truth; He will not turn from it; Of the fruit of your body I will set on the throne for you.

title: Psalms 132:12
text: If your sons will keep My covenant and My testimonies which I shall teach them, their sons shall also sit on your throne forever.

title: Psalms 132:13
text: The LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired [it] for His dwelling-place.

title: Psalms 132:14
text: This [is] My rest forever; here I will dwell; for I have desired it.

title: Psalms 132:15
text: I will greatly bless her food; I will satisfy her poor [with] bread.

title: Psalms 132:16
text: I also will clothe her priests [with] salvation; and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

title: Psalms 132:17
text: There I will make the horn of David to bud; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed.

title: Psalms 132:18
text: I will clothe his enemies [with] shame; but his crown shall shine on him.

title: Psalms 133:1
text: A Song of degrees; of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant [it is] for brothers to dwell together in unity!

title: Psalms 133:2
text: [It is] like the precious ointment on the head that ran down on the beard, Aaron's beard, that went down to the mouth of his garments;

title: Psalms 133:3
text: like the dew of Hermon that came down on the mountains of Zion; for there the LORD commanded the blessing, life forevermore.

title: Psalms 134:1
text: A Song of degrees. Behold, bless the LORD, all servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the house of the LORD.

title: Psalms 134:2
text: Lift up your hands [in] the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.

title: Psalms 134:3
text: [May] the LORD, who made the heavens and earth, bless you out of Zion.

title: Psalms 135:1
text: Praise the LORD! Praise the name of the LORD; praise Him, servants of the LORD.

title: Psalms 135:2
text: [Those] who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,

title: Psalms 135:3
text: praise the LORD; for the LORD [is] good; sing praises to His name, for [it is] full of delight.

title: Psalms 135:4
text: For the LORD has chosen Jacob to Himself, [and] Israel for His peculiar treasure.

title: Psalms 135:5
text: For I know that the LORD [is] great, and our LORD [is] above all gods.

title: Psalms 135:6
text: Every thing the LORD pleased, He did in the heavens and in earth, and in the seas and all deep places.

title: Psalms 135:7
text: He causes the vapors to rise from the end of the earth; He makes lightnings for the rain; He brings wind out of His storehouses.

title: Psalms 135:8
text: [He] who struck the first-born of Egypt, both of man and animal;

title: Psalms 135:9
text: [who] sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, on Pharaoh and on all his servants;

title: Psalms 135:10
text: who struck great nations and killed mighty kings,

title: Psalms 135:11
text: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,

title: Psalms 135:12
text: and gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel His people.

title: Psalms 135:13
text: Your name, O LORD, [endures] forever, and Your memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.

title: Psalms 135:14
text: For the LORD will judge His people, and He will have pity on His servants.

title: Psalms 135:15
text: The idols of the nations [are] silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

title: Psalms 135:16
text: They [have] mouths, but they do not speak; they [have] eyes, but they do not see;

title: Psalms 135:17
text: they [have] ears, but they do not hear, nor is there breath in their mouths.

title: Psalms 135:18
text: Those who make them are like them, everyone who trusts in them.

title: Psalms 135:19
text: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel; bless the LORD, O house of Aaron;

title: Psalms 135:20
text: bless the LORD, O house of Levi; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD.

title: Psalms 135:21
text: Blessed [is] the LORD out of Zion, who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 136:1
text: Oh give thanks to the LORD; for [He is] good; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:2
text: Oh give thanks to the God of gods; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:3
text: Oh give thanks to the Lord of lords; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:4
text: To Him who alone does great wonders; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:5
text: To Him who by wisdom made the heavens; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:6
text: To Him who stretched out the earth above the waters; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:7
text: To Him who made great lights; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:8
text: The sun to rule by day; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:9
text: the moon and stars to rule by night; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:10
text: To Him who struck Egypt in their first-born; for His mercy [endures] forever;

title: Psalms 136:11
text: and brought Israel out from among them, for His mercy [endures] forever;

title: Psalms 136:12
text: with a strong hand, and a stretched out arm; for His mercy [endures] forever;

title: Psalms 136:13
text: To Him who divided the Red Sea into parts; for His mercy [endures] forever;

title: Psalms 136:14
text: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it; for His mercy [endures] forever;

title: Psalms 136:15
text: but threw Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:16
text: To Him who led His people through the wilderness; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:17
text: To Him who struck great kings; for His mercy [endures] forever;

title: Psalms 136:18
text: and killed famous kings; for His mercy [endures] forever:

title: Psalms 136:19
text: Sihon king of the Amorites; for His mercy [endures] forever;

title: Psalms 136:20
text: and Og the king of Bashan; for His mercy [endures] forever;

title: Psalms 136:21
text: and gave their land for an inheritance; for His mercy [endures] forever;

title: Psalms 136:22
text: an inheritance to Israel His servant; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:23
text: Who remembered us in our low estate; for His mercy [endures] forever;

title: Psalms 136:24
text: and has redeemed us from our enemies; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:25
text: Who gives food to all flesh; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 136:26
text: Oh give thanks to the God of Heaven; for His mercy [endures] forever.

title: Psalms 137:1
text: There we sat down by the rivers of Babylon; also, we wept when we remembered Zion.

title: Psalms 137:2
text: We hung our lyres on the willows in its midst.

title: Psalms 137:3
text: For there our captors demanded a song from us; and our plunderers [demanded] gladness, [saying], Sing us [one] of the songs of Zion.

title: Psalms 137:4
text: How shall we sing the LORD's song in a foreign land?

title: Psalms 137:5
text: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget.

title: Psalms 137:6
text: If I do not remember you, let my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth; if I do not prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

title: Psalms 137:7
text: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Make [it] bare! Make [it] bare, even to the foundation of [it]!

title: Psalms 137:8
text: O daughter of Babylon, O destroyed one! Blessed [is] he who will repay to [you] your reward which you rewarded to us.

title: Psalms 137:9
text: Blessed [is] he who seizes and dashes your little ones against the stones.

title: Psalms 138:1
text: A Psalm of David. I will praise You with my whole heart; before the gods I will sing praise to You.

title: Psalms 138:2
text: I will worship toward Your holy temple, and praise Your name for Your loving-kindness and for Your truth's sake; for You have magnified Your word above all Your name.

title: Psalms 138:3
text: In the day when I cried You answered me [and] made me bold [with] strength in my soul.

title: Psalms 138:4
text: All the kings of the earth shall praise You, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.

title: Psalms 138:5
text: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD; for great [is] the glory of the LORD.

title: Psalms 138:6
text: Though the LORD [is] high, yet He has respect to the lowly; but the proud He knows afar off.

title: Psalms 138:7
text: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You will give me life; You shall stretch forth Your hand against the wrath of my enemies, and Your right hand shall save me.

title: Psalms 138:8
text: The LORD will perfect [His work] in me; Your mercy, O LORD, [endures] forever; do not forsake the work of Your own hands.

title: Psalms 139:1
text: To the Chief Musician, A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and have known [me].

title: Psalms 139:2
text: You know my sitting down and my rising up; You understand my thought afar off.

title: Psalms 139:3
text: You search my path and my lying down, and are acquainted [with] all my ways.

title: Psalms 139:4
text: For [there is] not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, You know it altogether.

title: Psalms 139:5
text: You have closed me in behind and in front, and laid Your hand on me.

title: Psalms 139:6
text: Such knowledge [is] too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot go up to it.

title: Psalms 139:7
text: Where shall I go from Your Spirit? Or where shall I flee from Your presence?

title: Psalms 139:8
text: If I go up into Heaven, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, behold, You [are there].

title: Psalms 139:9
text: [If] I take the wings of the morning [and] dwell in the furthest parts of the sea;

title: Psalms 139:10
text: even there shall Your hand lead me, and Your right hand shall hold me.

title: Psalms 139:11
text: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me, even the night [shall be] light around me.

title: Psalms 139:12
text: Yea, the darkness does not hide from You; but the night shines as the day; as [is] the darkness, so is the light to You.

title: Psalms 139:13
text: For You have possessed my inward parts; You have covered me in my mother's womb.

title: Psalms 139:14
text: I will praise You; for I am fearfully [and] wonderfully made; Your works [are] marvelous and my soul knows [it] very well.

title: Psalms 139:15
text: My bones were not hidden from You when I was made in secret [and] skillfully formed in the lowest parts of the earth.

title: Psalms 139:16
text: Your eyes saw my embryo; and in Your book all [my members] were written, the days they were formed, and not one [was] among them.

title: Psalms 139:17
text: How precious also are Your thoughts to me, O God! How great is the sum of them!

title: Psalms 139:18
text: [If] I should count them, they are more than the sand; when I awake, I am still with You.

title: Psalms 139:19
text: Surely You will slay the wicked, O God; and bloody men, depart from me.

title: Psalms 139:20
text: Who will speak against You maliciously? Your enemies are lifted up with vanity.

title: Psalms 139:21
text: O LORD, do I not hate those who hate You? And am I [not] grieved with those who rise up against You?

title: Psalms 139:22
text: I hate them [with] perfect hatred; I count them my enemies.

title: Psalms 139:23
text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; try me, and know my thoughts,

title: Psalms 139:24
text: and see if [any] wicked way [is] in me; and lead me in the way everlasting.

title: Psalms 140:1
text: To the Chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man; keep me from the violent man,

title: Psalms 140:2
text: who devised evil things in the heart; they are always gathered for war.

title: Psalms 140:3
text: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison [is] under their lips. Selah.

title: Psalms 140:4
text: O LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked; keep me from the violent man who purposed to trip up my steps.

title: Psalms 140:5
text: The proud have hidden cords and a trap for me; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set snares for me. Selah.

title: Psalms 140:6
text: I said to the LORD, You [are] my God; O LORD, hear the voice of my prayers.

title: Psalms 140:7
text: O Lord Jehovah, the strength of my salvation, You have covered my head in the day of battle.

title: Psalms 140:8
text: O LORD, do not grant the desires of the wicked; do not help his wicked plans, [lest] they praise themselves. Selah.

title: Psalms 140:9
text: [As for] the head of those around me, let the evil of their own lips cover them.

title: Psalms 140:10
text: Let burning coals fall on them; let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, so that they do not rise up again.

title: Psalms 140:11
text: Do not let an evil speaker be established in the earth; evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow [him].

title: Psalms 140:12
text: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted [and] the right of the poor.

title: Psalms 140:13
text: Surely the righteous shall give thanks to Your name; the upright shall dwell in Your presence.

title: Psalms 141:1
text: A Psalm of David. O LORD, I cry to You; make haste to me, give ear to my voice when I cry to You.

title: Psalms 141:2
text: Let my prayer be set forth before You [as] incense, [and] the lifting up of my hands [as] the evening sacrifice.

title: Psalms 141:3
text: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

title: Psalms 141:4
text: Let not my heart turn aside to [any] evil thing, to practice wicked works with men who work iniquity; and let me not eat of their delicacies.

title: Psalms 141:5
text: Let the righteous strike me; [it shall be] a kindness; and let him correct me, [it is] oil on my head, let not my head refuse [it]; for still my prayer also [shall be] against their wickedness.

title: Psalms 141:6
text: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

title: Psalms 141:7
text: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cuts and splits [wood] on the earth.

title: Psalms 141:8
text: But my eyes [are] on You, O Lord Jehovah; in You I take refuge, do not leave my soul naked.

title: Psalms 141:9
text: Keep me from the traps which they have laid for me, and the snares of the workers of evil.

title: Psalms 141:10
text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets together, while I escape.

title: Psalms 142:1
text: An Instruction of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave. I cried to the LORD [with] my voice; with my voice I prayed to the LORD.

title: Psalms 142:2
text: I poured out my prayer before Him; I declared my trouble before Him.

title: Psalms 142:3
text: When my spirit fainted within me, then You knew my path. In the way [in] which I walked they have secretly laid a snare for me.

title: Psalms 142:4
text: I looked on [my] right hand, and I watched, but no one recognized me; escape was lost to me; no man cared for my soul.

title: Psalms 142:5
text: I cried to You, O LORD; I said, You [are] my refuge [and] my portion in the land of the living.

title: Psalms 142:6
text: Hear my cry; for I am brought very low; deliver me from my pursuers; for they are stronger than I.

title: Psalms 142:7
text: Bring my soul out of prison that I may praise Your name; the righteous shall gather around me; for You shall reward me.

title: Psalms 143:1
text: A Psalm of David. Hear my prayer O LORD; give ear to my supplications; in Your faithfulness [and] in Your righteousness answer me.

title: Psalms 143:2
text: And do not enter into judgment with Your servant, for in Your sight no one living is just.

title: Psalms 143:3
text: For the enemy has pursued my soul; he has beaten my life down to the ground; he has made me dwell in darkness, as those long dead.

title: Psalms 143:4
text: And my spirit has fainted within me; my heart has become weary within me.

title: Psalms 143:5
text: I remember the days of old; I think on all Your works; I muse on the work of Your hands.

title: Psalms 143:6
text: I stretch forth my hands to You; my soul [thirsts] after You like a thirsty land. Selah.

title: Psalms 143:7
text: Hear me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails; do not hide Your face from me, lest I be like those who go down into the Pit.

title: Psalms 143:8
text: Cause me to hear Your loving-kindness in the morning, for I do trust in You; cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to You.

title: Psalms 143:9
text: Deliver me, O LORD, from my enemies; I flee to You to hide me.

title: Psalms 143:10
text: Teach me to do Your will; for You [are] my God; Your Spirit [is] good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

title: Psalms 143:11
text: O LORD, for Your name's sake enliven me; for Your righteousness' sake, bring my soul out of trouble.

title: Psalms 143:12
text: And out of Your mercy cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul; for I [am] Your servant.

title: Psalms 144:1
text: A Psalm of David. Blessed [is] the LORD my Rock, who teaches My hands for war, my fingers for battle.

title: Psalms 144:2
text: [He is] my goodness and my fortress; my high tower and my deliverer; my shield and [He] in whom I trust; who humbles my people under me.

title: Psalms 144:3
text: O LORD, what [is] man that You take knowledge of him! Or the son of man, that You esteem him?

title: Psalms 144:4
text: Man [is] like vanity; his days [are] like a shadow that passes away.

title: Psalms 144:5
text: Bow down Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

title: Psalms 144:6
text: Cast forth lightning and scatter them; shoot out Your arrows and destroy them.

title: Psalms 144:7
text: Send Your hand from above; rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of a foreigner's sons;

title: Psalms 144:8
text: because their mouth has spoken vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of lies.

title: Psalms 144:9
text: I will sing a new song to You, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will sing praises to You.

title: Psalms 144:10
text: [It is] You who gives salvation to kings; who delivers David His servant from the hurtful sword.

title: Psalms 144:11
text: Rescue me, and deliver me from the hand of foreigners' sons, because their mouth has spoken vanity, and their right [hand is] a right hand of falsehood;

title: Psalms 144:12
text: so that our sons [may be] like plants grown up in their youth; and our daughters [may be] like corner-stones, polished like a palace building;

title: Psalms 144:13
text: and our storehouses [may be] full, furnishing kind to kind; and our flocks may breed thousands and ten thousands outside;

title: Psalms 144:14
text: and our oxen [may be] loaded; [there is] no break in nor going out and no crying in our streets.

title: Psalms 144:15
text: Blessed [are] the peoples who are so; blessed [are] the peoples [to] whom Jehovah [is] his God.

title: Psalms 145:1
text: Praise. Of David. I will lift You up, my God, O King; and I will bless Your name forever and ever.

title: Psalms 145:2
text: Every day I will bless You; and I will praise Your name forever and ever.

title: Psalms 145:3
text: Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and [there is] no searching out His greatness.

title: Psalms 145:4
text: One generation shall praise Your works to another, and shall declare Your mighty acts.

title: Psalms 145:5
text: I will speak of the glorious honor of Your majesty, and of Your wonderful works.

title: Psalms 145:6
text: And [men] shall speak of the might of Your awesome works; and I will declare Your greatness.

title: Psalms 145:7
text: They shall pour forth the memory of Your great goodness, and shall sing of Your righteousness.

title: Psalms 145:8
text: The LORD [is] gracious and full of pity; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

title: Psalms 145:9
text: The LORD [is] good to all; and His tender mercies [are] over all His works.

title: Psalms 145:10
text: All Your works shall praise You, O LORD; and Your saints shall bless You.

title: Psalms 145:11
text: They shall speak of the glory of Your kingdom and talk of Your power,

title: Psalms 145:12
text: to make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of His kingdom.

title: Psalms 145:13
text: Your kingdom [is] an everlasting kingdom, and Your rule [endures] throughout all generations.

title: Psalms 145:14
text: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all [those] bowed down.

title: Psalms 145:15
text: The eyes of all wait on You; and You give them their food in due season.

title: Psalms 145:16
text: [You] open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

title: Psalms 145:17
text: The LORD [is] righteous in all His ways and holy in all His works.

title: Psalms 145:18
text: The LORD [is] near all those who call on Him, all those who call on Him in truth.

title: Psalms 145:19
text: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

title: Psalms 145:20
text: The LORD watches over all those who love Him; but all the wicked He will destroy.

title: Psalms 145:21
text: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD; and let all flesh bless His holy name forever and ever.

title: Psalms 146:1
text: Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

title: Psalms 146:2
text: While I live I will praise the LORD; I will sing praises to my God while I have any being.

title: Psalms 146:3
text: Do not put your trust in princes, [nor] in the son of man in whom [there is] no salvation.

title: Psalms 146:4
text: His breath goes forth; he returns to the earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

title: Psalms 146:5
text: Blessed [is] he who [has] the God of Jacob for his help, whose help [is] in the LORD his God,

title: Psalms 146:6
text: who made the heavens and earth, the sea and all that [is] in it; who keeps truth forever;

title: Psalms 146:7
text: who carries out judgment for the mistreated; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD lets the prisoners loose;

title: Psalms 146:8
text: the Lord opens [the eyes of] the blind; the LORD raises those who are bowed down; the LORD loves the righteous;

title: Psalms 146:9
text: the LORD preserves the strangers; He relieves the orphan and widow, but the way of the wicked He turns upside down.

title: Psalms 146:10
text: The LORD shall reign forever, even your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 147:1
text: Praise the LORD; for [it is] good to sing praises to our God; for praise [is] delightful [and] becoming.

title: Psalms 147:2
text: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

title: Psalms 147:3
text: He heals the broken-hearted, and binds up their wounds.

title: Psalms 147:4
text: He appoints the number of the stars; He calls them all by [their] names.

title: Psalms 147:5
text: Great [is] our LORD, and of great power; [There is] no limit to His understanding.

title: Psalms 147:6
text: The LORD lifts up the meek; He throws the wicked down to the ground.

title: Psalms 147:7
text: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise on the harp to our God,

title: Psalms 147:8
text: who covers the heavens with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow [on] the mountains.

title: Psalms 147:9
text: He gives the beasts its food, [and] to the young ravens which cry.

title: Psalms 147:10
text: He delights not in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

title: Psalms 147:11
text: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear Him, who hope in His mercy.

title: Psalms 147:12
text: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion.

title: Psalms 147:13
text: For He has made the bars of your gates strong; He has blessed your sons within you.

title: Psalms 147:14
text: He makes peace [in] your borders [and] fills you with the finest of the wheat.

title: Psalms 147:15
text: He sends forth His commandment [on] earth; His word runs very swiftly.

title: Psalms 147:16
text: He gives snow like wool; He scatters the hoarfrost like ashes.

title: Psalms 147:17
text: He casts forth His ice like crumbs; who can stand before His cold?

title: Psalms 147:18
text: He sends out His word and melts them; He causes His wind to blow, [and] the waters flow.

title: Psalms 147:19
text: He shows His word to Jacob, His statutes and His judgments to Israel.

title: Psalms 147:20
text: He has not done so with any nation; and they have not known [His] judgments. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 148:1
text: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the heights.

title: Psalms 148:2
text: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts.

title: Psalms 148:3
text: Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all stars of light.

title: Psalms 148:4
text: Praise Him, heavens of heavens, and waters that [are] above the heavens.

title: Psalms 148:5
text: Let them praise the name of the LORD; for He commanded, and they were created.

title: Psalms 148:6
text: He has also settled them forever and ever; He has made a decree which shall not pass away.

title: Psalms 148:7
text: Let praise [be to] the LORD from the earth, the sea-monsters, and all deeps;

title: Psalms 148:8
text: fire and hail, snow and vapor, stormy wind fulfilling His word,

title: Psalms 148:9
text: mountains and all hills, fruitful trees and all cedars,

title: Psalms 148:10
text: beasts and all cattle, creeping things and birds of the wing,

title: Psalms 148:11
text: kings of the earth and all people, princes and all judges of the earth,

title: Psalms 148:12
text: both young men and maidens, old men and children;

title: Psalms 148:13
text: let them praise the name of the LORD; for His name alone is excellent; His glory [is] above the earth and heavens.

title: Psalms 148:14
text: He also lifts up the horn of His people, the praise of all His saints, even of the sons of Israel, a people near to Him. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 149:1
text: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, His praise in the congregation of saints.

title: Psalms 149:2
text: Let Israel rejoice in his Makers; let the sons of Zion be joyful in their Kings.

title: Psalms 149:3
text: Let them praise His name in the dance; let them sing praises to Him with the timbrel and harp.

title: Psalms 149:4
text: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He will beautify the meek with salvation.

title: Psalms 149:5
text: Let the saints be joyful in glory; let them sing aloud on their beds.

title: Psalms 149:6
text: [Let] the high praises of God [be] in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

title: Psalms 149:7
text: to carry out vengeance on the nations [and] punishments on the peoples,

title: Psalms 149:8
text: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with iron-bands,

title: Psalms 149:9
text: to carry out on them the judgment written; this [is an] honor for all His saints. Praise the LORD!

title: Psalms 150:1
text: Praise the LORD. Praise God in His sanctuary; praise Him in the expanse of His power.

title: Psalms 150:2
text: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to His excellent greatness.

title: Psalms 150:3
text: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet; praise Him with the harp and lyre.

title: Psalms 150:4
text: Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; praise Him with stringed instruments and pipes.

title: Psalms 150:5
text: Praise Him on the sounding cymbals; praise Him with the resounding cymbals.

title: Psalms 150:6
text: Let everything that breathes praise the LORD. Praise the LORD!

title: Proverbs 1:1
text: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

title: Proverbs 1:2
text: to know wisdom and instruction; to recognize the words of understanding;

title: Proverbs 1:3
text: to receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and uprightness;

title: Proverbs 1:4
text: to give sense to the simple, knowledge and judgment to the young man;

title: Proverbs 1:5
text: the wise hears and increases learning; and understanding ones gets wisdom;

title: Proverbs 1:6
text: to understand a proverb and its meaning; the words of the wise, and their acute sayings.

title: Proverbs 1:7
text: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of knowledge; but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

title: Proverbs 1:8
text: My son, hear the instruction of your father, and forsake not the law of your mother;

title: Proverbs 1:9
text: for they [shall be] an ornament of grace to your head and chains around your neck.

title: Proverbs 1:10
text: My son, if sinners lure you, do not be willing.

title: Proverbs 1:11
text: If they say, Come with us, let us lie in wait for blood, we will watch secretly for the innocent without cause;

title: Proverbs 1:12
text: let us swallow them up alive as the grave, and whole, as those who go down into the pit;

title: Proverbs 1:13
text: we shall find all precious goods; we shall fill our houses [with] plunder;

title: Proverbs 1:14
text: cast in your lot among us, and let us have one purse.

title: Proverbs 1:15
text: My son, do not walk in the way with them! Keep back your foot from their path,

title: Proverbs 1:16
text: for their feet run to evil and make haste to shed blood.

title: Proverbs 1:17
text: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird,

title: Proverbs 1:18
text: And they lie in wait for their [own] blood; they watch secretly for their own lives.

title: Proverbs 1:19
text: So [are] the ways of everyone who gains unjust gain; it takes away its owners' life.

title: Proverbs 1:20
text: Wisdom cries outside; she utters her voice in the streets;

title: Proverbs 1:21
text: she cries in the chief place of gathering, in the openings of the gates; in the city she utters her words, [saying],

title: Proverbs 1:22
text: How long will you love simplicity, simple ones? And will scorners delight in their scorning? And will fools hate knowledge?

title: Proverbs 1:23
text: Turn at my warning; behold, I will pour out my Spirit to you; I will make my words known to you.

title: Proverbs 1:24
text: Because I called, and you refused; I stretched out my hand, and no one paid attention;

title: Proverbs 1:25
text: but you have despised all my advice, and would have none of my warning.

title: Proverbs 1:26
text: I also will laugh at your trouble; I will mock when your fear comes;

title: Proverbs 1:27
text: when your fear comes as a wasting away, and your ruin comes like a tempest when trouble and pain come upon you.

title: Proverbs 1:28
text: Then they shall call upon me, and I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me;

title: Proverbs 1:29
text: instead they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the LORD.

title: Proverbs 1:30
text: They would have none of my counsel; they despised all my correction,

title: Proverbs 1:31
text: and they shall eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own desires.

title: Proverbs 1:32
text: For the turning away of the simple kills them, and the ease of fools destroys them.

title: Proverbs 1:33
text: But whoever listens to me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.

title: Proverbs 2:1
text: My son, if you will receive My words and hide My commandments with you,

title: Proverbs 2:2
text: so that you attend to wisdom, you shall extend your heart to understanding;

title: Proverbs 2:3
text: yea, if you cry after knowledge [and] lift up your voice for understanding;

title: Proverbs 2:4
text: if you seek her as silver, and search [for] her as for hidden treasures,

title: Proverbs 2:5
text: then you shall understand the fear of the LORD and find the knowledge of God.

title: Proverbs 2:6
text: For the LORD gives wisdom; out of His mouth [come] knowledge and understanding.

title: Proverbs 2:7
text: He lays up sound wisdom for the righteous; [He is] a shield to those who walk uprightly.

title: Proverbs 2:8
text: He keeps the paths of judgment, and guards the way of His saints.

title: Proverbs 2:9
text: Then you shall understand righteousness and judgment and honesty, every good path.

title: Proverbs 2:10
text: When wisdom enters into your heart, and knowledge is pleasing to your soul;

title: Proverbs 2:11
text: judgment shall keep you, understanding shall keep you,

title: Proverbs 2:12
text: to deliver you from the way of the evil man, from the man who speaks wicked things;

title: Proverbs 2:13
text: those who leave the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness,

title: Proverbs 2:14
text: who rejoice to do evil [and] delight in the perversities of the wicked;

title: Proverbs 2:15
text: whose ways [are] crooked, and [are] devious in their paths.

title: Proverbs 2:16
text: [They] will deliver you from the strange woman, the stranger [who] flatters [with] her words,

title: Proverbs 2:17
text: who forsakes the guide of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.

title: Proverbs 2:18
text: For her house bows down to death, and her paths to the dead.

title: Proverbs 2:19
text: All who go in to her do not return, nor do they take hold of the paths of life,

title: Proverbs 2:20
text: in order that you may walk in the way of good and keep the paths of the righteous.

title: Proverbs 2:21
text: For the upright shall dwell [in] the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

title: Proverbs 2:22
text: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.

title: Proverbs 3:1
text: My son, forget not My law; but let your heart keep My commandments;

title: Proverbs 3:2
text: for they shall add length of days, and long life, and peace, to you.

title: Proverbs 3:3
text: Let not mercy and truth forsake you; tie them around your neck; write them upon the tablet of your heart;

title: Proverbs 3:4
text: and you shall find favor and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

title: Proverbs 3:5
text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not to your own understanding.

title: Proverbs 3:6
text: In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct your paths.

title: Proverbs 3:7
text: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and depart from evil.

title: Proverbs 3:8
text: Healing shall be to your navel and marrow to your bones.

title: Proverbs 3:9
text: Honor the LORD with your substance, and with the firstfruits of all your increase;

title: Proverbs 3:10
text: and your barns shall be filled [with] plenty, and your presses shall burst [with] new wine.

title: Proverbs 3:11
text: My son, do not despise the chastening of the LORD; nor be weary with His correction;

title: Proverbs 3:12
text: for whom the LORD loves He corrects, even as a father [corrects] the son [in whom] he delights.

title: Proverbs 3:13
text: Blessed [is] the man who finds wisdom, and the man who gets understanding.

title: Proverbs 3:14
text: For the profit from it [is] better than the gain from silver, and its produce more than fine gold;

title: Proverbs 3:15
text: she [is] more precious than rubies; and all the things you can desire are not to be compared with her.

title: Proverbs 3:16
text: Length of days [is] in her right hand; and in her left hand, riches and honor.

title: Proverbs 3:17
text: Her ways [are] ways of pleasantness, and all her paths [are] peace.

title: Proverbs 3:18
text: She [is] a tree of life to those who lay hold upon her; and happy [is] everyone who keeps her.

title: Proverbs 3:19
text: The LORD has founded the earth by wisdom; by understanding He has founded the heavens.

title: Proverbs 3:20
text: By His knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

title: Proverbs 3:21
text: My son, do not let them depart from your eyes; keep sound wisdom and judgment,

title: Proverbs 3:22
text: and they shall be life to your soul and grace to your neck.

title: Proverbs 3:23
text: Then you shall walk in your way safely, and your foot shall not stumble.

title: Proverbs 3:24
text: When you lie down, you shall not be afraid; yea, you shall lie down, and your sleep shall be sweet.

title: Proverbs 3:25
text: Do not be afraid of sudden fear, nor of the destroying of the wicked, when it comes.

title: Proverbs 3:26
text: For the LORD shall be your hope, and shall keep your foot from being taken.

title: Proverbs 3:27
text: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do [it].

title: Proverbs 3:28
text: Do not say to your neighbor, Go and come back again, and tomorrow I will give; when you have it beside you:

title: Proverbs 3:29
text: Do not plan evil against your neighbor, since he dwells trustingly by you.

title: Proverbs 3:30
text: Do not strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

title: Proverbs 3:31
text: Do not envy the cruel man, and choose none of his ways.

title: Proverbs 3:32
text: For the crooked man [is] hateful to the LORD, but His secret [is] with the righteous.

title: Proverbs 3:33
text: The curse of the LORD [is] in the house of the wicked; but He blesses the home of the just.

title: Proverbs 3:34
text: Surely He scorns the scorners; but He gives grace to the lowly.

title: Proverbs 3:35
text: The wise shall inherit glory; but shame shall be the promotion of fools.

title: Proverbs 4:1
text: Sons, hear the instruction of a father, and listen in order to know understanding.

title: Proverbs 4:2
text: For I give you good teaching; do not forsake my law.

title: Proverbs 4:3
text: For I was my father's son, tender and only [beloved] in the sight of my mother.

title: Proverbs 4:4
text: He also taught me, and said to me, Let your heart hold fast my words, keep my commandments and live.

title: Proverbs 4:5
text: Get wisdom, get understanding; forget not; nor turn away from the words of my mouth.

title: Proverbs 4:6
text: Do not forsake her, and she shall keep you; love her, and she shall keep you.

title: Proverbs 4:7
text: Wisdom [is] the main thing; get wisdom; and with all your getting get understanding.

title: Proverbs 4:8
text: Prize her, and she shall lift you up; she shall bring you to honor when you embrace her.

title: Proverbs 4:9
text: She shall give to your hand an ornament of grace; she shall shield you with a crown of glory.

title: Proverbs 4:10
text: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of your life [shall be] many.

title: Proverbs 4:11
text: I have taught you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in the right paths.

title: Proverbs 4:12
text: When you go, your steps shall not be narrowed, and when you run, you shall not stumble.

title: Proverbs 4:13
text: Take fast hold of instruction; do not let go; keep her; for she [is] your life.

title: Proverbs 4:14
text: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not into the way of evil.

title: Proverbs 4:15
text: Avoid it; do not pass by it; turn from it, and pass on!

title: Proverbs 4:16
text: For they do not sleep, except when they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away unless they cause [some] to fall.

title: Proverbs 4:17
text: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

title: Proverbs 4:18
text: But the path of the just [is] as the shining light, that shines more and more to the perfect day.

title: Proverbs 4:19
text: The way of the wicked [is] as darkness; they know not at what they stumble.

title: Proverbs 4:20
text: My son, listen to my words; bow down your ear to my sayings.

title: Proverbs 4:21
text: Let them not depart from your eyes; keep them in the midst of your heart.

title: Proverbs 4:22
text: For they [are] life to those who find them, and health to all his flesh.

title: Proverbs 4:23
text: Keep your heart with all diligence; for out of it [are] the issues of life.

title: Proverbs 4:24
text: Put away from you a wicked mouth, and devious lips put far from you.

title: Proverbs 4:25
text: Let your eyes look right on, and let your eyelids look straight before you.

title: Proverbs 4:26
text: Ponder the path of your feet, and all your ways [will be] established.

title: Proverbs 4:27
text: Do not turn to the right hand nor to the left; remove your foot from evil.

title: Proverbs 5:1
text: My son, listen to my wisdom; bow your ear to my understanding;

title: Proverbs 5:2
text: in order to keep discretion, [that] your lips may keep knowledge.

title: Proverbs 5:3
text: For the lips of a strange woman drip honey, and her palate [is] smoother than oil;

title: Proverbs 5:4
text: but afterward she [is as] bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.

title: Proverbs 5:5
text: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell,

title: Proverbs 5:6
text: lest you should meditate on the path of life, her tracks are movable; you cannot know [them].

title: Proverbs 5:7
text: And now hear me, O sons, and do not depart from the words of my mouth.

title: Proverbs 5:8
text: Remove your ways far from her, and do not come near the door of her house,

title: Proverbs 5:9
text: lest you give your honor to others and your years to the cruel;

title: Proverbs 5:10
text: that strangers not be filled [with] your strength, and your labors [be] in the house of a stranger;

title: Proverbs 5:11
text: and you moan when your end [comes], when your flesh and muscle are eaten away,

title: Proverbs 5:12
text: and say, How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised correction;

title: Proverbs 5:13
text: and I have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor bowed down my ears to those who taught me!

title: Proverbs 5:14
text: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

title: Proverbs 5:15
text: Drink waters out of your own cistern, and running waters out of your own well.

title: Proverbs 5:16
text: Should your overflowing spring he scattered abroad [as] rivers of waters in the streets.

title: Proverbs 5:17
text: Let them be only your own, and not strangers' with you.

title: Proverbs 5:18
text: Let your fountain be blessed, and rejoice with the wife of your youth.

title: Proverbs 5:19
text: [Like] the loving deer and pleasant doe, let her breasts satisfy you at all times, and be ravished always with her love.

title: Proverbs 5:20
text: And why will you, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

title: Proverbs 5:21
text: For the ways of man [are] before the eyes of the LORD, and He watches all his paths.

title: Proverbs 5:22
text: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be held with the cords of his sin.

title: Proverbs 5:23
text: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

title: Proverbs 6:1
text: My son, [if] you are surety for your friend, [if] you struck your palms with a stranger,

title: Proverbs 6:2
text: you are snared with the words of your mouth, you are taken with the words of your mouth.

title: Proverbs 6:3
text: My son, do this now, and deliver yourself when you have come into the hand of your friend; go, humble yourself and make your friend sure.

title: Proverbs 6:4
text: Do not give sleep to your eyes or slumber to your eyelids.

title: Proverbs 6:5
text: Deliver yourself as a gazelle from the [hunter's] hand, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

title: Proverbs 6:6
text: Go to the ant, sluggard; consider her ways and be wise;

title: Proverbs 6:7
text: who, having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

title: Proverbs 6:8
text: provides her food in the summer [and] gathers her food in the harvest.

title: Proverbs 6:9
text: How long will you sleep, O sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

title: Proverbs 6:10
text: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to lie down;

title: Proverbs 6:11
text: so shall your poverty come as one who travels, and your need like an armed man.

title: Proverbs 6:12
text: A worthless person, a wicked man walks with a crooked mouth,

title: Proverbs 6:13
text: winking with his eyes, speaking with his feet, teaching with his fingers;

title: Proverbs 6:14
text: perversity [is] in his heart; he [is] always planning mischief; he causes fighting.

title: Proverbs 6:15
text: Therefore his calamity shall come suddenly; he is quickly broken, and there is no healing.

title: Proverbs 6:16
text: These six the LORD hates; yea, seven [are] hateful to his soul:

title: Proverbs 6:17
text: a proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

title: Proverbs 6:18
text: a heart that plots wicked plans, feet hurrying to run to evil,

title: Proverbs 6:19
text: a false witness [who] speaks lies, and he who causes fighting among brothers.

title: Proverbs 6:20
text: My son, keep your father's commandments, and do not forsake the law of your mother;

title: Proverbs 6:21
text: bind them upon your heart forever, tie them around your neck.

title: Proverbs 6:22
text: When you go, it shall lead you; when you sleep, it shall keep you; and [when] you awake, it shall talk [with] you.

title: Proverbs 6:23
text: For the commandment [is] a lamp; and the law [is] light; and reproofs of instruction [are] the way of life;

title: Proverbs 6:24
text: to keep you from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

title: Proverbs 6:25
text: Do not lust after her beauty in your heart; nor let her take you with her eyelids.

title: Proverbs 6:26
text: For by means of a harlot [a man comes] to a piece of bread; and another man's wife will hunt for the precious life.

title: Proverbs 6:27
text: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

title: Proverbs 6:28
text: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

title: Proverbs 6:29
text: So is he who goes in to his neighbor's wife; whoever touches her shall not be innocent.

title: Proverbs 6:30
text: They do not despise a thief, if he steals to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

title: Proverbs 6:31
text: but [if] he is found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the goods of his house.

title: Proverbs 6:32
text: Whoever commits adultery [with] a woman lacks understanding; he [who] does it destroys his own soul.

title: Proverbs 6:33
text: He shall get a wound and dishonor; and his shame shall not he wiped away.

title: Proverbs 6:34
text: For jealousy [is] the rage of a man; therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

title: Proverbs 6:35
text: He will not take any ransom; nor will he be willing if you multiply the gifts.

title: Proverbs 7:1
text: My son, keep my words and store up my commandments within you.

title: Proverbs 7:2
text: Keep my commandments and live; and keep my law as the pupil of your eye.

title: Proverbs 7:3
text: Bind them upon your fingers; write them upon the tablet of your heart.

title: Proverbs 7:4
text: Say to wisdom, You [are] my sister; and call understanding [your] kinsman,

title: Proverbs 7:5
text: so that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the stranger [who] flatters with her words.

title: Proverbs 7:6
text: For at the window of my house I looked through my lattice,

title: Proverbs 7:7
text: and I saw among the simple ones, among the youths, a young man with no understanding,

title: Proverbs 7:8
text: passing through the street near her corner. And he went the way to her house,

title: Proverbs 7:9
text: in the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night.

title: Proverbs 7:10
text: And, behold, there a woman met him, [with] the dress of a harlot and a guarded heart.

title: Proverbs 7:11
text: She [is] loud and stubborn; her feet do not stay in her house;

title: Proverbs 7:12
text: now [she is] outside, now in the streets, and lies in wait at every corner.

title: Proverbs 7:13
text: And she caught him and kissed him, [and] with a hard face she said to him,

title: Proverbs 7:14
text: [I have] peace offerings with me; today I have paid my vows.

title: Proverbs 7:15
text: so I came out to meet you, earnestly to seek your face, and I have found you.

title: Proverbs 7:16
text: I have decked my bed with coverings, with striped cloths of Egyptian linen.

title: Proverbs 7:17
text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

title: Proverbs 7:18
text: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; let us delight ourselves with caresses.

title: Proverbs 7:19
text: For my husband [is] not at home, he has gone on a long journey;

title: Proverbs 7:20
text: he has taken a bag of silver with him [and] will come home at the day of the full moon.

title: Proverbs 7:21
text: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

title: Proverbs 7:22
text: He goes after her immediately, like an ox goes to the slaughter, or like a fool to the correction of the stocks;

title: Proverbs 7:23
text: until a dart strikes through his liver; as a bird hastens to the snare and does not know that it [is] for his soul.

title: Proverbs 7:24
text: And now listen to me, sons, and attend to the words of my mouth.

title: Proverbs 7:25
text: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways, do not go astray in her paths.

title: Proverbs 7:26
text: For she has cast down many wounded; yea, many strong [men] have been slain by her.

title: Proverbs 7:27
text: Her house [is] the way to hell, going down to the rooms of death.

title: Proverbs 8:1
text: Does not wisdom call? And does not understanding put forth her voice?

title: Proverbs 8:2
text: She stands in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the path.

title: Proverbs 8:3
text: She cries in the gates, before the entrance of the city, [at] the doors.

title: Proverbs 8:4
text: To you, O men, I call; and my voice [is] to the sons of man.

title: Proverbs 8:5
text: O simple ones understand wisdom; and, fools, be of an understanding heart.

title: Proverbs 8:6
text: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips [shall be] right things.

title: Proverbs 8:7
text: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness [is] hateful to my lips.

title: Proverbs 8:8
text: All the words of my mouth [are] in righteousness; nothing twisted or perverse [is] in them.

title: Proverbs 8:9
text: They [are] all plain to him who understands, and right to those who find knowledge.

title: Proverbs 8:10
text: Receive my instruction and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

title: Proverbs 8:11
text: For wisdom [is] better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

title: Proverbs 8:12
text: I, wisdom, dwell with sense, and find out knowledge of discretions.

title: Proverbs 8:13
text: The fear of the LORD [is] to hate evil; I hate pride, and arrogance, and the evil way, and the wicked mouth.

title: Proverbs 8:14
text: Counsel and sound wisdom [are] Mine; I [am] understanding; I have strength.

title: Proverbs 8:15
text: By Me kings reign and princes decree justice.

title: Proverbs 8:16
text: Princes rule by Me, and nobles, all the judges of the earth.

title: Proverbs 8:17
text: I love those who love Me; and those who seek Me early shall find Me.

title: Proverbs 8:18
text: Riches and honor [are] with Me; enduring riches and righteousness.

title: Proverbs 8:19
text: My fruit [is] better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and what I give [is better than] choice silver.

title: Proverbs 8:20
text: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment;

title: Proverbs 8:21
text: I may cause those who love Me to inherit riches; and I will fill their treasuries.

title: Proverbs 8:22
text: The LORD possessed Me in the beginning of His way, before His works of old.

title: Proverbs 8:23
text: I was anointed from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth [ever was].

title: Proverbs 8:24
text: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when [there were] no springs heavy [with] water.

title: Proverbs 8:25
text: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I travailed;

title: Proverbs 8:26
text: before He had made the earth, or the fields or the highest part of the dust of the world.

title: Proverbs 8:27
text: When He prepared the heavens, I [was] there; when He set a circle upon the face of the deep;

title: Proverbs 8:28
text: when He set the clouds above; when He made the strong fountains of the deep;

title: Proverbs 8:29
text: when He gave to the sea its limit that the waters should not pass His command; when He appointed the foundations of the earth;

title: Proverbs 8:30
text: and I was a workman at His side; and I was daily [His] delight, rejoicing always before Him;

title: Proverbs 8:31
text: rejoicing in the world, His earth; and My delight [was] with the sons of men.

title: Proverbs 8:32
text: And now listen to Me, O sons; for blessed [are those who] keep My ways.

title: Proverbs 8:33
text: Hear instruction, and be wise, and do not refuse it.

title: Proverbs 8:34
text: Blessed [is] the man who hears Me, watching daily at My gates, waiting at the posts of My doors.

title: Proverbs 8:35
text: For whoever finds Me finds life, and shall obtain favor from the LORD.

title: Proverbs 8:36
text: But he who sins against Me wrongs his own soul; all who hate Me love death.

title: Proverbs 9:1
text: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out her seven pillars;

title: Proverbs 9:2
text: she has killed her beasts; she has mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

title: Proverbs 9:3
text: She has sent out her young women; she cries upon the highest places of the city,

title: Proverbs 9:4
text: The simple one, let him turn in here. [To one] lacking heart, she says to him,

title: Proverbs 9:5
text: Come, eat of my bread and drink of the wine I have mixed.

title: Proverbs 9:6
text: Forsake the foolish and live; and go in the way of understanding.

title: Proverbs 9:7
text: One rebuking a scorner gets shame to himself; and one rebuking a wicked one [gets] himself a blemish.

title: Proverbs 9:8
text: Do not reprove a scorner, lest he hate you; give to a wise man, and he will love you.

title: Proverbs 9:9
text: Give to a wise one, and he will be still wiser; teach a just one, and he will increase in learning.

title: Proverbs 9:10
text: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of wisdom; and the knowledge of the holy [is] understanding.

title: Proverbs 9:11
text: For by Me your days shall be multiplied, and the years of your life shall he increased.

title: Proverbs 9:12
text: If you are wise, you shall be wise for yourself; but [if] you scorn, you alone shall bear [it].

title: Proverbs 9:13
text: A foolish woman [is] noisy; she [is] simple and knows nothing.

title: Proverbs 9:14
text: For she sits at the door of her house, in a seat in the high places of the city,

title: Proverbs 9:15
text: to call those who pass by, who are going straight [on] their ways;

title: Proverbs 9:16
text: The simple one, let him turn in here. And to one lacking heart, she says to him,

title: Proverbs 9:17
text: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread [eaten] in secret is pleasant.

title: Proverbs 9:18
text: But he does not know that the dead [are] there; her guests [are] in the depths of hell.

title: Proverbs 10:1
text: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son [is] the sorrow of his mother.

title: Proverbs 10:2
text: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; but righteousness delivers from death.

title: Proverbs 10:3
text: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry; but He casts away the desire of the wicked.

title: Proverbs 10:4
text: He who deals [with] a lazy hand becomes poor; but the hand of the hard worker makes rich.

title: Proverbs 10:5
text: He who gathers in summer [is] a wise son; but he who sleeps in harvest [is] a son who causes shame.

title: Proverbs 10:6
text: Blessings [are] on the head of the just; but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

title: Proverbs 10:7
text: The memory of the just [is] blessed; but the name of the wicked shall rot.

title: Proverbs 10:8
text: The wise in heart will receive commandments; but a babbling fool shall fall.

title: Proverbs 10:9
text: He who walks uprightly walks surely; but he who twists his ways shall be known.

title: Proverbs 10:10
text: He who winks the eye causes sorrow; but a babbling fool shall fall.

title: Proverbs 10:11
text: The mouth of a righteous one [is] a well of life; but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

title: Proverbs 10:12
text: Hatred stirs up fights, but love covers all sins.

title: Proverbs 10:13
text: In the lips of him who has understanding, wisdom is found; but a rod [is] for the back of him who is without understanding.

title: Proverbs 10:14
text: Wise ones store up knowledge; but the mouth of the foolish [is] near ruin.

title: Proverbs 10:15
text: The rich man's wealth [is] his strong city; the ruin of the poor [is] their poverty.

title: Proverbs 10:16
text: The labor of the righteous [tends] to life; the fruit of the wicked [tends] to sin.

title: Proverbs 10:17
text: He who keeps instruction [is] in the way of life; but he who refuses reproof goes astray.

title: Proverbs 10:18
text: He who hides hatred [with] lying lips, and he who speaks a slander, [is] a fool.

title: Proverbs 10:19
text: In the multitude of words, sin is not lacking; but he who holds back his lips [is] wise.

title: Proverbs 10:20
text: The tongue of the just [is as] choice silver; the heart of the wicked [is] worth little.

title: Proverbs 10:21
text: The lips of the righteous feed many; but fools die for lack of wisdom.

title: Proverbs 10:22
text: The blessing of the LORD itself makes rich, and He adds no sorrow with it.

title: Proverbs 10:23
text: To work out evil devices [is as] laughter to a fool; [so] wisdom [is] to a man of understanding.

title: Proverbs 10:24
text: What the wicked fears shall come upon him; but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

title: Proverbs 10:25
text: As the storm passes, so the wicked is no more; but the righteous [is] an everlasting foundation.

title: Proverbs 10:26
text: Like vinegar to the teeth, and like smoke to the eyes, so [is] the sluggard to those who send him.

title: Proverbs 10:27
text: The fear of the LORD prolongs days; but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

title: Proverbs 10:28
text: The hope of the righteous [is] gladness; but the hope of the wicked shall perish.

title: Proverbs 10:29
text: The way of the LORD [is] strength to the upright; but ruin [is] to the workers of iniquity.

title: Proverbs 10:30
text: The righteous shall never be moved; and the wicked shall not live in the earth.

title: Proverbs 10:31
text: The mouth of the just brings forth wisdom; but the perverse tongue shall be cut out.

title: Proverbs 10:32
text: The lips of the righteous know what is pleasing; but the mouth of the wicked what [is] contrary.

title: Proverbs 11:1
text: False balances [are] hateful to the LORD; but a just weight [is] His delight.

title: Proverbs 11:2
text: Pride comes, then shame comes; but with the lowly [is] wisdom.

title: Proverbs 11:3
text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them; but the crookedness of traitors shall destroy them.

title: Proverbs 11:4
text: Riches do not profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

title: Proverbs 11:5
text: The righteousness of the perfect shall make his way right, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

title: Proverbs 11:6
text: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but deceivers shall be taken in lust.

title: Proverbs 11:7
text: When a wicked man dies, his hope shall perish; and the hope of evil ones shall be lost.

title: Proverbs 11:8
text: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked comes [in] his place.

title: Proverbs 11:9
text: A hypocrite corrupts [his] neighbor with [his] mouth; but through knowledge the just shall be delivered.

title: Proverbs 11:10
text: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices; and when the wicked are destroyed, [there is] singing.

title: Proverbs 11:11
text: By the blessing of the upright the city is lifted up, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

title: Proverbs 11:12
text: One despising his friend lacks heart, but a man of understanding remains silent.

title: Proverbs 11:13
text: One going with slander is a revealer of secrets, but the faithful of spirit keeps the matter hidden.

title: Proverbs 11:14
text: Where [there is] no wisdom, the people fall; but in the multitude of wise men [there is] safety.

title: Proverbs 11:15
text: He who is surety for a stranger shall be ruined; and he who hates suretyship is safe.

title: Proverbs 11:16
text: A gracious woman keeps honor, and the strong keep riches.

title: Proverbs 11:17
text: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but [he who is] cruel troubles his own flesh.

title: Proverbs 11:18
text: The wicked makes a deceitful wage; but one sowing righteousness [has] a sure reward.

title: Proverbs 11:19
text: So righteousness [tends] to life; but one pursuing evil, [it is] to his own death.

title: Proverbs 11:20
text: They who are of a perverse heart [are] hateful to the LORD, but the upright in the way [are] His delight.

title: Proverbs 11:21
text: [Though] hand [join] in hand, the wicked shall not be innocent; but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

title: Proverbs 11:22
text: [Like] a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, [so is] a beautiful woman who turns aside discretion.

title: Proverbs 11:23
text: The desire of the righteous [is] only good; the hope of the wicked [is] wrath.

title: Proverbs 11:24
text: There is one who scatters and yet increases; but one who withholds just due [comes] only to poverty.

title: Proverbs 11:25
text: The soul who gives freely shall be made fat; and he who waters shall also be watered himself.

title: Proverbs 11:26
text: He who withholds grain, the people shall curse him; but blessing [is] on the head of him who sells.

title: Proverbs 11:27
text: He who carefully seeks good gets favor; but he who seeks mischief, it shall come to him.

title: Proverbs 11:28
text: He who trusts in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall blossom like a branch.

title: Proverbs 11:29
text: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind; and the fool [shall be] servant to the wise in heart.

title: Proverbs 11:30
text: The fruit of the righteous [is] a tree of life; and he who wins souls [is] wise.

title: Proverbs 11:31
text: Behold, the righteous shall be rewarded in the earth; much more the wicked and the sinner.

title: Proverbs 12:1
text: Whoever loves instruction loves knowledge; but he who hates correction [is] like a brute [animal].

title: Proverbs 12:2
text: The good gets grace from the LORD, but He will condemn a man of wicked thoughts.

title: Proverbs 12:3
text: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

title: Proverbs 12:4
text: A woman of virtue [is] a crown to her husband, but she who causes shame [is] like rottenness in his bones.

title: Proverbs 12:5
text: The thoughts of the righteous [are] right; the counsels of the wicked [are] deceit.

title: Proverbs 12:6
text: The words of the wicked [are] to lie in wait for blood; but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

title: Proverbs 12:7
text: The wicked are overthrown, and [are] gone; but the house of the righteous shall stand.

title: Proverbs 12:8
text: A man shall be praised according to his wisdom, but he who is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

title: Proverbs 12:9
text: Better is a despised one, and having a servant, than he honoring himself and lacks bread.

title: Proverbs 12:10
text: A righteous one understands the soul of his animal; but the tender mercies of the wicked [are] cruel.

title: Proverbs 12:11
text: He who tills his land shall be satisfied [with] bread; but he who follows vanities lacks heart.

title: Proverbs 12:12
text: The wicked desires the net of evils; but the root of the righteous yields [fruit].

title: Proverbs 12:13
text: The wicked [is] snared by the transgression of [his] lips, but the just shall come out of trouble.

title: Proverbs 12:14
text: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of [his] mouth, and the reward of a man's hands shall be given to him.

title: Proverbs 12:15
text: The way of a fool [is] right in his own eyes, hut he who listens to advice [is] wise.

title: Proverbs 12:16
text: A fool's vexation is known in a day, but the astute one covers shame.

title: Proverbs 12:17
text: He who breathes truth shows forth righteousness, but a false witness deceit.

title: Proverbs 12:18
text: There are those who speak like the thrusts of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

title: Proverbs 12:19
text: The lips of truth shall be established forever, but only while I wink [is] a lying tongue.

title: Proverbs 12:20
text: Deceit [is] in the heart of those who imagine evil, but to counselors of peace [there is] joy.

title: Proverbs 12:21
text: No evil shall happen to the just, but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

title: Proverbs 12:22
text: Lying lips [are] hateful to the LORD, but those who deal truly [are] His delight.

title: Proverbs 12:23
text: A wise man conceals knowledge, but the heart of fools cries out foolishness.

title: Proverbs 12:24
text: The hand of the hard worker shall bear rule, but the lazy shall be under service.

title: Proverbs 12:25
text: Heaviness in the heart of man makes it stoop, but a good word makes it glad.

title: Proverbs 12:26
text: The righteous [is] more excellent than his neighbor, but the way of the wicked seduces them.

title: Proverbs 12:27
text: The lazy one does not start after his game, but the wealth of a hard worker [is] precious.

title: Proverbs 12:28
text: In the way of righteousness [is] life, and in that pathway [there is] no death.

title: Proverbs 13:1
text: A wise son [heeds] his father's instruction, but a scorner does not hear rebuke.

title: Proverbs 13:2
text: From the fruit of [his] mouth a man shall eat good, but the soul of the treacherous [eats] violence.

title: Proverbs 13:3
text: He who keeps his mouth keeps his life; he who opens his lips wide, [it is] ruin to him.

title: Proverbs 13:4
text: The soul of the sluggard desires and [has] nothing; but the soul of the hard worker shall be made fat.

title: Proverbs 13:5
text: The righteous hates lying, but the wicked one is odious and acts shamefully.

title: Proverbs 13:6
text: Righteousness guards the perfect of way, but wickedness subverts sin.

title: Proverbs 13:7
text: There are [those] who act rich, yet have nothing; and those who act poor, yet [have] great riches.

title: Proverbs 13:8
text: The ransom of a man's life [is] his riches, but the poor does not hear rebuke.

title: Proverbs 13:9
text: The light of the righteous rejoices, but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

title: Proverbs 13:10
text: Only by pride comes argument, but with those who take advice [is] wisdom.

title: Proverbs 13:11
text: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be taken away, but he who gathers by labor shall increase.

title: Proverbs 13:12
text: Hope put off makes the heart sick, but desire fulfilled [is] a tree of life.

title: Proverbs 13:13
text: Whoever despises the word shall be destroyed, but he who fears the commandment shall be rewarded.

title: Proverbs 13:14
text: The law of the wise [is] a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

title: Proverbs 13:15
text: Good understanding gives favor, but the way of traitors [is] ever flowing.

title: Proverbs 13:16
text: Every wise one deals with knowledge, but a fool lays open [his] folly.

title: Proverbs 13:17
text: A wicked messenger falls into mischief, but a faithful ambassador [is] health.

title: Proverbs 13:18
text: Poverty and shame [shall be to] him who refuses instruction, but he who listens to correction shall be honored.

title: Proverbs 13:19
text: The desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but [it is] hateful to fools to turn from evil.

title: Proverbs 13:20
text: He who walks with the wise shall be wise, but a companion [with] fools shall be destroyed.

title: Proverbs 13:21
text: Evil pursues sinners, but to the righteous good shall be repaid.

title: Proverbs 13:22
text: A good [man] leaves an inheritance to his sons' sons, and the wealth of the sinner [is] laid up for the just.

title: Proverbs 13:23
text: Much food [is] in the plowed ground of the poor, but when [there is] no justice, it is swept away.

title: Proverbs 13:24
text: He who spares his rod hates his son, but he who loves him chastens him early.

title: Proverbs 13:25
text: The righteous eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked shall lack.

title: Proverbs 14:1
text: A wise woman builds her house, but the foolish plucks it down with her hands.

title: Proverbs 14:2
text: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but [he who is] perverse in his ways despises Him.

title: Proverbs 14:3
text: In the mouth of the foolish [is] a rod of pride, but the lips of the wise shall keep them.

title: Proverbs 14:4
text: Where no cattle [are], the stall [is] clean, but much gain [is] by the strength of the ox.

title: Proverbs 14:5
text: A faithful witness will not lie, but a false witness will speak lies.

title: Proverbs 14:6
text: A scorner seeks wisdom, and it is not [found], but knowledge [is] easy to him who understands.

title: Proverbs 14:7
text: Go from the before a foolish man when you do not see [in him] the lips of knowledge.

title: Proverbs 14:8
text: The wisdom of the wise [is] to understand his way, but the folly of fools [is] deceit.

title: Proverbs 14:9
text: Fools laugh at sin, but among the righteous [there is] favor.

title: Proverbs 14:10
text: The heart knows its own bitterness, and a stranger does not share in its joy.

title: Proverbs 14:11
