title: Ecclesiastes 7:5
text: [It is] better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:6
text: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so [is] the laughter of the fool; this also [is] vanity.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:7
text: Surely oppression makes a wise man mad; and a bribe destroys the heart.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:8
text: Better [is] the end of a thing than the beginning of it; the patient in spirit [is] better than the proud in spirit.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:9
text: Do not be hasty in your spirit to be angry; for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:10
text: Do not say, Why was [it] that the former days were better than these? For you do not ask wisely in regard to this.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:11
text: Wisdom [is] good with an inheritance; but it is gain to those who see the sun.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:12
text: For wisdom [is] a defense, and money [is] a defense; but the excellency of knowledge [is] that wisdom gives life to those who have it.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:13
text: Consider the work of God; for who can make straight what He has made crooked?

title: Ecclesiastes 7:14
text: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity take note [that] God also has set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:15
text: All [things] I have seen in the days of my vanity; there is a just one who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked one who prolongs [life] in his wickedness.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:16
text: Do not be righteous overmuch, neither make yourself overwise; why destroy yourself?

title: Ecclesiastes 7:17
text: Do not be very wicked, and do not be a fool; why should you die before your time?

title: Ecclesiastes 7:18
text: [It is] good that you should take hold of this; yea, also from this do not withdraw your hand; for he who fears God shall come forth from all of them.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:19
text: Wisdom makes the wise stronger than ten mighty ones who are in the city.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:20
text: For [there is] not a just man on earth who does good and does not sin.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:21
text: Also do not listen to all words that are spoken; lest you hear your servant curse you.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:22
text: For also your own heart knows that you yourself have also cursed others many times.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:23
text: All this I have proved by wisdom; I said, I will be wise; but it [was] far from me.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:24
text: That which is far off and exceedingly deep, who can find it out?

title: Ecclesiastes 7:25
text: I set my heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason [of things], and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness;

title: Ecclesiastes 7:26
text: and I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart [is] snares and nets, and her hands [like] bands. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her, but the sinner shall be taken by her.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:27
text: Behold, this I have found, says the Preacher, [counting] one by one, to find out the sum,

title: Ecclesiastes 7:28
text: which my soul still sought, but I find not: one man among a thousand I have found, but a woman among all those I have not found.

title: Ecclesiastes 7:29
text: Lo, this only I have found, that God has made man upright, but they have sought out many inventions.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:1
text: Who [is] as the wise? And who knows the meaning of a thing? A man's wisdom makes his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:2
text: I [say], keep the king's word, and [that] because of the oath of God.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:3
text: Do not be hasty to leave his presence. Do not take a stand in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:4
text: Because the word of a king [is] that which has power; and who may say to him, What are you doing?

title: Ecclesiastes 8:5
text: Whoever keeps the command shall feel no evil thing; and a wise man's heart knows both time and judgment.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:6
text: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man [is] great on him.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:7
text: For he does not know what shall be; for who can tell him when it shall be?

title: Ecclesiastes 8:8
text: [There is] no man who has power over the spirit to keep the spirit; nor power in the day of death; and [there is] no discharge in [that] war; nor shall wickedness deliver its owners.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:9
text: All this I have seen, and I gave my heart to every work that is done under the sun. [there is] a time in which one man rules over another to his own hurt.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:10
text: And so I saw the wicked buried, and they came and went from the holy place. And they were forgotten in the city, [these] things that they had done. This [is] also vanity.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:11
text: Because sentence [against] an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:12
text: Though a sinner does evil a hundred [times], and his [days] be made longer, yet surely I know that it shall be well with those who fear God, who fear before Him.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:13
text: But it shall not be well with the wicked, nor shall he make [his] days longer like a shadow; because he does not fear before God.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:14
text: There is a vanity which is done on the earth: There are just ones to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked; again, there are wicked ones to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also [is]  vanity.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:15
text: Then I praised gladness, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat and to drink and to be glad; for that shall go with him of his labor for the days of his life which God gives him under the sun.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:16
text: When I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth; for neither day nor night do men see sleep with their eyes.

title: Ecclesiastes 8:17
text: Then I looked at all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun; because though a man labors to seek [it] out, yet he shall not find it. Yea, further, though a wise one speaks of knowing, yet he shall not be able to find [it].

title: Ecclesiastes 9:1
text: For all this I took to heart, even to make all this clear, that the righteous and the wise and their works [are] in the hand of God. No man knows either love or hatred [by] all [that is] before them.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:2
text: All [happens] alike to all; [there is] one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him who sacrifices, and to him who does not sacrifice. As [is] the good, so is the sinner. He who swears is as [he] who fears an oath.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:3
text: This [is] an evil among all things that are done under the sun, that [there is] one event to all. Yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness [is] in their heart while they live, and after that [they go] to the dead.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:4
text: For whoever is chosen, to all those living, there is hope; for a living dog [is] better than a dead lion.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:5
text: For the living know that they shall die; but the dead do not know anything, nor do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:6
text: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; nor do they any longer have a part forever in all that is done under the sun.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:7
text: Go, eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God now is pleased with your works.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:8
text: Let your garments be always white; and let your head lack no ointment.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:9
text: Look [on] life with the wife whom you love all the days of the life of your vanity, which He has given you under the sun, all the days of your vanity. For that [is] your share in [this] life, and in your labor which you labor under the sun.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:10
text: Whatever your hand finds to do, do [it] with all your might; for [there is] no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave where you go.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:11
text: I returned and saw under the sun that the race [is] not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, nor yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happens to them all.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:12
text: For man also does not know his time; as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so [are] the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:13
text: This wisdom I have seen also under the sun, and it [seemed] great to me.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:14
text: [There was] a little city, and few men in it; and a great king came against it and besieged it, and built huge bulwarks against it.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:15
text: And a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that poor man.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:16
text: And I said, Wisdom [is] better than strength; but the poor man's wisdom [is] despised, and his words are not heard.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:17
text: The words of the wise [are] heard in quiet more than the cry of him who rules among fools.

title: Ecclesiastes 9:18
text: Wisdom [is] better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:1
text: As dead flies cause the perfumer's ointment to stink [and] ferment; [so] heavier more rare than wisdom and than honor is a little foolishness.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:2
text: A man's heart [is] at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:3
text: Yes also, in the way a fool walks, his heart fails; and he says to all [that] he [is] a fool.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:4
text: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, do not leave your place; for yielding quiets great sinners.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:5
text: There is an evil I have seen under the sun, sins which comes from the ruler's face;

title: Ecclesiastes 10:6
text: foolishness is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:7
text: I have seen servants on horses and princes walking as servants on the earth.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:8
text: He who digs a pit shall fall into it; and whoever breaks a hedge, a snake shall bite him.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:9
text: Whoever removes stones shall be hurt with them. He who splits wood shall be endangered by it.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:10
text: If the iron is blunt, and he does not whet the edge, then he must put more strength to [it]. But wisdom [is] profitable to direct.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:11
text: Surely the snake will bite without enchantment; and a babbler [is] no better.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:12
text: The words of a wise mouth [are] gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow him.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:13
text: The beginning of the words of his mouth [is] foolishness; and the end of his talk [is] wicked madness.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:14
text: A fool also makes many words; a man knows not what they shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?

title: Ecclesiastes 10:15
text: The labor of fools wearies him, because he does not know [how] to go to the city.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:16
text: Woe to you, O land, when your king [is] a child and your leaders eat in the morning.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:17
text: Blessed [are] you, O land, when your king [is] the son of nobles, and your leaders eat in [due] time, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

title: Ecclesiastes 10:18
text: By slothfulness the building decays; and through lowering of the hands the house leaks.

title: Ecclesiastes 10:19
text: Bread [is] made for laughter, and wine makes merry; but silver answers all [things].

title: Ecclesiastes 10:20
text: Do not curse a king, no, not in your thought; and do not curse the rich in your bedroom; for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which has wings shall tell the matter.

title: Ecclesiastes 11:1
text: Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.

title: Ecclesiastes 11:2
text: Give a share to seven, and also to eight; for you know not what evil shall be on the earth.

title: Ecclesiastes 11:3
text: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty on the earth; and if the tree falls toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falls, there it shall be.

title: Ecclesiastes 11:4
text: He who watches the wind shall not sow; and he who pays attention to the clouds shall not reap.

title: Ecclesiastes 11:5
text: As you do not know what [is] the way of the spirit, as how the bones [grow] in the pregnant woman's womb; even so you do not know the works of God who makes all.

title: Ecclesiastes 11:6
text: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening do not withhold your hand; for you do not know what shall be blessed, either this or that, or whether they both [shall be] fruitful in the same way.

title: Ecclesiastes 11:7
text: Also the light [is] sweet, and a pleasant thing [it is] for the eyes to behold the sun;

title: Ecclesiastes 11:8
text: but if a man lives many years, [and] rejoices in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many. All that comes [is] vanity.

title: Ecclesiastes 11:9
text: Rejoice, in your youth, young man; and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth, and walk in the ways of your heart, and in the sight of your eyes; but know that for all these [things] God will bring you into judgment.

title: Ecclesiastes 11:10
text: Therefore remove vexation from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for childhood and prime of life [are] vanity.

title: Ecclesiastes 12:1
text: Remember now your Creator in the days of your youth, while the evil days do not come, nor the years draw near, when you shall say, I have no pleasure in them.

title: Ecclesiastes 12:2
text: So long as the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, are darkened, or the clouds return after rain,

title: Ecclesiastes 12:3
text: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men, are bowed, and the grinders cease because there are few, and those who look out of the windows are darkened,

title: Ecclesiastes 12:4
text: and the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and you shall rise up at the voice of a bird, and all the daughters of music are silenced;

title: Ecclesiastes 12:5
text: also they are afraid of the high place, and terrors along the way, and the almond tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail; because man goes to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets;

title: Ecclesiastes 12:6
text: or ever the silver cord is not loosed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern;

title: Ecclesiastes 12:7
text: then the dust shall return to the earth as it was, and the spirit shall return to God who gave it.

title: Ecclesiastes 12:8
text: Vanity of vanities, says the preacher; all [is] vanity.

title: Ecclesiastes 12:9
text: And more than that, the preacher [was] wise; he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he listened, and looked, and set in order many proverbs.

title: Ecclesiastes 12:10
text: The preacher sought to find out pleasing words; and words of truth written by the upright.

title: Ecclesiastes 12:11
text: The words of the wise [are] like goads; yes, their collected words are like nails driven home; they [are] given from one Shepherd.

title: Ecclesiastes 12:12
text: And further, by these, my son, be warned: The making of many books has no end, and much study [is] a weariness of the flesh.

title: Ecclesiastes 12:13
text: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter. Fear God, and keep His commandments. For this [is] the whole [duty] of man.

title: Ecclesiastes 12:14
text: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether [it is] good, or whether evil.

title: Song of Solomon 1:1
text: The song of songs, which [is] Solomon's.

title: Song of Solomon 1:2
text: Let Him kiss me with the kisses of His mouth; for Your loves [are] better than wine.

title: Song of Solomon 1:3
text: For Your ointments have a lovely fragrance; Your name is [as] oil poured out; therefore the virgins love You.

title: Song of Solomon 1:4
text: Draw me, we will run after You, The King has brought me into his chambers; we will be glad and rejoice in You, we will remember Your love more than wine; the upright love You.

title: Song of Solomon 1:5
text: I [am] black, but comely, O daughters of Jerusalem, like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Solomon.

title: Song of Solomon 1:6
text: Do not look on me, that I [am] black, that the sun has looked on me. My mother's sons were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; [but] my vineyard I have not kept.

title: Song of Solomon 1:7
text: Tell me, [You] whom my soul loves, where do You feed, where do You lie down at noon? For why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of Your companions?

title: Song of Solomon 1:8
text: If you know not, most beautiful among women, go in the footsteps of the flock; and feed your kids beside the shepherds' tents.

title: Song of Solomon 1:9
text: O My love, I have compared you to My mares among Pharaoh's chariots.

title: Song of Solomon 1:10
text: Your cheeks [are] beautiful with ornaments, your neck with chains.

title: Song of Solomon 1:11
text: We will make you borders of gold with studs of silver.

title: Song of Solomon 1:12
text: While the King is in His circle, my spikenard gives its smell.

title: Song of Solomon 1:13
text: A bundle of myrrh [is] my Beloved to me. [He] shall lie all night between my breasts.

title: Song of Solomon 1:14
text: My Beloved [is] to me [like] a cluster of henna in the vineyards of Engedi.

title: Song of Solomon 1:15
text: Behold, you [are] beautiful, my love; behold, you [are] beautiful; you [have] doves' eyes.

title: Song of Solomon 1:16
text: Behold, you [are] beautiful, my Beloved, yea, pleasant. Also our bed [is] green.

title: Song of Solomon 1:17
text: The beams of our house [are] cedar, [and] our rafters are of fir.

title: Song of Solomon 2:1
text: I [am] the rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.

title: Song of Solomon 2:2
text: As the lily among thorns, so [is] My love among the daughters.

title: Song of Solomon 2:3
text: As the apple among the trees of the wood, so [is] my Beloved among the sons. I sat down under His shadow with great delight, and His fruit [was] sweet to my taste.

title: Song of Solomon 2:4
text: He brought me to the banqueting house, and His banner over me [was] love.

title: Song of Solomon 2:5
text: Feed me with raisin cakes, comfort me with apples, for I [am] sick [with] love.

title: Song of Solomon 2:6
text: His left hand [is] under my head, and His right hand embraces me.

title: Song of Solomon 2:7
text: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles, and by the does of the field, do not stir up or awake [my] Love until He please.

title: Song of Solomon 2:8
text: The voice of my Beloved! Behold, He comes leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.

title: Song of Solomon 2:9
text: My Beloved is like a roe or a young hart. Behold, [He] stands behind our wall, He looks forth at the windows, peering from the lattice.

title: Song of Solomon 2:10
text: My Beloved spoke, and said to me, Rise up, My love, My beautiful one, and come away.

title: Song of Solomon 2:11
text: For lo, the winter is past, the rain is over; it goes to itself.

title: Song of Solomon 2:12
text: the flowers appear on the earth; the time of singing has come, and the voice of the turtle-dove is heard in our land;

title: Song of Solomon 2:13
text: the fig tree puts forth her green figs, and the vines [with] the tender grape give a [good] smell. Arise, My love, My beautiful one, and come away.

title: Song of Solomon 2:14
text: O My dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let Me see your face, let Me hear your voice; for your voice [is] sweet, and your face [is] beautiful.

title: Song of Solomon 2:15
text: Take us the foxes, the little foxes that spoil the vines; for our vines [have] tender grapes.

title: Song of Solomon 2:16
text: My Beloved [is] mine, and I [am] His; He feeds among the lilies.

title: Song of Solomon 2:17
text: Until when does the day blow, and the shadows flee away? Turn, my Beloved, and be like a gazelle, or a young deer, the stag, on the mountains of Bether.

title: Song of Solomon 3:1
text: By night on my bed I sought Him whom my soul loved; I sought [Him], but I did not find Him.

title: Song of Solomon 3:2
text: I will rise now and go about the city, in the streets and in the broad ways; I will seek [Him] whom my soul loves. I sought Him, but I did not find Him.

title: Song of Solomon 3:3
text: The watchmen going about the city found me. [I said], Have you seen Him whom my soul loves?

title: Song of Solomon 3:4
text: But a little while after I passed from them, I found [Him] whom my soul loves. I held Him and would not let Him go, until I had brought Him into my mother's house, and into the room of her who conceived me.

title: Song of Solomon 3:5
text: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles, and by the does of the field, do not stir up nor awake [my] love until it pleases.

title: Song of Solomon 3:6
text: Who [is] this coming up out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, from all the merchant's powders?

title: Song of Solomon 3:7
text: Behold his bed, Solomon's! Sixty mighty men [are] around it, of Israel's mighty men.

title: Song of Solomon 3:8
text: They all hold swords, instructed in war; each man has his sword on his thigh because of fear in the night.

title: Song of Solomon 3:9
text: King Solomon made himself a litter-bed of Lebanon's trees.

title: Song of Solomon 3:10
text: He made its poles [of] silver, its back gold, its seat of purple, its middle was paved [with] love by the daughters of Jerusalem.

title: Song of Solomon 3:11
text: Go forth, O daughters of Zion, and behold King Solomon with the crown [with] which his mother crowned him on his wedding day, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.

title: Song of Solomon 4:1
text: Behold, you [are] beautiful, My love. Behold, you [are] beautiful; your eyes [are] like doves' from behind your veil; your hair [is] like a flock of goats that appear from Mount Gilead.

title: Song of Solomon 4:2
text: Your teeth [are] like a flock of shorn [sheep], which came up from the washing; they all are bearing twins and not one [is] barren among them.

title: Song of Solomon 4:3
text: Your lips [are] like a cord of scarlet, and your speech [is] becoming; your temples [are] like a piece of pomegranate behind your veil.

title: Song of Solomon 4:4
text: Your neck [is] like the tower of David built for an armory, on which there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.

title: Song of Solomon 4:5
text: Your two breasts [are] like two fawns, twins of a gazelle, feeding among the lilies.

title: Song of Solomon 4:6
text: Until when the day blows, and the shadows flee away, I will go to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.

title: Song of Solomon 4:7
text: You [are] all fair, My love; no blemish [is] in you.

title: Song of Solomon 4:8
text: Come with Me from Lebanon, [My] spouse; with Me from Lebanon. Look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
